title: E-Commerce Manager - Shopify Plus
description:
USA Roller Chain & Sprockets



E-Commerce Manager - Shopify Plus







Location: Remote -- Philippines







Fifty Thousand Products. One Massive Digital Opportunity.



USA Roller Chain & Sprockets is a fast-growing, family-owned power transmission distributor headquartered in Clermont, Florida, and we have been powering American industry since 2001. We sell power transmission products to customers throughout the United States and around the world. Our Shopify Plus website contains more than 50,000 products and supports a growing volume of B2B demand. We are looking for a hands-on e-commerce professional who can keep this complex digital engine organized, optimized, and moving forward.







Our core values: 



Integrity - Innovation - Commitment - Respect - Empathy -Striving for Excellence







USA Roller Chain & Sprockets is seeking a technically capable and detail-oriented E-Commerce Manager to oversee the daily operation and continued development of its Shopify Plus website. This is not a "set it and forget it" website. With more than 50,000 products, thousands of collections, technical resources, and frequent updates, the platform is constantly evolving. You will manage product data, improve site organization, support front-end updates, monitor performance, and coordinate with internal leadership and external development partners.







The ideal candidate combines hands-on Shopify expertise with strong catalog-management, analytical, SEO, and project-coordination skills. You do not need to be located in Florida, but you must communicate clearly, work independently, and maintain reliable overlap with the company's U.S. Eastern Time business hours.







Key Responsibilities



Manage and maintain the company's Shopify Plus storefront

Perform regular website updates, configurations, and quality checks

Maintain a catalog containing more than 50,000 products

Complete bulk updates to titles, descriptions, tags, prices, images, and attributes

Organize products into accurate, scalable collections and categories

Improve site navigation, filtering, search, and product discovery

Add new products and update existing product information

Maintain consistent product taxonomy and data standards

Identify and correct broken links, inaccurate content, and website errors

Make light front-end changes using HTML, CSS, and Shopify Liquid

Support new Shopify features, applications, integrations, and improvements

Coordinate projects with external developers, agencies, and marketing partners

Translate business needs into clear technical tasks

Review and test updates before and after launch

Support technical and on-page SEO improvements

Optimize product pages, collections, and educational content

Monitor traffic, conversion rate, average order value, and revenue performance

Use site data to recommend improvements to merchandising and user experience

Support promotions, campaigns, product spotlights, and new content

Help bring more e-commerce capabilities and institutional knowledge in-house





Qualifications



Two or more years of verifiable, hands-on Shopify experience

Shopify Plus experience strongly preferred

Demonstrated experience managing a large or technically complex product catalog

Proficiency with Shopify Admin and bulk CSV operations

Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Shopify Liquid

Experience with product taxonomy, attributes, collections, tags, and filters

Understanding of technical and on-page SEO best practices

Experience with Shopify Analytics, Google Analytics, or comparable tools

Ability to identify and troubleshoot website and product-data issues

Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy

Comfortable coordinating with developers and external agencies

Strong written and verbal English communication skills sufficient to collaborate with U.S.-based colleagues, vendors, and partners. 

Able to work independently and manage competing priorities

Reliable internet connection and availability during agreed working hours

Experience with industrial, technical, or B2B e-commerce is a plus

Experience with large SKU environments and third-party integrations is highly preferred

Schedule: Candidates must be available for at least 4 hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Specific working hours will be agreed upon before engagement. 





*Preferred remote-work setup: To support consistent availability, candidates are encouraged to have a reliable backup plan for both internet connectivity and power outages. This may include a mobile hotspot or secondary internet provider, along with a UPS, inverter, battery system, or generator. While not strictly required, having these safeguards is strongly preferred. 







Compensation



Full-time, remote position

Pay: $18-$25 per hour, depending on experience and location





Why USA Roller Chain & Sprockets?



This is not another small Shopify store with a few dozen products, and nothing left to build. You will work on a large, active B2B platform with more than 50,000 products, ongoing development needs, strong organic visibility, and real revenue impact. The company is investing in bringing more digital expertise in-house and wants someone who can grow with the platform. If complex catalogs make you curious instead of nervous, this may be the challenge you have been looking for.







USA Roller Chain & Sprockets is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Paid Ads Specialist
description:
About Us

Service Conversion is a marketing agency that helps home services companies (HVAC, plumbing, and electrical) grow through high-converting websites and lead generation. We're a small, hands-on team, and our clients count on us to turn ad spend into booked jobs.



The Role

We're looking for an expert paid ads specialist who can own campaigns from start to finish. This isn't a "just manage the bids" job. You'll build the full system: tracking, offer, landing page, follow-up, and budget. You'll work closely with our design, copy, and operations team to make every campaign work as a complete funnel.

What You'll Do

• Build and manage Google Ads (Search, Local Services Ads, Performance Max) and Meta Ads 
/Instagram) campaigns for home services clients

• Set up full conversion tracking before launch, including GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, call tracking, and form tracking

• Work with the team to plan and sharpen offers that actually get homeowners to call

• Collaborate with our web team on landing pages built to convert

• Set up
 and SMS follow-up campaigns so leads don't go cold

• Manage and adjust daily budgets across all ad platforms to hit client goals

• Bring fresh ideas for new ways to generate leads, whether that's new platforms (YouTube, Nextdoor, ChatGPT Ads, Microsoft Ads), new ad formats, seasonal promotions, or creative angles we haven't tried yet

• Report on results in plain language: cost per lead, booked jobs, and ROI



What You Bring

• 3+ years of hands-on experience running Google Ads and Meta Ads

• Proven ability to set up tracking from scratch, not just use what's already there

• Experience with
 and SMS automation (GoHighLevel experience is a big plus)

• A full-funnel mindset: you understand that the ad is only one piece

• A creative, test-and-learn mindset: you're always looking for the next channel or offer that can bring in more leads

• Comfort asking for help and working across teams to get campaigns launched right

• Experience with home services or local service businesses is a strong plus

How to Apply

title: Amazon Product Sourcing VA
description:
We are looking for an experienced Amazon Product Sourcer to help us grow and scale our UK Amazon FBA business. The main focus of the role is sourcing profitable products in the UK marketplace, primarily via Online Arbitrage.



WE HAVE THE CAPITAL READY TO SPEND. WHAT WE NEED IS MORE HIGH-QUALITY LEADS. That is the whole job, and it is why we are only looking for proven UK OA sourcers this time. If you are new to sourcing or have only worked the US market, this role is not for you.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR THE SAME LEADS EVERYONE ELSE BUYS. Deal lists, 
 feeds and the top page of the scanning tools are seen by hundreds of sellers on the same day and the margin is gone within hours. We want a sourcer who can MANUFACTURE THEIR OWN DISCOUNT (stacking codes, clearance, discounts and anything else to make profitable products, price matches, multi-buy and bundle offers, newsletter and app-only promotions) and who can FIND LOW-KEY LEADS that never appear on a shared list: quiet retailers, deep category pages, seasonal clearance, brands with no third-party sellers yet. If you can take a shelf price that shows 5% ROI and turn it into a 25% buy, you are who we want.



The role includes an UNCAPPED BONUS based on the spend on leads you provide. The more we buy from your leads, the more you earn. Our top performing sourcers regularly earn an extra $400+ per month on top of salary, and there is no ceiling. FOR A PROVEN, ABSOLUTE TOP PERFORMER, THE BASE SALARY IS NEGOTIABLE. Show us your track record and we will talk.



The ideal candidate is self-motivated, hungry, and looking for a long-term position with space to grow. We ask that only candidates with real experience of Online Arbitrage product sourcing in the UK marketplace apply.



WHAT AN A-CLASS SOURCER LOOKS LIKE TO US:

- Consistently delivers leads we actually buy, not long lists of borderline ones

- Manufactures margin: knows every legitimate way to get a UK retailer's price down (code stacking, cashback sites, discounted gift cards, loyalty schemes, price matching, multi-buys, app and newsletter codes etc) and builds that into the lead before submitting it

- Finds low-key leads through methods the shared tools and deal lists do not surface: manual retailer digging, storefront and reverse sourcing, deep category and clearance pages, brands with no third-party sellers, seasonal and regional stock

- Uses a wide range of sourcing methods and keeps finding new ones (retailer clearance and promotions, brand and category scanning, Keepa Product Finder)

- Reads a Keepa chart properly: real sales velocity, the real sell price, Buy Box behaviour, etc

- Checks gating, IP risk, variations and VAT before submitting, so leads arrive clean

- Knows UK retailers and discount routes that most sourcing VAs do not



EXPERIENCE REQUESTED (please include details of your experience against each point in your application):

- 12+ months experience in OA sourcing for the UK market specifically

- Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, SellerAmp SAS and Keepa

- Experience in a variety of different sourcing methods for OA (and wholesale or Amazon-to-Amazon if applicable) - list every sourcing method you have used, step by step

- Google Sheets / Excel

- Understanding of UK VAT and UK FBA fees in profit calculations



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Product research and analysis in SAS and Keepa

- Finding your own leads from UK retailers and suppliers using your full range of methods

- Verifying, prioritising and re-checking leads passed to you by the team before they are bought

- Inputting leads into our leads database in the required format, with your reasoning

- Flagging replenishable winners



WHAT WE OFFER:

- $4000 / month starting base salary + uncapped performance bonus paid on spend from your leads

- Flexible working hours (40 hours per week, work when suits you, with at least a one hour crossover with UK 9am-5pm for communication)

- Salary reviewed regularly and increased based on contribution and performance; base negotiable for a proven top performer

- Career development: we are expanding our team of VAs and will be promoting internally for managers and purchasers

- Long-term, stable role with a growing UK business



REQUIREMENTS:

- Full-time: 40 hours a week

- You will use timeproof software to demonstrate you are working effectively during contracted hours

- You will work for us and only us; you may not source for other e-commerce sellers at the same time

- Every lead you submit is checked. Padded or copied lead sheets end the trial.

- Include the words "BIG CHEESE" in your application subject. Applications without it are ignored. This is to make sure you have read the post.



TO APPLY:

Respond with the subject line above and include ALL of the following. Applications missing any of these are not read:



1. A brief description of why you are the best candidate and how you can help us grow.

2. Every sourcing method you use, step by step, in your own words. Which retailers, which discount and cashback routes, which Keepa filters, how you stack them. "I use Keepa and SAS" is not an answer.

3. How you manufacture discount. Give us a real example of a deal where the shelf price did not work and you built the margin yourself: which codes, cashback, gift card or loyalty discounts you stacked, in what order, and what the final buy price and ROI came to. Legitimate, publicly available discounts only.

4. 2-3 real UK product leads you have found in the last 7 days that did NOT come from a deal list, 
 feed or the top page of a scanning tool: retailer purchase link, Amazon link, buy price including delivery and any discount applied, sell price, ROI, net profit after VAT and fees, estimated monthly sales, SAS and Keepa screenshots, how you found it, and a short description of why it is a good lead. This is mandatory, not optional, and it carries the most weight in our decision. Leads we recognise from public lists count against you.

5. Your track record: for your last one or two UK clients, roughly how much did they spend per month on your leads, and what ROI did those leads return? Do you have your old lead sheet for us to see example leads?



If you have a CV, portfolio or anything else that demonstrates why we should hire you, include it. Shortlisted candidates get a short video call and a paid two-week trial working real leads.

Video Review Quality Control (1 position available)

We launch hundreds of ‘How To’ YouTube episodes every month across our various client's channels. We are in need of an additional team member to help with quality control. Your main role will be to review the completed video and check for editing errors, spelling errors, out of place content, etc.

Experience in quality control or video editing or a keen eye will really be helpful, as you will be the one putting the stamp of approval on each video before our clients or the public sees it.



Description Writer  (1 position available)

As a description writer, you will join our YouTube team. When the editing team is finished with things on their side, the YouTube team takes over with a variety of tasks, including writing the description. You’ll start with the specific template we use for the corresponding channel, and then customize it with a 1 or 2 paragraph summary of the video content, followed by a specific time-stamped “table of contents” called chapters. We’ll teach you how to do this. 



The ideal candidate needs to have mastery over English writing and grammar. The writing projects won’t be overly complex, but everything needs to be written in a way that sounds native English. The first part of the introduction needs to be written in a compelling way, to create curiosity in the viewer compelling them to watch the episode. 



Transcription, Cards, Endscreens & Chapter TimeStamps (2 positions available)

YouTube transcriptions are vital to the success of our YouTube strategy. Today, instead of using keyword tags to index a video for search, YouTube uses the transcription and knows what the video is about. YouTube will automatically transcribe the video, and your job will be to comb through it adding capitalization, punctuation, and correct spelling errors. You will also take note of “Chapters” throughout the video and provide that information to our description writers.



The ideal candidate for this position needs to be able to endure repetitive tasks with a close attention to detail. You need to be advanced in English spelling and writing. The keyword strategy we use will ensure our clients say the right words within the video, and you will ensure those words are spelled correctly in the transcription. title: YouTube Video Editor – Long-Form + Shorts | Part-Time
description:
Video Editor, YouTube Long Form and Short Form



About Years Younger



Years Younger is a movement, mobility, strength, and performance longevity brand helping active adults stay strong, mobile, capable, confident, and adventurous.



We are actively growing our YouTube channel and are looking for a skilled, experienced video editor who can turn educational talking head, movement, breathwork, mobility, and wellness content into polished videos that hold attention and feel professional.



This is primarily a video editing position.



I am not looking for someone who simply knows how to cut clips together. I am looking for an editor with strong visual judgment who understands pacing, storytelling, B roll, music, hooks, viewer retention, and, equally important, when not to add unnecessary effects.



What You Will Be Editing



You may work on:



• Long form YouTube videos, including educational and talking head content

• Movement, mobility, exercise, and breathwork videos

• YouTube Shorts and vertical social videos

• Strong opening sequences and hooks

• B roll sequences that visually reinforce what the speaker is teaching

• Captions, text, graphics, and motion elements when appropriate

• Music and sound that support the tone without overpowering the content

• Long form content repurposed into high quality short form clips



You will also be responsible for reviewing your own work before submitting it and correcting obvious issues with cuts, audio, text, spelling, graphics, pacing, cropping, and exports.



Quality control is part of the editing job, not something that should happen only after revisions are requested.



The Editor We Are Looking For



You should have:



• At least 4 years of professional video editing experience

• A strong portfolio demonstrating long form editing ability

• Experience editing talking head, educational, podcast, coaching, wellness, fitness, or similar content

• Strong B roll selection and placement skills

• An understanding of pacing and viewer retention

• The ability to create engaging intros without making the entire video feel overproduced

• Good judgment around music, graphics, captions, transitions, and effects

• The ability to follow an established brand while bringing your own creative ideas

• Strong attention to detail and quality control

• The ability to accept feedback and make revisions accurately

• Excellent communication and deadline management

• The ability to work independently without requiring constant direction



Being able to make a video more interesting without making it unnecessarily busy is particularly important for this role.



Editing Software



You should be highly proficient with at least one professional editing platform, preferably:



Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut.



Experience with After Effects or motion graphics is a plus.



CapCut experience is useful because we also produce short form content.



Descript experience is helpful but not required. A strong editor can be trained on the portions of Descript we use.



Schedule and Compensation



This is a remote, ongoing part time position.



*Starting pay: $6 USD per hour

*Expected workload: approximately 12 to 15 hours per week



Hours may grow over time as the YouTube channel and business expand.



You do not need to work entirely during U.S. business hours, but you must have reliable communication overlap during Pacific Time working hours.



My normal working day ends at approximately *4:00 PM Pacific Time (Los Angeles)*, so questions, problems, file access issues, and deadline concerns need to be communicated early rather than late in the evening.



Communication Expectations



Communication is an important part of this position and will also be evaluated during the hiring process and paid test.



During your agreed working days, you are expected to acknowledge direct work messages, questions, file access issues, revision requests, or deadline related communication within 8 hours.



You do not need to have the complete answer within 8 hours. A short acknowledgment is sufficient, for example:



“Received, thank you. I’ll review this and update you by 2:00 PM PT.”



“I received the files and everything is opening correctly. I’ll follow up after I review them.”



“I saw your message. I need some time to investigate this and will update you during my next work block.”



If a problem could affect a deadline, you are expected to communicate it as soon as you become aware of it rather than waiting until the deadline approaches.



Last minute extension requests or discovering at the end of a project that an assignment cannot be completed will not be a good fit for this role.



How to Apply



Please include all of the following in your application:



1. Your video editing portfolio.



2. Links to two of your strongest long form edits.



3. A link to one of your strongest short form edits.



4. For each example, briefly explain exactly what you personally did on the video, such as first pass editing, B roll, graphics, animation, color, audio, captions, thumbnail, or complete edit.



5. Choose one of the long form videos you submitted and give me one specific timestamp where you made an editing decision you are particularly proud of. Tell me what you did there and why you made that choice.



6. Tell me how many years you have worked professionally as a video editor.



7. Tell me which editing programs you currently use.



8. Tell me your current or normal hourly rate.



9. Tell me whether you currently have another job or regular clients and approximately how many hours per week you are committed elsewhere.



10. Give me your normal weekly working schedule, including your working days and hours, shown in both your local time and Pacific Time.



11. Specifically tell me what hours you would normally be available for communication between 8:00 AM and 4:00 PM Pacific Time.



12. Briefly explain how you approach B roll selection and pacing in a talking head YouTube video.



13. Briefly explain how you d
 when to use music, graphics, text, transitions, and effects versus when to keep an edit simple.



Important Application Instructions



Please read these carefully.



Start with the number 12. Subtract 9, then add 2.



Use the final answer as the number of Apply Points you use when submitting your application.



Do not write the answer to the math problem here simply because it appears in the job posting. Calculate it yourself and use that number of Apply Points.



Also, somewhere in your response to the question about B roll selection and pacing, naturally use the word younger.



Please do not simply write “younger” by itself or add it as an unrelated sentence. It should be used naturally within your response.



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be reviewed.

title: Building an Empire using a Laptop | Personal Assistant & Outreach Specialist Needed
description:
Hey! I’m a 25-year-old solo entrepreneur building a massive affiliate network of sellers, buyers, and partners across the world using my laptop. It’s called Wiredspace.

------------------

HOW THE BUSINESS WORKS

Our job is to match Sellers with Buyers through the internet.

------------------

We secure sellers by reaching out to them and offering them buyers in exchange for a commission—this is like an affiliate program. Then we target ideal buyers and recommend them to the Sellers (via
, website contact forms, WhatsApp, etc.).



We can recommend the Seller directly to the Buyer:

Sellers < - Wiredspace - > Buyers



Or indirectly—through a “Partner”:

Sellers < - Wiredspace - > Partners - > Buyers



A partner is someone who already has access to Buyers, refers those Buyers to the Seller, and earns a commission on referrals. This is like an affiliate partner.

------------------

WHAT WE MATCH:

We deal with everything. From high-ticket assets like luxury real estate, yachts, and private jets, to marketing agencies, video production, freelance/home services, courses, paintings, and general goods. We can basically sell anything, anywhere, to anyone.

------------------

DETAILED RESPONSIBILITIES

#1 Send messages all day to Buyers, Sellers, and Partners, 

and maintain ongoing communication (via Gmail, website contact forms, WhatsApp, etc.). Sending messages all day is KEY and the thing I need help with the most.



#2 Be my personal assistant, and execute daily relevant tasks such as:

Writing messages

Searching for Buyers, Sellers, and Partners

Setting appointments

Helping me organize everything (Google Sheets, to-dos, calendar)

And help me build matches

------------------

I will give clear, simple, and doable instructions and guide you through everything.



I can provide the copy, targets, and everything so that you focus strictly on sending messages—but I prefer someone who wants to learn the process of creating a match between a Buyer and a Seller / Partner from start to finish, so that you can create matches independently and understand the process.

------------------

WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR (SKILLS & ATTITUDE)

MAIN SKILL: Ability to consistently send 50+ messages/emails daily and follow up.



TECH LITERACY: 

Comfortable using Gmail, WhatsApp, Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Calendar), and basic AI tools to write messages/search.



MINDSET: Ambitious, open-minded, highly organized, and curious to experiment.



WORK DETAILS & COMPENSATION

PAY: $5 / hour

HOURS: 4 hours per day (20 hours per week, for now)

TRIAL PERIOD: 1-week trial (5 days)



COMMISSION UPSIDE: 

In addition to your base pay, you will receive performance commissions on sales we close. Because of the vast range of products we handle, your commissions could range from $50 if we sell a basic website to $1,000 if we sell a house together. Anything is possible, and our success is completely up to us.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY!)

To show that you read this post and can follow simple instructions, answer these in your response:

1. Set your application subject line to: Wiredspace Laptop Assistant: [Your Name]

2. Briefly tell me about your experience with sending messages, outreach, or admin tasks.

Thanks!

Simon

title: Virtual General Manager / Senior Operations Manager
description:
We are a growing home-services company based in Texas, USA, specializing primarily in air duct cleaning, HVAC cleaning and indoor air quality services, mold-related services, and restoration work.



Our business operates with field technicians who travel to customers’ homes and businesses every day. Our office team is responsible for answering incoming calls, booking jobs, following up with leads, coordinating technicians, handling customers, ordering materials, working with vendors, and keeping the entire operation organized.



We are continuing to grow, and we are looking for an exceptional Virtual General Manager / Senior Operations Manager who can become the owner’s right hand and eventually take responsibility for much of the company’s day-to-day operations.



This is NOT a Virtual Assistant position.

This is NOT simply a customer service or call-answering position.

This is NOT a traditional 8-hour-a-day, Monday-Friday job.



We are looking for an extremely capable, intelligent, resourceful, and dependable person.



We don’t need someone who waits for instructions all day.



We need someone who can see a problem, understand it, research it when necessary, make a good decision, take action, and follow through until the problem is solved.



Our goal is to find someone we can eventually trust to run the daily operations of the company with minimal supervision.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



You will be involved in nearly every part of the business, including:



* Managing the daily schedule of technicians, jobs, and appointments

* Answering and managing customer calls professionally

* Following up with new leads, estimates, and existing customers

* Negotiating with customers and helping close sales

* Coordinating technicians throughout the day

* Making sure technicians arrive at jobs on time and jobs are completed efficiently

* Handling customer complaints and finding solutions

* Identifying operational problems before they become bigger problems

* Ordering equipment, materials, tools, and supplies

* Managing relationships with existing vendors

* Finding better vendors, suppliers, and business partners

* Opening new supplier and vendor accounts

* Keeping track of unfinished tasks and making sure nothing falls through the cracks

* Monitoring employee and technician performance

* Improving company systems, procedures, and organization

* Researching solutions independently when you don’t know the answer

* Helping recruit and manage employees as the company grows

* Working directly with the owner on company growth and daily decision-making

* Taking responsibility for getting things done instead of simply reporting problems to the owner



The Person We’re Looking For



Intelligence, common sense, and problem-solving ability are extremely important for this position.



We’re looking for someone who:



* Thinks like an operator and business owner

* Is exceptionally sharp and learns quickly

* Has excellent judgment and common sense

* Takes initiative without constantly waiting for instructions

* Can solve complicated problems independently

* Is extremely organized

* Remembers details and follows through

* Can manage many things happening at the same time

* Communicates professionally and confidently

* Can manage employees and technicians

* Can negotiate with customers and help close sales

* Is comfortable making decisions

* Knows when to make a decision independently and when something truly needs the owner’s attention

* Takes accountability for results, not just completed tasks

* Can be trusted with increasing levels of responsibility



We do not want someone whose mentality is:



“Tell me what to do and I will do it.”



We want someone whose mentality is:



“I understand what needs to be accomplished. I will figure out how to make it happen.”



Requirements



* Previous experience as a General Manager, Operations Manager, Office Manager, Executive Operations Manager, or similar leadership position

* Excellent spoken and written English

* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities

* Excellent customer service skills

* Strong sales and negotiation skills

* Experience managing employees, schedules, and daily operations

* Strong computer skills and ability to learn new software quickly

* Ability to research and find answers independently

* Ability to work with limited supervision

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Quiet and professional workspace

* Long-term commitment



Experience with a U.S.-based home-service, HVAC, restoration, construction, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, or similar field-service company is a major advantage.



Schedule & Availability



This position requires 7-day-a-week availability.



This does not necessarily mean you will be actively working every hour, seven days a week. However, this is a senior operational position, and you must have the flexibility to respond when important situations require your attention.



We are not looking for someone who wants to work a strict shift, clock out, and completely disconnect from the business.



We need someone who understands that being responsible for operations sometimes requires handling an urgent customer, technician, scheduling, or operational issue outside normal working hours.



The regular working schedule, time off, and exact availability expectations will be discussed during the interview.



Compensation & Growth



Starting Salary: $1,200 USD per month



This is the starting salary, not the maximum salary.



We want someone who can grow with the company.



As you prove that you can independently manage more of the operation, solve problems, manage employees, improve performance, and reduce the amount of day-to-day involvement required from the owner, your compensation can increase.



There is significant long-term growth potential for the right person.



The more responsibility you can successfully take off the owner’s shoulders, the more valuable you become to the company.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career and eventually become one of the company’s key leaders.



IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE APPLYING



We are not looking for hundreds of average applications.



We are looking for one exceptional person.



When submitting your application, you MUST include a brief explanation answering the following:



“Why do you believe you are the best person for this position, and why should we trust you to eventually help run the company?”



Tell us about relevant experience you’ve had, difficult problems you’ve solved, teams or operations you’ve managed, and what makes you different from other applicants.



Generic answers will not help you. We want to understand how you think.



Applications that do not include this explanation will NOT be considered.



If you’re simply looking for another virtual assistant job where you answer calls and complete assigned tasks, please do not apply.



If you’re highly intelligent, ambitious, resourceful, dependable, and want the opportunity to become the right hand of a business owner and grow into a major leadership position, we want to hear from you.

title: Full-Stack App Developer / Software Engineer – Custom CRM & Mobile App Development
description:
About us



Zenith Roof Restorations and Replacements is a roofing company based in Sydney, Australia, servicing Sydney West, Sydney Metro, South West Sydney, and Wollongong. We built our own CRM to replace ServiceM8, and the core of it is live and in daily use by our office team. We need an experienced full stack developer to pick up where the last developer left off, finish what is already in progress, and keep working through a long backlog the office has put together.



This is a real production system used by more than 10 staff and office users every day, built on a proper security model, not a small tidy up job.



What's already built and live



Client, job, and diary records with a full status pipeline from quote through to completed

Quoting and job billing, with bundles, line items, and a materials catalog

Invoicing, with numbering and PDF generation

A roof inspection report tool that generates a branded Word document straight from a form, with multiple reports per job

Dispatch queues, so the office can group and assign jobs



What you'd start with



Finishing the scheduling and dispatch calendar. The database and booking rules are done. What's left is the calendar itself: staff shown as rows, hourly time slots, day, week, and month views, an unscheduled jobs list, and eventually drag and drop assignment (click to assign comes first)

Connecting real integrations to replace what's currently mocked: Outlook and Microsoft Graph for
, a live SMS provider, and Xero for accounting

Adding Stripe for online payments across the web app, invoices, and a future customer app

Building reporting and KPIs: profit and loss, job costing, and estimator performance

Working through a long list of smaller requested features (partial payments on invoices, automated follow ups on unpaid invoices and quotes, a proposal generator, a strata and real estate partner database, stock and material tracking, a forms builder, staff management, and more), in an order we'll agree on together

Eventually scoping and building two brand new apps that share the same backend and login system: one for our field technicians, one for our customers



Our stack



Frontend: Vite and React

Backend: Supabase, meaning Postgres, authentication, storage, and row level security

Hosting: Vercel, deploying automatically from our main branch

One piece of server side logic already runs as a Supabase edge function (it's what generates the roof reports)



What we're looking for



Solid, proven experience with React and Supabase, or very similar tools such as Postgres, Firebase, or another Postgres backed platform, including row level security or an equivalent access control model

Comfortable reading and working inside an existing production codebase, not just building from scratch

Experience wiring up real third party APIs. Anything like Stripe, Xero, Outlook or Microsoft Graph, or SMS providers is a big plus

Able to work independently, communicate clearly in English, and flag problems or better approaches rather than just doing exactly as asked

Comfortable with a backlog that isn't fully prioritised yet. We'll work through priority and scope together, and want someone who can help us think it through, not just wait to be told



How this would work



We'll start with a paid, clearly scoped first project, most likely finishing the dispatch calendar, so we can see how we work together before committing to more. If that goes well, this becomes an ongoing paid role with steady monthly work through the rest of the backlog and, eventually, the two new apps.



To apply, please tell us



Your experience with React and Supabase specifically, not just similar tools

An example of a production app you've built or maintained, ideally one still live today

Your available hours per week and your time zone

Your rate expectations, monthly or hourly, whichever you prefer to quote

Send CV to

title: Graphic Designer / Design VA
description:
We’re looking for a high-taste graphic designer to work with RevLoft on a project-by-project basis.



This is not a part-time or full-time position right now. Work will be assigned whenever we have design projects, and you’ll be paid based on your hourly rate for the work completed.



As we grow and the volume of design work becomes more consistent, there may be an opportunity to turn this into a part-time or full-time role.



The biggest thing I care about is design taste.



I’m not looking for someone who can simply follow a Canva template. I want someone who has designed genuinely good-looking work before, understands hierarchy, typography, spacing, composition, branding, and can take a reference and make something that feels just as good or better.



A common workflow might be me sending you a design and saying:



“I like the direction/style of this. Can we create something inspired by it for this project?”



You should be able to understand what makes the reference work, then create something original that fits our brand/project rather than simply copying it.



We will always provide the copy/content. Your job is primarily to turn that copy and our briefs into great visual design.



You may work on things such as:



- Image ads for info products, agencies, coaches, SaaS, webinars, etc.  (not ecom ads)

- LinkedIn and other social media graphics

- Instagram carousels

- Instagram Story designs

- Landing page graphics and infographics

- Landing page wireframes/mockups — you do not need to code them; our operations team will handle implementation

- Info product / course / digital product mockups

- Webinar and VSL slide decks

- Brand assets and occasional logo work

- Visual concepts for campaigns

- Motion graphics occasionally  (this is a plus, not a requirement)

- Other design work that comes up across our agency and client projects



You should be comfortable working from both detailed briefs and loose creative direction.



For example, sometimes we may provide an exact brief with the copy, dimensions, references, and direction. Other times we may give you the copy, show you a few references, explain the objective, and expect you to come up with the visual direction yourself.



Because this is project-based, I’m also looking for someone who is responsive and can generally start projects quickly when work comes in. I’m not expecting you to sit around waiting for us, but turnaround time and communication matter.



To Apply



Start your application with the word “RevLoft.”



(If your application does not start with RevLoft, it will automatically be disqualified)



Then include:



1. Your portfolio / best work



Please don’t just send me a giant generic portfolio. Send me the best and most relevant work you’ve done for the types of designs listed above.



Especially include image ads, social graphics, carousels, landing page designs, infographics, product mockups, or slide decks if you have them.



2. Your desired hourly rate



There is no fixed hourly rate listed for this role. Tell me what hourly rate you would want to charge for this type of work.



3. Your availability



Let me know roughly how many hours you currently have available and how quickly you can normally start a project after receiving a brief.



Hiring Process



If I like your portfolio, I’ll shortlist you and send you a small trial task consisting of 1-2 quick image ad designs.



The trial is mainly to see your actual design taste, how well you interpret a brief/reference, communication, and execution.



If you crush the trial, we’ll start sending you paid design projects as they come in.



Long-term, I’d like to find one designer I can rely on consistently rather than finding someone new every time we need something designed.

title: Video Editor & Content Repurposing Virtual Assistant
description:
Hi! I'm looking for a creative, reliable, and highly skilled Video Editor & Content Repurposing Virtual Assistant to become my go-to person for turning raw video footage into polished, professional content for multiple social media platforms.

I am an entrepreneur, educator, instructional designer, and founder of a software company. I create content around entrepreneurship, AI, instructional design, product development, education, and my SaaS platform, SimplexED Suite.

I have plenty of ideas and content.

What I DON'T have is the time—or desire—to edit it all myself. 

That's where you come in.

THE ROLE

I want to be able to record the content, upload the footage, and hand it to you.

You will take it from there.

You will be responsible for transforming raw and long-form footage into professional content designed for:

• YouTube

• YouTube Shorts

• Instagram Reels

•
/Reels

• TikTok

• LinkedIn

This includes both 16:9 long-form video and 9:16 short-form content.

This is NOT primarily an administrative VA position.

Video editing, visual storytelling, and content repurposing are the most important skills for this role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will:

• Edit long-form YouTube videos

• Turn long-form content into engaging short-form videos

• Convert and creatively redesign 16:9 content for 9:16 platforms

• Add professional captions/subtitles

• Create hooks and attention-grabbing openings

• Add graphics, motion, transitions, B-roll, music, screenshots, and other visual elements when appropriate

• Create branded video layouts

• Edit screen recordings and software demonstrations

• Keep desktop software interfaces readable when adapting them for mobile/social formats

• Create YouTube thumbnails and social-media graphics

• Repurpose one piece of content into multiple assets

• Organize completed content and source files

• Prepare content for publishing across multiple platforms

• Eventually assist with uploading and scheduling approved content

My goal is NOT simply to have someone cut videos.

I am looking for someone who can look at raw footage and think:

"How can I turn this into great content?"

A SPECIAL CHALLENGE YOU MUST BE COMFORTABLE WITH

One of my businesses is a desktop web application called SimplexED Suite.

Many of my product demonstrations are recorded in 16:9 desktop format.

However, I also need those demonstrations transformed into beautiful 9:16 Reels, Shorts, and TikToks.

Simply shrinking the entire desktop screen or adding empty/blurred space around it is not enough.

I need someone who can creatively use techniques such as reframing, zooming, motion, graphics, branded backgrounds, text, layout design, and other approaches to make desktop demonstrations look intentional and professional in vertical video.

Creative problem-solving is very important to me.

TOOLS

You do not need to use one specific editing program.

Experience with tools such as these is helpful:

• Adobe Premiere Pro

• DaVinci Resolve

• Final Cut Pro

• CapCut

• Canva

• Descript

• OpusClip

• Runway

• Adobe After Effects

• AI video and content-creation tools

I care much more about the quality of your work than which software you use.

THE PERSON I'M LOOKING FOR

You may be a great fit if you:

• Have strong video-editing skills

• Understand both long-form and short-form social content

• Have excellent visual judgment

• Understand pacing, hooks, retention, captions, and storytelling

• Can follow an established brand while still bringing creative ideas

• Can work independently without needing detailed instructions for every edit

• Are comfortable learning new software/products

• Are organized and dependable

• Communicate clearly

• Meet deadlines

• Welcome feedback without taking revisions personally

• Are interested in a long-term working relationship

Bonus if you have experience editing:

• SaaS/software demonstrations

• Educational content

• Online courses

• Technology content

• Business/entrepreneurship content

• YouTube channels

• Personal brands

HOURS

Initially, I anticipate approximately 15–20 hours per week.

This is intended to become an ongoing, long-term relationship with the right person.

I care about results, reliability, communication, and quality—not monitoring every minute of your work.

COMPENSATION

Compensation is negotiable based on your experience, portfolio, capabilities, and the scope of work you can manage.

Please include your expected hourly rate and/or preferred monthly rate in your application.

Exceptional candidates with strong video editing and content-management capabilities will be considered accordingly.

PAID SKILLS TEST

Finalists will be invited to complete a PAID editing assignment before I make the final hiring decision.

You will receive:

1. A short 16:9 desktop software demonstration

2. Brand assets/guidelines

3. A short talking-head video

You will be asked to demonstrate how you would transform the footage into polished social-media content.

I will provide the objective but intentionally will NOT give you step-by-step editing instructions.

I want to see YOUR creativity.

HOW TO APPLY

Please send me:

1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Your video-editing experience.

3. A link to your portfolio or 3–5 examples of your BEST work.

4. At least one example of a vertical Reel/Short/TikTok you edited.

5. If available, an example of a software demo, screen recording, educational video, or other content where you had to creatively present information on screen.

6. The video-editing and content tools you use.

7. Your expected hourly rate and/or preferred monthly rate for approximately 15–20 hours per week.

8. Your typical availability and working hours.

9. Tell me which part of video editing you believe you are BEST at.

IMPORTANT: At the very beginning of your application, write:

CREATE ONCE

title: B2B Cold Caller, Sales / Lead Generation Specialist, Appointment Setter, VA
description:
About the Role





We are looking for a highly motivated B2B Sales & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant to help generate new business opportunities for a U.S.-based telecommunications Account Executive which is T-Mobile



The ideal candidate is comfortable making high-volume outbound calls, researching businesses, speaking with owners and decision-makers, handling objections, qualifying prospects, and booking appointments.



This is a performance-driven sales position. Your success will be measured by the number and quality of qualified appointments you generate.



Key Responsibilities



1. Lead Generation



* Research and identify small and mid-sized businesses.

* Build targeted prospect lists using Google Maps, Google Search, business directories, LinkedIn, and other sources.

* Identify the business owner, manager, office manager, or person responsible for wireless/telecommunications.

* Find business phone numbers and available contact information.

* Prioritize businesses that are likely to have multiple employees, company phones, tablets, hotspots, or fleet vehicles.



2. Cold Calling



* Make outbound B2B calls to business prospects.

* Introduce our telecommunications solutions professionally.

* Quickly identify whether the business is a potential fit.

* Ask discovery questions about their current wireless provider, number of lines, monthly spending, and pain points.

* Handle common objections professionally.

* Generate interest without being overly aggressive.



3. Appointment Setting



* Book qualified appointments directly on the Account Executive’s calendar.

* Confirm the appointment with the prospect.

* Send follow-up messages when appropriate.

* Maintain accurate appointment notes.

* Make sure appointments meet the agreed qualification criteria.



4. Follow-Up



* Follow up with prospects who aren’t ready to speak immediately.

* Re-contact previous leads.

* Maintain a structured follow-up schedule.

* Track conversations and outcomes in the CRM/spreadsheet.



5. Sales Intelligence

The VA should identify opportunities such as:



* Businesses with 5+ employees

* Multiple business phone lines

* Companies with fleet vehicles

* Construction companies

* HVAC companies

* Plumbing companies

* Electrical contractors

* Landscaping companies

* Pest control companies

* Roofing companies

* Delivery/courier companies

* Property management companies

* Medical/dental offices

* Professional-service businesses

* Salons/barbershops

* Other businesses likely to have multiple wireless users



Ideal Candidate



We’re looking for someone who:



* Has B2B cold-calling experience

* Has appointment-setting experience

* Has strong spoken English

* Sounds confident and professional on the phone

* Is comfortable making 50–100+ outbound calls per day

* Can handle rejection without becoming discouraged

* Understands basic sales psychology

* Can identify decision-makers

* Can overcome common objections

* Is organized and detail-oriented

* Can work independently

* Has reliable internet and a quiet workspace

* Is comfortable using Google Sheets/Excel, CRM systems, and communication tools

* Is highly motivated by performance and results



Performance Expectations



Daily targets:



* 50–100+ outbound calls

* 20+ meaningful conversations when possible

* 10–20+ newly researched prospects

* Consistent follow-up on previous prospects

* Accurate CRM/spreadsheet updates



Primary KPI:

Qualified appointments booked



Quality is more important than simply booking appointments. Appointments should ideally be with a business owner or decision-maker who has a legitimate need for business wireless services.



Qualification Questions



The VA should learn to determine:



1. Who is currently providing your business wireless service?

2. Approximately how many business lines do you have?

3. Are those lines company-owned or employee-owned?

4. Roughly how much does the business spend on wireless each month?

5. Are you currently under contract?

6. Are you experiencing any issues with your current provider?

7. Who makes the final decision regarding your wireless service?

8. When would you be open to reviewing another option?



The goal is not to hard-sell on the first call. The goal is to determine whether there is an opportunity and get the qualified prospect onto the Account Executive’s calendar.





If you’ve made it this far and read the role qualifications. Please send a virtual video of introducing yourself and why you are the best fit for this role.

title: Lead Google Workspace & AppSheet Specialist (Data & Systems Architect)
description:
Lead Google Workspace & AppSheet Specialist (Data & Systems Architect)

 Full-Time 

Google AppSheet is required. All dashboard reporting in this role is built in Google AppSheet. Experience with other tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, Glide, does not replace it. If you have not built dashboards in AppSheet, this role is not a fit.



Do you build spreadsheets so solid that other people are afraid to touch them? Do you think in QUERY, LAMBDA, and relational data models? Have you shipped AppSheet dashboards that teams use every day? If so, we want to talk to you.



About Us

Service Conversion is a marketing agency that builds websites and generates leads for home services companies in HVAC, plumbing, and electrical. We manage data and reporting across a growing portfolio of client accounts, and we need someone to own that infrastructure end to end.



The Role

You will be the architect and guardian of our clients' Google Workspace data ecosystems. You will build custom Google Sheets models from scratch, turn business goals into automated KPI scorecards, and build all dashboard reporting in Google AppSheet for mobile and desktop.

Building is only half the job. You will also keep these systems accurate and stable long term by managing permissions, setting data entry standards for the team, and running regular audits so every number holds up.



What You'll Do

Build dashboard reporting in Google AppSheet

• Design, deploy, and manage interactive dashboards and business apps in Google AppSheet, powered by Google Sheets backends

• Configure relational data models, user roles, security filters, custom actions, and automated notifications

• Deliver a smooth, near-real-time experience on mobile and desktop

Build production-grade Google Sheets

• Design complex models from scratch, without templates

• Write and optimize advanced formulas such as LAMBDA, LET, QUERY, FILTER, ARRAYFORMULA, and INDEX/MATCH

• Set up data validation, named ranges, and clean architecture that prevents user error and keeps sheets fast

Turn goals into scorecards

• Translate client objectives into measurable, automated KPIs

• Make sure data flows cleanly from daily operational sheets into executive scorecards and AppSheet dashboards

Own accounts and govern the data

• Take full ownership of client Workspace environments, sheet structures, and system stability

• Write clear data entry guidelines for team members who update sheets

• Put locked ranges, role-based protections, and access controls in place



Audit and maintain

• Audit formulas on daily, weekly, monthly, and annual cycles

• Catch calculation lag, broken dependencies, data drift, and reference errors before they cause problems

• Use Google Apps Script to automate maintenance, triggers, custom functions, and API connections



What You Bring

• Required: proven experience building dashboard reporting in Google AppSheet. You have designed, deployed, and maintained AppSheet dashboards on live Google Sheets backends. Other BI or no-code tools do not count toward this requirement.

• 2+ years building production-grade spreadsheets, financial models, or internal tools from scratch in Google Sheets

• Strong Google Apps Script (JavaScript) skills

• A track record of owning client deliverables, managing multi-user access, and auditing team inputs

• Experience modeling and automating operational metrics into scorecards

• Extreme attention to detail and a clear method for auditing formulas across daily, weekly, monthly, YTD, and YoY horizons



Nice to Have

• Experience connecting Sheets or AppSheet to Make, Zapier, Looker Studio, REST APIs, or databases, in addition to AppSheet, not instead of it

• Experience optimizing large datasets to keep calculations fast and within memory limits



How to Apply

Send your resume with the three work samples below. Applications without working samples will not be considered.

1. Google Sheets models built from scratch. Provide view access or sanitized copies that show advanced formulas and automated scorecard design.

2. An AppSheet dashboard you built. Provide a live link, a functional preview, or a screen recording. It must be built in Google AppSheet on a Google Sheets backend. Samples built in other tools will not be accepted.

3. A short case study. Briefly describe how you managed data inputs, permissions, or formula audits in a multi-user or client environment.

title: Residential HVAC Estimator – Full-Time Remote
description:
Residential HVAC Experience Required



We are an established Canadian residential HVAC company looking for an exceptional Residential HVAC Estimator to join our team in a full-time, permanent remote position.



This is NOT a general Virtual Assistant or administrative position.



We are specifically looking for someone who understands residential HVAC systems, equipment, materials and installation requirements and can take a residential project and break it down into a detailed, organized and accurate estimate.



You will work directly with and report to the CEO.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term position and can become a trusted member of our estimating operation.



WHAT YOU WILL BE ESTIMATING



You must have a strong understanding of residential HVAC installations involving:



Gas furnaces

Central air conditioning

Air-source heat pumps

Ductless mini-split and multi-split systems

Boilers and hydronic heating systems

Radiant in-floor heating

HRV/ERV systems

Residential ductwork

Gas piping

Refrigerant piping and line sets

Venting systems

Pumps, valves and hydronic accessories

Thermostats and HVAC controls

Registers, grilles and diffusers

Installation accessories and miscellaneous materials



Experience with Canadian/North American residential HVAC equipment and installation practices is a major asset.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



This position requires much more than entering prices into a spreadsheet.



You will be expected to review information provided for residential HVAC projects and determine everything required to complete the installation.



Your responsibilities will include:



Reviewing residential drawings, plans, specifications, site information and equipment selections

Completing detailed HVAC material takeoffs

Breaking projects into equipment, material, labour and accessory requirements

Building detailed estimating spreadsheets

Creating and maintaining Excel/Google Sheets estimating templates

Preparing complete bills of materials

Identifying missing components before a quote is completed

Reviewing equipment specifications and installation requirements

Researching model numbers and manufacturer information

Determining required accessories for HVAC equipment

Calculating ductwork quantities

Breaking down sheet-metal requirements and fittings

Estimating gas piping materials

Estimating hydronic piping and accessories

Estimating refrigerant piping and installation accessories

Breaking down boiler and radiant heating systems

Reviewing supplier quotations

Comparing supplier pricing against required materials

Organizing estimates so another person can easily review them

Identifying discrepancies or missing information

Communicating questions BEFORE making assumptions

Continuously improving our estimating spreadsheets and processes

EXAMPLE



If you are given a residential boiler project, we don't simply want:



1 × Boiler



We expect you to understand that the installation may also require pumps, valves, expansion tank, air elimination, piping, fittings, venting, condensate components, controls, electrical components, manifolds and other installation materials.



The same thinking applies to furnaces, heat pumps, air conditioners, HRVs, duct systems, gas piping and radiant heating systems.



You must think like an HVAC estimator.



SPREADSHEET SKILLS ARE EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



A major part of this position will involve building and maintaining detailed estimating spreadsheets.



You must be highly comfortable with:



Microsoft Excel

Google Sheets

Formulas

Organized material databases

Equipment lists

Pricing tables

Cost calculations

Labour calculations

Markups

Structured estimating templates



Your spreadsheets must be clean, organized and understandable by other members of our company.



COMMUNICATION EXPECTATIONS



Communication is extremely important in this position.



Because you will be working remotely, we expect consistent daily communication.



You will be required to:



Check in every working day

Provide updates on assigned projects

Ask questions when information is unclear

Identify problems quickly

Respond to messages during your scheduled working hours

Communicate clearly in written and spoken English

Participate in video/voice meetings when required



We do not want someone who disappears for hours or days while working on an estimate.



If you are unsure about something, we expect you to ask.



WORK REQUIREMENTS



This is a:



FULL-TIME

PERMANENT

REMOTE

DEDICATED POSITION



You must have:



Reliable high-speed internet

Reliable computer capable of handling drawings, PDFs and large spreadsheets

Quiet and professional work environment

Webcam and microphone

Reliable power and backup plan appropriate to your location

Ability to work our agreed working schedule consistently



You will be required to use TimeProof for time tracking during working hours.



Use of TimeProof is mandatory and not optional.



ONE-JOB REQUIREMENT



This position requires your full professional commitment during your scheduled working hours.



You may not hold another full-time job or perform other paid client work during the hours you are scheduled to work for our company.



If you are looking to manage several VA clients simultaneously during the same working hours, this position is not for you.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and to become part of our company.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are only interested in top-level candidates.



The ideal candidate is:



Experienced with RESIDENTIAL HVAC

Highly detail-oriented

Excellent with numbers

Excellent with spreadsheets

Technically minded

Extremely organized

Dependable

Comfortable working independently

Able to research technical information

Able to read drawings and specifications

Able to identify missing information

Comfortable asking questions

Strong at written and spoken English

Consistent with deadlines

Interested in a permanent long-term position



We value accuracy over speed, but expect you to become both accurate and efficient as you learn our systems.



THIS POSITION IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF:

Your experience is primarily general VA/admin work

You have never worked with HVAC estimating

You don't understand residential HVAC equipment

You are primarily a commercial construction estimator without residential HVAC knowledge

You plan to work multiple jobs simultaneously during our scheduled hours

You have unreliable internet

You dislike time-tracking software

You need constant supervision

You routinely make assumptions instead of asking questions

You struggle with Excel or Google Sheets

You do not communicate consistently

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS – READ CAREFULLY



We receive a large number of applications.



Applications that do not follow ALL of the instructions below will not be considered.



When applying, your email subject/title must be:



RESIDENTIAL HVAC ESTIMATOR – BLUE BOILER



At the very bottom of your application, after everything else, write:



“I understand this is residential HVAC estimating, not a general VA position.”



Do not put that sentence at the beginning.



INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING WITH YOUR APPLICATION



Please provide:



Your resume/CV.

A short explanation of your residential HVAC estimating experience.

Which of the following you have personally estimated:



Boilers / Furnaces / AC / Heat Pumps / Ductless / HRV-ERV / Ductwork / Gas Piping / Radiant In-Floor Heating



An example of an estimating spreadsheet you have personally created. You may remove confidential customer/company information.

Your expected hourly or monthly compensation.

Your normal internet download/upload speed.

Your available working hours and time zone.

Confirmation that you are willing to use TimeProof every working day.

Confirmation that you can commit to this as your only job during your scheduled working hours.

TECHNICAL SCREENING QUESTIONS



Please answer these without copying generic definitions from the internet. Short, practical answers are preferred.



Question 1



You are estimating a residential boiler replacement.



Besides the boiler itself, name at least 10 components/material categories you would investigate before considering the material estimate complete.



Question 2



A residential project requires a new forced-air HVAC system.



Explain how you would approach creating a ductwork material takeoff from the mechanical drawings.



Question 3



You are estimating a ductless heat pump installation with one outdoor unit and three indoor heads.



Name the major equipment, materials and accessories you would expect to investigate before completing the estimate.



Question 4



You receive a supplier quote showing the furnace, AC condenser and evaporator coil.



What installation materials or accessories would you check for that may not appear on the equipment quotation?



Question 5



You are reviewing a residential gas piping drawing.



What information do you need before you can properly determine the pipe sizing and material requirements?



Question 6



You discover that the plans and equipment schedule appear to contradict each other.



What do you do?



FINAL ATTENTION-TO-DETAIL QUESTION



Somewhere in your answers to the technical questions above, include the words:



“Accuracy before assumptions.”



Do not explain why you included the phrase.



HIRING PROCESS



Candidates who successfully pass the initial screening may be asked to complete a short paid residential HVAC estimating exercise.



The exercise may include reviewing a simple residential HVAC project and producing part of a material takeoff or estimating spreadsheet.



We care less about fancy resumes and more about whether you can demonstrate that you actually understand residential HVAC estimating.



This is a real, currently available full-time position.



We are looking for someone exceptional who wants a stable, long-term role, communicates consistently and takes ownership of their work.



If you are an experienced Residential HVAC Estimator and believe you can meet these standards, we would like to hear from you.

title: AI Video CREATOR and EDITOR (AI-Generated Ads)
description:
We're looking for an AI Video Creator who can both CREATE videos from scratch using AI tools AND edit/polish them into scroll-stopping social media ads.



This is NOT a traditional video editor role. 



You'll be using tools like Google Flow, Runway, Kling, Sora, and similar AI video platforms to generate video content from prompts — then cut, refine, and deliver finished ad creatives ready for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.



We expect full autonomy. That means you research ad angles, write scripts (using AI is fine and encouraged), generate AI voiceovers, source B-roll, and deliver a finished video — not wait for someone to hand you a script and footage.



What you'll do every day:

• Generate AI video clips using tools like Google Flow (Veo), Runway, Kling, or Sora based on creative briefs or your own research

• Edit and assemble AI-generated footage into polished ad creatives (hooks, body, CTAs)

• Produce multiple format variations per ad (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) for different placements

• Research competitor ads and winning angles — then create your own versions with a unique spin

• Write or generate scripts using AI copywriting tools

• Generate AI voiceovers using tools like ElevenLabs

• Deliver a set number of finished videos per week (we'll agree on volume targets together)

• Maintain visual consistency and brand guidelines across all creatives



How we hire (please read carefully):

We hire 5–8 candidates at the same time for this role. Everyone receives the same test task: you'll get a reference video (either one of our winners or a competitor ad), and we'll ask you to create your own version from scratch using AI tools.

We grade you on:

1. Turnaround time — how fast you deliver after receiving the task

2. How well you follow instructions

3. How much creative thinking you bring — we do NOT want a 1:1 copy, we want your own spin on it

4. Overall quality and polish of the final video



The top performers stay on the team. This isn't meant to be unfair — it's meant to find the best people fast and give everyone a real shot based on their actual work, not just their resume.



Requirements:

• Hands-on experience with at least one AI video generation tool (Google Flow, Runway, Kling, Sora, Pika, or similar)

• Solid video editing skills (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar)

• Understanding of what makes a social media ad work — pacing, hooks, storytelling in short format

• Self-starter mindset — you don't wait for instructions, you bring ideas

• Strong English communication

• Reliable internet and available for full-time hours (flexible schedule)



Bonus points:

• Experience with AI image generation (Midjourney, DALL-E)

• Motion graphics / After Effects skills

• Experience creating ads for Meta, TikTok, or YouTube

• Understanding of ad performance metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR)



⚠️ HOW TO APPLY — IMPORTANT:

Do NOT apply with just a resume. Your application MUST include:



1. A link to 2–3 AI-generated video examples you've created (Google Drive, YouTube, Vimeo, or portfolio link). We want to see videos where you used AI tools to generate the footage — not just traditional edits. Bonus if you can show both short-form ad style AND longer YouTube-style videos.



2. A short message (3–5 sentences) telling us which AI video tools you've used and what your workflow looks like.

Applications without AI video examples will not be considered.

title: UGC Video Editor
description:
## UGC Video Editor – Fast, Creative & TikTok-Savvy



I’m looking for a **creative, fast, and reliable UGC video editor** to help edit short-form content for **TikTok, TikTok Shop, Instagram Reels, and other social platforms**.



I create a high volume of UGC and product-focused content, so I need someone who understands that great short-form editing isn’t just about making a video look good — it’s about **grabbing attention quickly, keeping viewers watching, and making the content feel natural and native to social media.**



### What I’m Looking For



You should be able to:



* Edit **15–60 second vertical UGC videos**

* Create strong, attention-grabbing openings within the **first 1–3 seconds**

* Add engaging captions, text overlays, transitions, zooms, cuts, B-roll, sound effects, and other pattern interrupts when appropriate

* Understand **TikTok/TikTok Shop pacing and editing styles**

* Turn raw footage into polished content that still feels **authentic and not overly produced**

* Edit product demonstrations, testimonials, storytelling videos, GRWM-style content, car chats, lifestyle videos, and direct-response product videos

* Follow a script or creative brief while also bringing **your own creative ideas**

* Understand hooks, mid-video re-hooks, retention editing, CTAs, urgency, and natural product placement

* Keep videos formatted correctly for **9:16 vertical content**

* Deliver clean, organized files without unnecessary back-and-forth



### FAST TURNAROUND IS IMPORTANT



I’m specifically looking for someone who can work quickly.



Ideally, I would like most edits returned within **24–48 hours**, depending on the project and number of videos.



There will be opportunities for **consistent ongoing work** for the right editor. I’m looking for someone I can build a workflow with—not just someone for a single project.



### You’re Probably a Great Fit If…



You’re creative enough to take basic footage and think:



**“How can I make someone stop scrolling and keep watching this?”**



You stay current with TikTok and Reels editing trends, understand what UGC should feel like, communicate well, meet deadlines, and don’t need every single cut spelled out for you.



I LOVE an editor who can take direction but also say, **“I have an idea that could make this video better.”**



### When Applying



Please send:



1. Examples of UGC, TikTok, TikTok Shop, or Reels you've edited

2. Your typical turnaround time

3. Your rate per video or package rate

4. What editing software you use

5. How many short-form videos you can realistically edit per week



**BONUS:** If you have experience editing **high-converting TikTok Shop/product videos**, please specifically point those examples out.



I’m looking for someone who is **creative, dependable, fast, understands social media, and wants consistent work.**

title: Amazon & Marketplace Manager
description:
Amazon, Mirakl & Marketplace Manager



We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Amazon & Marketplace Manager to oversee and grow our presence across Amazon and other online marketplaces. This role is responsible for managing marketplace operations, optimizing product listings, driving sales performance, and ensuring an exceptional customer experience while maximizing profitability. Australian based and local hours joining a growing business unit and team.



Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute marketplace strategies to drive revenue growth across Amazon and other eCommerce platforms.

Manage the day-to-day operations of Amazon Seller Central/Vendor Central and other marketplace accounts.

Create, optimize, and maintain product listings, including titles, descriptions, keywords, images, and enhanced content to improve visibility and conversion rates.

Monitor sales performance, inventory levels, pricing, and product availability to ensure optimal marketplace performance.

Plan and manage promotional campaigns, deals, coupons, and advertising (Amazon PPC and other marketplace advertising platforms).

Analyze sales data, market trends, competitor activity, and customer insights to identify growth opportunities and improve performance.

Collaborate with marketing, supply chain, customer service, and product teams to ensure seamless marketplace operations.

Manage inventory forecasting and coordinate replenishment to minimize stock shortages and excess inventory.

Ensure compliance with marketplace policies, performance metrics, and account health requirements.

Generate regular reports on sales, profitability, advertising performance, and key performance indicators (KPIs), providing actionable recommendations for continuous improvement.

Skills & Qualifications

Proven experience managing Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central accounts.

Strong understanding of eCommerce marketplaces, including Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, eBay, and other relevant platforms.

Experience with Amazon PPC, SEO, and listing optimization.

Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Excel and marketplace reporting tools.

Knowledge of inventory management, pricing strategies, and marketplace compliance.

Excellent communication, organizational, and project management skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, eCommerce, or a related field (preferred).

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Marketplace sales and revenue growth.

Advertising return on ad spend (ROAS) and ACOS performance.

Listing quality and conversion rate improvements.

Inventory health and stock availability.

Account health and marketplace compliance metrics.

Customer satisfaction and seller performance ratings.

What We’re Looking For:

Proven experience managing Shopify and multi-channel marketplaces.

Strong knowledge of e-commerce tools, integrations, and analytics.

Experience with Amazon Seller Central, Etsy Seller, and similar platforms.

Hands-on problem solver who can execute strategies end-to-end.

Strong project management, communication, and leadership skills.



Why Join Us:

Lead and grow the company’s fast scale e-commerce presence.

Work in a supportive team with a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.



You must have degree qualification and minimum 3 years in similar role to be considered.

RESPONSIBILITIES

, and other social platforms

30% RECURRING COMMISSION on every new paying member you personally generate.



Our membership is currently $125/month, so a successful referral earns you $37.50 per month for as long as that member remains subscribed.



For example:

• 5 active referrals = $187.50/month

There is no fixed hourly rate or required number of hours. You can determine how much time you want to dedicate based on your own schedule, with the focus being on quality prospects, genuine conversations, and successful conversions.

I’m looking for someone interested in building a long-term opportunity, not someone simply looking for a short-term task.



If you are good at finding people, starting conversations, building relationships, and turning qualified prospects into customers, there is significant room to grow with this opportunity.



The more successful members you generate, the more your recurring commission can build over time.



HOW TO APPLY

3. Approximately how many leads or conversations were you responsible for per day?
