The Mission



We operate a Young Adult Mentoring Network built around online mentoring, learning marketing, AI and tech, adventure meet-ups and travel experiences.



Our non-profit volunteers guide young adults through transformative journeys that combine mentorship, personal development, real-world skills and adventure.



Our programs connect mentees with mentors, organize adventure-based learning experiences, manage family and community engagement, and track personal growth outcomes, all while scaling to serve more young people across multiple regions.



You'll work directly with the directors with maximum autonomy (we run on Holacracy principles). Execute with creativity, master our processes, and after proving your value and fast learning capabilities you'll be promoted to SMM Team Leader, building and recruiting your own team (with increased salary for increased responsibility).

- Build automated content distribution, engagement tracking, and follower growth systems across platforms



The goal: Build and maintain our social media marketing system as a top-of-funnel for reliable, measurable and effective client acquisition.



As you help build these systems, you'll ensure all processes are well-documented.

You're not looking for a job where you wait for instructions. You're proactive, analyse the situation in front of you, and suggest various possible paths forward.



Skills and Aptitudes



You're looking for a role where you:



- Own the problem, not just the task

- Flexible PTO policy, Paid Time Off (discussed at hire)



How to Apply

1. One specific social media marketing success you've had, or list the social media tools you regularly use and what you've done with them

2. Your availability - when can you start the trial tasks?

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)

This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



If you have never worked a graveyard shift before, think carefully before applying. We will ask you specifically how you plan to structure your sleep, and how you'll make the schedule work alongside your family or partner. "I'll figure it out" is not an answer that gets you hired. This shift is sustainable for people who plan for it and difficult for people who don't.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 15-minute pre-screen async interview

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



A NOTE ON TIMING



We hire for this role on a rolling basis and are always reviewing applications, so the timeline varies. Sometimes we're interviewing within a week of your application. Sometimes a seat opens a month or two later. If you're a strong fit, we'll keep you in our pipeline and reach out when there's an opening.



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A screenshot of your typing test results (
)

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit

- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren



---



Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | Pacific Time (Graveyard Shift in PH)

Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 15-minute pre-screen async interview

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



A NOTE ON TIMING



We hire for this role on a rolling basis and are always reviewing applications, so the timeline varies. Sometimes we're interviewing within a week of your application. Sometimes a seat opens a month or two later. If you're a strong fit, we'll keep you in our pipeline and reach out when there's an opening.



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A screenshot of your typing test results (
)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit

- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren

title: B2B Sales & Customer Relationship Specialist
description:
About CoolHed



CoolHed Pty Ltd is an Australian company focused on innovative cooling solutions for heat stress management, recovery, performance, and wellbeing.



We are expanding across Australia and launching into the United States, and we're looking for a motivated sales professional to join our growing team.



About the Role



We're looking for a B2B Sales & Customer Relationship Specialist to help grow CoolHed through lead generation, outreach, follow-ups, and relationship building.



You will be responsible for following up with our existing leads, identifying new business opportunities, speaking with potential customers, and helping turn conversations into sales.



You will work closely with the CEO and COO and play an important role in our expansion into the US and other markets.



Key Responsibilities

Follow up with existing and new B2B leads through email, phone, LinkedIn, and other platforms.

Generate new leads and identify potential customers and business opportunities.

Conduct outbound sales outreach to companies and decision-makers.

Build and maintain strong customer relationships.

Understand customer needs and explain how CoolHed can help.

Handle customer questions and objections professionally.

Schedule meetings and product demonstrations.

Follow up consistently with prospects throughout the sales process.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records.

Track conversations, opportunities, and next steps.

Support sales campaigns and conference/event follow-up.

Assist the CEO and COO with sales-related research and business development activities.

Provide ongoing customer support and help develop long-term relationships.

What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is:



Confident communicating with customers and businesses.

Comfortable making outbound calls and sending sales emails.

Friendly, professional, and personable.

Persistent and comfortable with follow-up.

Organized and able to manage multiple leads.

Motivated by achieving results.

Comfortable working independently.

Willing to learn about our products and sales process.

Comfortable using CRM systems, Google Workspace, LinkedIn, and other online tools.



Previous experience in B2B sales, customer service, lead generation, business development, or account management is preferred, but we are also open to candidates who have strong communication skills and the right attitude.



Experience in healthcare, wellness, medical devices, construction, mining, sports, or workplace safety is an advantage but not required.



What You'll Be Selling



CoolHed's products are designed to provide portable, reusable cooling solutions for a range of applications, including:



Workplace heat stress

Construction and mining

Healthcare and wellness

Sports and athletic recovery

Corporate wellbeing

Outdoor workers

Events and organizations

What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means consistently creating new conversations, following up with leads, building relationships, and converting qualified opportunities into sales.



You will be expected to:



Actively work through assigned leads.

Generate new qualified prospects.

Maintain consistent follow-up.

Build a healthy sales pipeline.

Convert opportunities into orders.

Keep CRM information accurate.

Provide a professional customer experience.

What We Offer

Full-time remote position.

Opportunity to work with an Australian company expanding internationally.

Direct exposure to the CEO and COO.

Opportunity to work on the US market launch.

Supportive and collaborative team environment.

Long-term growth opportunities based on performance.

Performance incentives and sales commissions.



If you're confident, motivated, enjoy talking to people, and want to be part of a growing company expanding into international markets, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Creative Strategist for 7-Figure Brand| Up to $15/hr
description:
We're a fast-growing lingerie e-commerce brand and we're looking for an experienced Creative Strategist who owns our weekly static ad output from idea to editor-ready brief.



This is a pure strategy role. You do the thinking, our in-house editing team does the making. You will never touch Photoshop or Premiere.



What you'll own



The weekly static creative pipeline: new angles, hooks, and concepts every week

Editor-ready briefs: reference images, hook copy, text overlay, layout direction, so clear that our editors can execute without follow-up questions

Creative research: winning ads from competitors, trends in Meta Ad Library and ad spy tools, customer language from reviews and communities

Testing structure: which concepts we test, what we learn from results, and what that means for next week's batch

Reading performance data with our media buyer and turning it into sharper creative decisions



What we expect from you



2+ years as a Creative Strategist for e-commerce brands running paid social at scale

You've produced high weekly volumes of static concepts before (10-15+ briefs per week is normal for you)

Deep understanding of direct response: hooks, angles, customer avatars, ad psychology

You work from data, not just taste: you can explain why an ad won

Experience with lingerie, fashion, or beauty brands is a strong plus; you know how to sell desire and confidence while staying within Meta's ad policies

Excellent written English, your briefs are the product



What you get



$6 to $15 per hour, based on your experience and the quality of your work. Proven senior strategists with strong direct-response results start on the higher end, and rates grow as the brand scales

part-time or Full-time, long-term role with a scaling brand

Clear testing frameworks, fast feedback loops, and real influence on results

Room to grow into a senior creative role as we scale



How to apply

3 static ads you developed the strategy or brief for, with one or two lines per ad: what was the angle, and how did it perform?

title: AI-Native Video Editor (Meta Ads / Facebook Ads / Instagram Ads)
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing Shopify direct-to-consumer (DTC) brand, Flux Sleep, and we are looking for a highly capable, sharp, and proactive AI-Native Video Editor. This role is strictly focused on creating high-converting video ads for
 and Instagram.



You will take raw footage, product assets, and concepts, and turn them into scroll-stopping video ads. If you are someone who waits to be told exactly what to do every morning, this is not the role for you. We need a modern, conversion-focused editor who understands the anatomy of a winning Meta ad and naturally incorporates AI tools into their workflow to work faster and produce better creative assets.



Core Responsibilities

- Direct Response Video Editing: Edit, format, and export fast-paced, highly engaging video ads optimized specifically for
 and Instagram feeds, Reels, and Stories.

- AI Workflow Integration: Utilize cutting-edge AI tools (such as ElevenLabs for voiceovers, Seedance/Kling for asset generation, Runway/Pika for b-roll, or advanced AI captioning tools) to enhance ad quality and speed up production time.

- Hook & Angle Testing: Relentlessly focus on the first 3 seconds of the video. You will cut multiple hook variations for every core video concept to help us systematically test and scale what works.

- Creative Iteration: Take our current "winning" ads and find ways to iterate on them—swapping b-roll, changing text overlays, or adjusting pacing to combat ad fatigue and improve click-through rates (CTR) and return on ad spend (ROAS).

- Asset Management: Keep project files, raw footage, and final exports highly organized and easily accessible for the broader marketing team.



Required Qualifications & Skills

- Meta Ad Editing is Mandatory: You must have a deep understanding of direct response marketing on Meta. You know how to pace an ad, use engaging text overlays, design pattern-interrupting hooks, and drive viewers to a clear call-to-action.

- AI Tool Experience is Mandatory: You are not just a traditional video editor; you are an "AI-native" creator. You must be comfortable using AI platforms to generate voiceovers, source/create dynamic b-roll, and streamline your editing process.

- Video Portfolio Required: A proven track record of editing profitable e-commerce video ads. We want to see your actual direct response work, not cinematic short films or wedding videos.

- Software Proficiency: Expert in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut, CapCut PC, or similar, alongside your AI tool stack.

- Proactive Attitude: You naturally spot trends on TikTok/IG Reels and bring new visual hooks, audio trends, and campaign ideas to the table without being asked.

- Reliable Setup: High-speed internet connection (with a backup plan) and a reliable computer capable of handling 4K video editing and rendering smoothly.



Nice-to-Haves (Not Mandatory)

- Creative Strategist Experience: The ability to research competitors, write high-converting video ad scripts, and conceptualize entirely new marketing angles from scratch.

- Prior experience working with sleep-tech, premium home goods, or specific water-based cooling products.



How to Apply

If you are sharp, highly creative, and ready to take full ownership of our video ad pipeline, please reply with:

A link to your video editing portfolio showcasing past e-commerce Meta/IG ads.

A brief introduction explaining your current AI tool stack (e.g., which AI tools you use daily and how they speed up your workflow).

A brief summary of your experience with direct response ad editing.

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
OPERATIONS COORDINATOR



Salary: $6 per hour

Hours: 20 a week.

Type: Part-time, permanent, remote.

Start: 2 October 2026

Applications close: 25 September 2026



ABOUT THE ROLE



Our client is a UK property investment business. They buy residential and commercial property to refurbish and sell, or to rent and hold, sourcing deals through direct mail, leaflet drops, estate agent relationships and auctions.



This is an Operations Coordinator role, working directly with the founder. You are the person things get handed to when they need to happen and nobody wants to think about them again. You sit between contractors, estate agents, managing agents, tenants, suppliers, the accountant and the bookkeeper. You chase, you coordinate, you d
 where you can, and you escalate with a recommendation when you cannot.



This is a phone-first job. Several calls a day, in both directions, to people you have not met. If you prefer quiet written work, this is not the right role for you.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



- Owning leaflet distribution campaigns end to end: researching and shortlisting distributors town by town, getting like-for-like quotes, negotiating rather than accepting first prices, holding the print spec, booking drops across several towns at once, confirming the drops happened 

- Building a comparison table each procurement round covering distributor, distribution type, tracking, turnaround and rates

- Calling estate agents about properties of interest: establishing the vendor's situation, their bottom line for a fast cash completion, and whether other offers are in play

- Running a monthly follow-up cadence on stalled and rejected offers by phone, WhatsApp and
, logged every time

- Taking inbound vendor calls, fact-finding properly and writing clean notes into the tracker

- Acting as day-to-day contact for contractors and trades: taking a works list from a managing agent, briefing the right contractor, chasing to completion and reporting back closed

- Keeping the lead tracker and weekly activity log current, and suppressing responders from further mailings

- Writing a short Friday report with the numbers behind it, and an SOP for every process the first time you run it



As hours grow, the role extends into refurbishment admin, finance coordination with the accountant and bookkeeper, and tenant communications.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Excellent spoken English, C1 or C2. You will be understood by older vendors and by tradespeople on poor phone lines, in natural back-and-forth, not from a script

- Written English that shifts register properly between a tenant
 and a quick WhatsApp update

- Genuine phone confidence, including chasing and awkward conversations

- Proven follow-through. When something stalls, you move it without being reminded

- The judgement to act on an incomplete instruction and come back with a position, not a question

- Ability to hold several parallel workstreams without dropping any

- Stable internet and a real contingency for power cuts and storms. 



Useful: UK property, lettings, construction or facilities work, refurbishment coordination, procurement or direct mail, bookkeeping exposure.



THE PRACTICAL DETAILS



Remote, Philippines-based. 20 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 13:00 UK time. That is a late-afternoon shift in Manila, shifting by an hour when the UK clocks change in late October. UK hours are the fixed reference.



Start date: 30 September 2026. The role is designed to grow to full-time, reviewed at three months. Paid holiday, personal days and a clear time off policy apply.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply at 



It takes about twenty minutes. Please do not send a generic cover letter: we read for specifics, what you actually did, what it cost, what you would do differently.

When you write about your experience on the form, include the reference code somewhere in your answer. Applications that do not will not be read. The reference code is REV-OP.

* Strong computer skills and extremely comfortable navigating websites, software, and online tools, with basic to intermediate familiarity with gaming and gaming platforms (PC and/or console).

* Able to troubleshoot problems independently and figure out solutions quickly.

* No other jobs or freelance commitments.



About the Job

Send an
 to 
 with answers to the following.

Only apply if you meet ALL the requirements above. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

title: All-Around Digital Operations & Marketing Specialist
description:
Experience Required: Minimum 4 years



About the Role

We are looking for a versatile, creative, and tech-savvy Digital Operations & Marketing Specialist to join our team. You are a rare hybrid: someone who has an eye for clean, engaging design, loves the logic behind backend systems, workflows, and conversion funnels, and knows how to leverage modern AI tools to supercharge efficiency and output.



If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where you can juggle creative assets, technical automations, and AI-driven workflows seamlessly, we want to hear from you!



Key Responsibilities

AI Integration & Tool Utilization: Leverage advanced AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, or workflow-specific AI agents) to streamline content creation, copywriting, data processing, and operational workflows.



Funnel Building: Design, build, and optimize high-converting landing pages and sales funnels from scratch.



Marketing Automation: Set up, manage, and troubleshoot automation workflows,
 sequences, and CRM integrations to ensure smooth lead management.



Graphics & Creative Content: Create eye-catching marketing collateral, social media graphics, ad creatives, and lead magnets that align with brand guidelines.



Social Media Management: Assist with basic social media scheduling, content planning, and community management to maintain an active online presence.



Process Optimization: Continuously test and improve funnel performance, troubleshoot technical bottlenecks, and streamline day-to-day digital operations using tech and AI.



Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: At least 4 years of proven experience in digital marketing, funnel building, or marketing operations.



AI Proficiency: Demonstrated capability and hands-on experience using generative AI tools and AI-powered assistants to boost productivity and marketing output.



Design Skills: Strong portfolio showcasing proficiency in graphic design tools (e.g., Canva, Figma, or Adobe Creative Suite) and AI image/content generation.



Technical Know-How: Hands-on experience building funnels and setting up automations using platforms like ActiveCampaign, Make/Zapier, HighLevel, ManyChat, or similar tools.



Social Media Savvy: Familiarity with major social media platforms, content calendars, and best practices.



Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities, close attention to detail, strong time management, and the ability to work independently.



Work Flexibility: 100% remote work setup.



Growth Opportunity: Room to expand your role and responsibilities as the business grows.



Send your application to George at 
 with the Subject Line: All-Around Digital Operations & Marketing Specialist

title: Transaction & Disposition Coordinator
description:
About the Opportunity

We are a stable and growing land investment company with an established system, consistent deal flow, and a strong team culture.

We are looking for someone to manage real estate transactions from contract through closing and help market and sell our land inventory. This is a key position combining transaction coordination, property research, organization, problem-solving, and buyer communication.

You will receive structured training, clear SOPs, ongoing coaching, and access to the tools needed to perform your job successfully. This is an opportunity to build valuable experience in real estate transactions, due diligence, land investing, and property sales while growing with an established company.



Why Work With Us?

Training and Support

You will receive onboarding, SOPs, deal walkthroughs, and ongoing coaching. We will teach you our systems and processes rather than expecting you to figure everything out alone.

Stable and Established Company

We are not a new startup experimenting with a business model. We have an established operation, consistent deal flow, and a proven process.

Career Growth

You will gain hands-on experience with real estate closings, title work, due diligence, property marketing, buyer communication, and land investing.

Strong Team Culture

We value honesty, accountability, respectful communication, continuous improvement, and team members who take responsibility for their work.

Base Pay Plus Commission

You will receive reliable base pay plus commission on closed property sales. Your earning potential grows as your performance and our deal volume grow.



Key Responsibilities

• Manage acquisition and disposition transactions from contract through closing

• Review contracts and documents for accuracy and completeness

• Track deadlines, title work, payments, contingencies, and closing progress

• Research zoning, taxes, legal access, utilities, county requirements, liens, and other property issues

• Communicate with title companies, attorneys, county offices, sellers, buyers, and vendors

• Coordinate services such as surveys, perc tests, inspections, and other property-related work

• Create and manage property listings across online marketplaces

• Respond to prospective buyers by phone, text, and

• Follow up with buyer leads and help move them toward a purchase

• Maintain accurate transaction records and CRM updates

• Identify problems early and help find practical solutions

• Manage multiple active transactions without allowing important details or deadlines to be missed



What This Role Requires

This position involves detailed work, multiple deadlines, frequent follow-up, and unexpected transaction issues. You must be able to work carefully, learn quickly, stay organized, and remain calm when problems arise.

You should also be comfortable taking ownership of your responsibilities and determining the next step without needing constant direction.



Qualifications

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Confident, clear, and professional communication on the phone

• Comfortable speaking with prospective buyers and following up consistently

• Strong organizational and time-management skills

• Ability to manage multiple active transactions and deadlines

• Ability to research unfamiliar issues and think through possible solutions

• Comfortable receiving coaching and applying feedback

• Reliable and able to work independently in a remote environment

• Experience using CRMs, spreadsheets,
, and online research tools

Experience in real estate transactions, title work, land investing, property management, sales, customer service, or administrative coordination is preferred.

Sales experience is a plus because part of the role involves communicating with prospective land buyers. You do not need to be an aggressive salesperson, but you must be comfortable asking questions, following up, handling basic objections, and helping buyers move forward.

Compensation

Base Pay + Commission

You will receive base pay for stability plus commission on closed property sales. The more successful sales you help complete, the more you can earn.

How to Apply

We do things a little differently here — and that starts with how we hire. We would like to receive your Resume but also want to get a real sense of who you are before we ever get on a call. Please send the video recording with Google Drive or Loom Video Link

📹 Required: Resume and 2-Minute Video Application 

Record a short 2-minute video, Start with Today's Date and tell us:

• Who you are and what your background looks like

• Why are you interested in this specific position?

• Tell us about a time you had to manage several important tasks or deadlines at once.

Keep your video natural. We are not looking for a rehearsed or highly polished presentation. We want to understand how you communicate, organize your thoughts, and approach problems.



Applications without a resume and video will not be considered.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Philippines



We are an Australian/NZ natural telehealth business looking for a hands-on End-to-End Performance Marketing Manager to own our customer acquisition and conversion system.



This is not primarily a branding, social media or organic content role. We need an operator who understands the entire performance marketing journey — paid traffic, offers, hooks and creative, landing pages, tracking, CRM automation, purchase, nurture and conversion — and can bring it together into a measurable, profitable funnel.



You will have support from Meta, Google, creative, content and GoHighLevel specialists, but you will own the overall system and its performance.



Your First Project



Build and launch a direct-to-consumer health testing funnel:

Meta/Google → Landing Page → Purchase → Test → Results → Consultation → Further Services



You will own:

Funnel strategy and customer journey

Offers, hooks, messaging and conversion copy

Landing and sales page optimisation

GoHighLevel workflows and automation

Checkout and abandoned-cart follow-up

/SMS nurture and post-purchase journeys

Meta/Google campaign oversight

GA4, GTM, Pixel/CAPI, UTMs and attribution

Reporting and funnel performance

Coordination of paid media, creative and technical specialists

Conversion testing and optimisation

What You Need



Strong practical experience with:



GoHighLevel

Meta Ads and Google Ads

Performance creative, hooks and copy

GA4 and Google Tag Manager

Meta Pixel/CAPI and conversion tracking

Landing page/conversion optimisation

/SMS automation

Online checkout funnels

A/B testing and reporting dashboards



Experience with WordPress, Make/Zapier/API integrations, direct-response marketing, eCommerce, health/wellness/coaching or high-ticket funnels is highly desirable.



You don't need to personally execute every campaign or build every asset, but you must understand each part well enough to manage specialists, challenge decisions and diagnose what isn't working.



You Must Understand the Numbers

You should be comfortable analysing CAC, ROAS, CTR, CPC, landing-page conversion, checkout abandonment, funnel conversion and revenue by channel.



You should be able to look at a funnel and answer: Where are we losing customers, why, and what should we test next?



About You



You are proactive, commercially minded and technically capable. You take ownership, move quickly, communicate clearly, troubleshoot independently and can take an idea through to a functioning, measurable acquisition funnel.



You understand how to market health products, services and coaching directly to consumers. You know what strong direct-response creative and copy looks and feels like, and what makes an offer convert.



You love data. You know how to interpret it, identify what isn't working and make commercially sound decisions about what to test or change next.



To Apply



Please send:

A 2-minute Loom walking us through one funnel and its numbers and what you think your experience could bring to our clinic.

One funnel you personally helped build from ad click to purchase — including product price, traffic source, your role, approximate CAC and conversion rate.

Your experience with Meta, Google, GoHighLevel, wordpress, paid acquisition, tracking and automation.

One example of a change you made that improved funnel performance.

Responsibilities



You will manage projects, priorities, deadlines, owners, and next steps, follow up with team members and freelancers, identify stalled tasks and help move them forward, provide clear progress updates, create Fiverr job postings, review and shortlist applicants, coordinate interviews, paid tests, and onboarding, research tools and solutions, maintain organized documentation, create basic SOPs, perform quality-control checks, use AI for research and problem-solving, and handle occasional administrative tasks.



Projects may include websites, landing pages, marketing, AI, automation, communities, social media, content, design, video, and lead generation.



How We Work



Be settled in, connected, and ready before meetings begin. Take ownership of tasks through completion, communicate progress without waiting to be asked, raise problems early, and do not disappear when something becomes difficult or unclear.



Before asking a question, research the issue and make reasonable progress. When you need help, explain what you tried, what you found, and what you recommend doing next.



Follow through on commitments, confirm when work is complete, identify the next action when something is stalled, and own and correct mistakes quickly.



We do not expect perfection. We do expect communication, progress, accountability, and follow-through.



What We're Looking For



Strong written English, excellent organization, reliable internet, attention to detail, consistent communication, comfort managing multiple priorities, ability to work independently, resourceful problem-solving, willingness to learn, and comfort using AI tools.



Experience with project management, Fiverr, Upwork, ClickUp, Trello, Asana, 
, GoHighLevel, Canva, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, digital marketing, hiring, websites, or funnels is helpful but not required.

Working Relationship

title: Social Media Manager & Content Designer
description:
JJW Studio + Carat Content | Remote | Ad Hoc /Freelance to Begin



We’re looking for a smart, organised and creatively minded Social Media Manager & Content Designer to support the ongoing social presence of two Australian creative agencies: JJW Studio and Carat Content.



JJW Studio works across content, video and social for brands in areas including healthcare, wellness, beauty and lifestyle.

Carat Content is our specialist jewellery content and marketing agency, working with jewellery retailers, wholesalers and luxury brands across strategy, photography, video, content and social.



This will begin as an ad-hoc freelance role, with the opportunity to grow as our content output and client base develops.



We already have an in-house video editor, so we are not looking for someone whose main skill is video editing. We need someone who can think strategically about social media, organise content across multiple platforms, write and adapt copy, create strong static content when needed, and make sure our channels are consistently moving forward.



What you’ll be helping with:

- Planning and managing content across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube and YouTube Shorts

- Scheduling and publishing content through Planable

- Turning larger content ideas into platform-appropriate posts across multiple channels

- Working with our Creative Director, strategist and in-house video editor to coordinate upcoming content

- Writing and refining captions, post copy, hooks, titles and supporting social copy

- Creating simple but polished static posts, carousels, graphics and social assets

- Creating or assisting with YouTube thumbnails

- Organising content calendars and keeping publishing schedules on track

- Preparing posts for review and approval before publishing

- Identifying opportunities to repurpose existing photography, video and long-form content

- Researching jewellery, fashion, beauty, lifestyle and wider social trends without simply copying what everyone else is doing

- Reviewing channel performance and helping us understand what we should create more of, less of or differently

- Helping maintain consistency in tone, visual quality and positioning across both brands



The person we’re looking for...



You should be someone who thinks before they post.



We are not looking for someone whose social strategy is simply following trends, posting every day or chasing views.



For Carat Content especially, our approach is strategy-led. We want content that helps demonstrate expertise, build trust, show our work and make the right jewellery businesses more likely to remember us when they need support. That means understanding why a piece of content exists, not just filling a content calendar. This reflects Carat Content’s broader principle that content should have a clear role and that quality matters more than volume.



You’ll ideally have:

- Previous experience managing social media for a creative agency, fashion, jewellery, beauty, luxury, lifestyle or consumer brand

- Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube

- Excellent written English and the ability to adjust tone between platforms

- Strong visual taste and attention to detail

- Confidence creating polished social assets in Canva, Adobe or similar

- Experience using social scheduling or approval platforms. Planable experience is a bonus

- An understanding of how a single idea can become a Reel, LinkedIn post, carousel, Short or YouTube asset without everything feeling duplicated

- The ability to work independently and bring ideas to us rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions

- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage content deadlines

- An interest in jewellery, fashion, beauty, luxury and contemporary brand marketing



This probably isn’t the role for you if…



You mainly want to edit videos all day.

You rely heavily on generic Canva templates.

Your approach to social media is “post more often”.

You need every post and idea completely briefed before you can begin.

Or you have no interest in understanding the brand, customer or commercial reason behind the content.



We care much more about good judgement, taste and strategic thinking than producing huge volumes of content.



About how we work:

We’re a small Australian team and work collaboratively across strategy, production, editing and social.



Our creative work is customised to each brand, but we like the process behind it to be organised and reliable.



For Carat Content in particular, we work exclusively within the jewellery industry and want our own social presence to demonstrate genuine knowledge of jewellery marketing rather than looking like another generic creative agency. The brand itself is positioned around strategy-led content, specialist jewellery knowledge, clear thinking and commercially useful creative work.



To apply...



Please send us:

1. A short introduction about yourself and your current freelance/work situation.

2. Examples of social accounts you have personally managed and what you were responsible for.

3. Examples of static posts, carousels or social graphics you have designed.

4. Tell us about one brand you think is doing particularly strong social media right now and why.

5. Tell us about your experience with Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn and YouTube.

6. Let us know whether you have used Planable or a similar scheduling platform.

7. Your preferred hourly rate in USD.

8. Your current weekly availability.



Please don’t send a generic AI-generated application. We’d much rather read a short, thoughtful response that gives us a sense of how you think.

title: Short Form Video Editor | Long-Term, $1000-1300 /month
description:
Please read the whole post, before you apply.



We're Dreaver. We're a lifestyle brand, that currently sells treadmills and other fitness equipment for the home, direct to people who want to move more without a gym membership or the pressure from booking a class. We run ads in the Netherlands, Denmark and Sweden — more markets can follow. Creative is the lever that moves the needle for us, and we are looking for a loyal editor to own our video output long-term.



This is direct-response editing, not video production. If your scope is weddings, corporate or long-form YouTube, we won't be a good client for you.



What you'd be doing

Cutting UGC, founder footage and mash-ups into Meta ads, 9:16 and 4:5. Hook variants tested against each other. Editing to AI voiceover with clean sync and pacing. Occasionally an AI b-roll or AI UGC shot from Higgsfield, made to not look like AI. Captions, pattern interrupts, retention pacing, end cards. Re-cutting winners into new angles instead of starting from zero.



Multiple markets | NL, DK, SE, ...

Native translators on the team handle scripting and copy per market, you don't need to write or speak Danish or Swedish. But editing is a different skill from translating. You need enough sense of those languages to catch when a caption runs too long, a hook doesn't land the same way it does in English, or a cut point falls wrong against the sentence. If you can only judge pacing and hooks in English, this role isn't for you. A creative sense for scripting and concepting, someone who can push back on a script or suggest a better opening, is a big plus.



How we work

This is how we work:

Ownership matters, you don't wait for a brief to fix what you can already see.

Speed. We'd rather test fast than think long. We learn by doing and improve as we go.

Proactive. You don't wait around. You spot opportunities, flag problems, and act.

Fix > perfect. See something that could be better? Fix it. Perfection isn't the requirement, progress is.



Tools

Premiere Pro or CapCut, non-negotiable. Comfortable with Higgsfield and ElevenLabs for the occasional AI shot and voice-overs. We're not hiring an AI specialist, just someone who won't freeze the first time AI footage lands in their timeline. When working together, we pay for all AI subscriptions, on our accounts.



What we offer

- Full-time

- $
per month, depending on level

- Perform well and you grow with us. More scope, better pay.

- Work when you work best. No fixed hours, just deadlines and a few hours overlap with Amsterdam CET

- Long-term. We want someone for years, not a project



How to apply

 
 with the subject line in exactly this format:

[Your name] | [years editing DR ads] | [months using Higgsfield] | [length in seconds of the AI video you're sending]

Example: Anna Nowak | 3 | 7 | 24



Then in the body, exactly these six lines and nothing else. No cover letter, no CV, no attachments — links only.



1. Best UGC or founder ad you've edited:

2. What it sold and how it performed:

3. Best AI video you've made (if any)

4. Best moment in the ad from line 1 — timestamp (mm:ss) and why, max 2 sentences:

5. Loom link (90 seconds max, camera on) --> open one of the two videos on your screen and talk us through one editing decision, and why. Not a pitch, not your CV. We want to hear how you think.



You will be skipped for: wrong subject format, a CV instead of links, attachments, weddings or corporate work, "I am hardworking and a fast learner," or anything that could have been sent to any company.



We want to hear from you. Really see you and build that true connection.

Experience supporting dropshipping stores that acquire customers through Google Shopping or Google Ads is strongly preferred. Your main responsibility will be customer support and order follow-up.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Handle customer
s about order status, shipping, delivery delays, product questions, cancellations, returns, and refunds.

• Escalate chargeback threats, unusual complaints, and cases requiring an owner’s decision.

• Careful handling of customer information.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



• Supporting stores selling through Google Shopping or Google Ads.

• Working with CJdropshipping or similar fulfillment suppliers.

• Supporting customers in the USA and UK.

• Handling delivery complaints, refund requests, and chargeback-related cases.

• Using Gmail, Gorgias, Zendesk, Help Scout, or similar support tools.



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



Hours and compensation will be agreed based on experience, availability, and support volume. Please include your expected hourly rate in USD.



HOW TO APPLY



Use “Google Shopping Support VA” as your application subject and include:



1. A brief overview of your Shopify dropshipping customer support experience.

2. Whether you have supported a store selling through Google Shopping or Google Ads, and your responsibilities there.

3. The support and fulfillment tools you have used, including any CJdropshipping experience.

4. Your weekly availability, working hours with time zone, and expected hourly rate in USD.

5. Your answer to the scenario below.



APPLICATION SCENARIO



A customer says their order is late, tracking has not updated for seven days, and they want a refund or will open a chargeback.



Write a short customer reply and list your first three checks in Shopify and with the supplier. If your next step depends on our store policy, explain what you would need to confirm.

title: Customer Support & General Virtual Assistant (Remote, Jewelry Brand)
description:
About Us



We're a jewelry brand, but our customers aren't really buying jewelry. They're buying a gift for a sister who just moved abroad, a charm that marks a trip they took with their best friend, a piece that will sit on someone's wrist for the next ten years. When something goes wrong with that order, it's not a product issue, it's a ruined moment. We need someone who gets that, and who treats every ticket like it matters, because to the person on the other end, it does.



The Role



This is a hybrid role: part Customer Support Representative, part General Virtual Assistant. Customer support is the core of the job. You'll be the first point of contact for our customers across
 and social media, helping with everything from sizing and material questions to shipping updates, returns, and the occasional "my parcel says delivered but it isn't here."

Around that, you'll pick up general VA work as the business needs it. That might mean updating order details in Shopify, tagging and organising tickets, keeping trackers and spreadsheets current, pulling together simple reports, researching a supplier or a competitor, or helping the team get a project over the line. The mix will shift week to week, and we'd rather hire someone who's comfortable with that than someone who needs a fixed list.

We're not looking for someone who pastes templates and closes tickets. We need a problem solver who is caring enough to make the customer feel looked after, and sharp enough to protect the business while doing it.



What We're Looking For



Detail-oriented. Jewelry orders are unforgiving. A wrong ring size, a typo in an address, or a missed engraving note means a disappointed customer and a costly reship. You catch these things before they become problems.



A problem solver. "I don't know" isn't where you stop, it's where you start. You dig into the order, check the tracking, read the policy, ask the right person, and come back with an answer.



Pragmatic. You understand that customer happiness and business policy aren't opposites. You can calm down an angry customer and land on a solution that works for both sides, and you know a full refund isn't the only tool in the box.



A strong writer. Excellent grammar, clear structure, and the ability to shift tone from warm and reassuring to polite and firm depending on who's in front of you.



Self-directed. This is a remote role with a lot of autonomy. You manage your own queue, flag issues before they're chased, and don't need hand-holding to get through a task list.

Adaptable. One hour you're handling a delivery complaint, the next you're cleaning up a spreadsheet. You're fine with that.



Responsibilities



Customer support (primary):

Manage customer inquiries via
 and social media about orders, shipping, sizing, materials, and care.

Respond to and moderate social media comments and DMs in the brand's voice.

Handle returns, exchanges, and replacements efficiently, following our policies while keeping customer goodwill intact.

De-escalate frustrated customers dealing with shipping delays, damaged items, or wrong orders.

Spot and flag recurring issues (a batch defect, a carrier problem, a confusing product page) so we can fix the root cause.

General VA (secondary):

Order admin in Shopify: address changes, order edits, cancellations, and manual fulfilment updates.

Keep internal trackers, sheets, and documentation up to date.

Light reporting: pulling weekly ticket numbers, common contact reasons, or other simple data the team asks for.

Ad-hoc research and admin tasks to support the wider team.

Requirements

English proficiency at C1 or C2 level, written and spoken.

At least 1 year of customer support experience, ideally for an e-commerce or DTC brand.

Comfortable working across multiple tools at once. Experience with Shopify and a helpdesk (Commslayer, Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or Intercom) is a strong plus.

Confident with Google Sheets or Excel at a basic-to-intermediate level.

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet working setup, and a backup plan for power or internet outages.

Availability for 30-40 hours



What You'll Get



3$/h, paid fortnightly.

Fully remote, long-term role with a small team that actually reads what you write.

Clear processes and a helpdesk with AI assistance, so your time goes on the tickets that need a human, not the ones that don't.



Room to grow into more responsibility if you show you can handle it.



MUST FOLLOW STEP: Apply through our ATS

We only review applications submitted through the link below. Applications sent by DM,
, or as a comment on this post won't be seen. Shortlisted candidates will be sent a short paid trial task before any interview.

Apply:

title: Direct Response Video Editor (Meta / TikTok Ads)
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand looking for a sharp, conversion-focused Direct Response Video Editor for Meta 
 & Instagram) and TikTok Ads.



This is not a traditional cinema editing role. We are not looking for cinematic showreels, corporate brand hype videos, or music videos. We need a visual marketer who understands direct response consumer psychology, retention graph optimization, and how to stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds.



You will collaborate directly with our Creative Strategist, taking raw UGC, product footage, AI footage, and conceptual hooks, and turning them into high-intent, high-converting video creatives that drive clicks and purchases. You understand how visual pacing, sound design, on-screen kinetic captions, and split-screen patterns keep mobile users glued to the screen.



Core Responsibilities

⚬ End-to-End Direct Response Editing: Edit high-converting video ad formats including UGC mashups, problem/solution native ads, 3-reasons-why, founder-led explainers, and TikTok-style native demos using editing tools like Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

⚬ Collaboration with Creative Strategist: Turn creative briefs, storyboards, and hook concepts into dynamic, performance-driven video assets without needing constant micro-management.

⚬ Rapid Hook & Angle Iteration: Systematically produce 3–5 alternative 3-second visual hooks for winning ad bodies to combat creative fatigue and unlock new scale.

⚬ Retention Pacing & Motion Design: Implement native captions, jump cuts, visual b-roll overlays, kinetic text, sound effects (SFX), and UI mockups that feel organic to the feed while driving urgency.

⚬ Performance Analysis: Review weekly creative metrics (3-second hook rate, hold rate/retention curves, and outbound CTR) with the team to understand why an ad won or lost, using the data to improve the next batch.



Required Qualifications & Skills

⚬ Direct Response Video Experience: Demonstrated track record editing high-converting video ads specifically for Meta and TikTok. You understand the difference between "aesthetic editing" and "selling on camera."

⚬ Software Mastery: High proficiency in video editing tools like Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

⚬ Direct Response Creative Portfolio: You have a portfolio/showcase containing active or past DTC e-commerce video ads (applications without an ad portfolio will not be reviewed).

⚬ Native Platform Literacy: You live and breathe short-form content. You know current audio trends, visual memes, capcut-style text pacing, and what makes an ad feel native rather than corporate.

⚬ Excellent English & Copy Nuance: Strong grasp of American/Western e-commerce phrasing, pacing, and on-screen hook formatting.

⚬ Reliable Workstation: Stable high-speed internet (plus a reliable backup connection) and a powerful editing rig capable of rendering and managing 4K/raw footage without bottlenecks.



Nice-to-Haves

⚬ Familiarity with creative research and swipe-file tools (Foreplay.co, TrendTrack, Meta Ad Library).

⚬ Experience with sleep-tech, consumer health, or premium home goods DTC brands.

⚬ Light motion graphics experience (creating custom UI overlays, comparison tables, or press badge popups).



How to Apply

Please include:

 1. A direct link to your video portfolio or Google Drive folder containing e-commerce direct response video ads you personally edited (do not send cinematic reels or corporate video work).

 2. The video editing software and computer specs you use.

You’ll work directly with our team helping organize sales pipelines, maintain CRM systems, manage lead data, support outbound campaigns, improve follow-up processes, and keep revenue operations running smoothly for Integer One and selected client accounts.

title: WordPress Technical SEO & Website Architecture Specialist
description:
I own two established local service businesses in Jacksonville, Florida: a pest control company and a concrete company.



I am looking for ONE technically strong person who can take ownership of the structure and technical SEO of our WordPress websites.



This is NOT primarily a content-writing position and NOT a basic WordPress VA position. I already have people who can build pages and create content.



THE PROBLEM:



Our pest control website is approximately 10 years old. Different contractors have built and optimized different parts of the website over time.



We now have newer optimized service and location pages that are published, but the old website structure was never properly reorganized.



Examples:



• Old service pages are still linked from menus and other parts of the website

• New optimized pages exist but are difficult to find through normal website navigation

• Old and new pages may target the same search intent

• Internal linking needs to be reorganized

• Some newer pages may be orphaned or poorly integrated

• Old URLs may have years of Google history and backlinks that must be protected

• Navigation and service/location hierarchy needs to make sense

• Redirects, canonicals, indexing and sitemaps need to be reviewed

• We need to determine which pages should be kept, updated, merged, redirected or removed from the website structure



I DO NOT want someone to simply start deleting pages, changing URLs or rebuilding everything.

Creativity. We'll give you guidance, direction, and instructions  but we're hiring you to bring ideas, not to wait for them. Hook angles, trends worth jumping on, formats we haven't tried, a series idea that runs for a month. If you need a task list to start working, this isn't the seat.

Strong work leads straight into the full-time seat.

Accounts you've managed  live links preferred

AI image examples  Higgsfield or otherwise, show us what you can make

A Reddit post you wrote that performed well  or explain how you'd approach our niche

Three content ideas for our brand, one line each  pitch us
