title: Executive Virtual Assistant
description:
I’m looking for an Executive Assistant / Virtual Assistant to support me directly across business operations, scheduling, organization, follow-ups, research, documentation, B2B outreach, and day-to-day priorities.



This role is best suited for someone who is extremely organized, detail-oriented, proactive, reliable, resourceful, comfortable communicating with people, and able to take ownership rather than waiting for instructions on every task.



Responsibilities may include:



* Calendar and scheduling management

s and messages

* Helping book meetings and maintain follow-up sequences

* Supporting business development and sales-related tasks

* Social media research, posting, commenting, and engagement when needed

* Assisting with marketing and client-related work when needed

* General executive, administrative, operational, and business support as needed



The responsibilities are not limited to the list above. The role will evolve based on what is happening in the business and where I need the most support.



I move quickly and priorities can change when new information comes in. I’m looking for someone who can adapt, use good judgment, stay calm, think independently, and keep things organized in a fast-moving environment.



I’m not looking for someone who only completes assigned tasks and waits for the next instruction. I value someone who can notice what needs attention, follow through, ask questions when necessary, and take ownership of things within their scope.



There will be hands-on training, onboarding, frequent video calls, and live feedback. You will have time to learn how I work, how we prioritize, and how our systems operate.



You also need to be comfortable appearing professionally on Zoom video calls. This role may involve internal team calls as well as client, prospect, partner, or vendor calls with people across the US, Southeast Asia, the UK, and other markets.



For video calls, I’m looking for someone with a clean and professional work setup, reliable internet, good audio, appropriate lighting, and a presentable background. Please do not rely on a virtual background or green screen. I want someone who is comfortable being on camera and communicating professionally when representing the company.



There will also be a trial period before an ongoing offer is made. Some portions of the evaluation will be completed live on video without AI so I can understand how you naturally think, prioritize, organize information, solve problems, communicate, and make decisions. Other portions will allow AI since we use ChatGPT and similar tools heavily within the company. I care about someone who can use AI effectively while still having strong independent judgment.



If the trial goes well, the initial ongoing offer will most likely be either approximately 12 or 20 hours per week, with the intention of developing into a longer-term, full-time position if we work well together.



The initial part-time schedule will generally include Monday through Saturday PHT, with Sunday PHT off.

If the role progresses to full-time, it will be 40 paid working hours per week. The schedule would expand by adding hours after the existing 11 AM to 3 PM Pacific Time window rather than starting earlier.

title: LinkedIn Acquisition Operator, 20% per deal
description:
I’m looking for someone to work directly with me and run the day-to-day execution of my LinkedIn account.



This is a hands-on execution role, not a strategy or consulting role.



I already have the overall strategy, positioning, target market, offer, and direction. I’ll also provide the ideas, frameworks, observations, and raw material behind the content.



Your job is to take that direction and execute consistently.



The goal is simple: use LinkedIn to build relevant relationships, create conversations, and generate qualified opportunities with founder-led internet businesses.



What you’ll do



You’ll manage the day-to-day activity of my LinkedIn account.



That includes:



* Turning my ideas, notes, voice notes, frameworks, and direction into clean LinkedIn posts that sound like me

* Publishing content consistently

* Finding people and businesses that match the ICP I give you

* Researching prospects before reaching out

* Sending personalized connection requests and messages

* Following up with prospects

* Engaging with relevant posts and people when it makes sense

* Keeping conversations organized

* Identifying people who may have a genuine need for what we’re offering

* Moving interested prospects toward a conversation/call with me

* Tracking what is working and what isn’t



I will handle the sales calls, closing, client strategy, and fulfillment side.



You’re responsible for helping me create the opportunities that lead to those calls.



How we’ll work



I’m not hiring you and then disappearing.



I’ll be heavily involved in the thinking.



I’ll tell you who we’re targeting, what we’re offering, how I want things positioned, what angles we’re testing, what I want communicated, and the overall strategy we’re following.



For content, I’ll regularly give you the actual ideas and thinking. Your job is to turn that material into something clean, concise, and publishable without stripping away my voice.



For outbound, I’ll give you the ICP and direction. Your job is to consistently find the right people, execute the outreach, follow up, and keep the pipeline moving.



Think roughly 80% direction/strategy from me, 20% independent judgment from you.



I don’t need another strategist.



I need someone who can execute a strategy extremely well.



At the same time, I don’t want someone who needs instructions for every individual action. You should be able to understand the system, learn how I think, and increasingly operate within it independently.



Who I’m looking for



You should be:



* Very comfortable using LinkedIn

* A strong written communicator

* Good at researching people and companies

* Able to recognize patterns and follow a defined ICP

* Persistent with outreach and follow-up

* Organized enough to manage many conversations without losing track

* Comfortable receiving direct feedback and adjusting quickly

* Able to write naturally instead of producing obvious AI/corporate content

* Commercially aware enough to recognize when someone could become a real opportunity

* Consistent



You do not need to come in with some giant personal-brand strategy or convince me how LinkedIn should work.



I’m specifically looking for someone who can take a clear direction and run with it.



Compensation



This is a commission-only position. There is no hourly rate or base salary.



Compensation is:



20% of the first month’s collected revenue from every client attributable to your work.



Examples:



A client pays $1,000 for their first month → you earn $200



A client pays $3,000 → you earn $600



A client pays $5,000 → you earn $1,000



A client pays $10,000 → you earn $2,000



Commission is paid on revenue actually collected from the client.



There is no cap on commissions.



Important



Do not apply if you’re looking for guaranteed hourly work.



Do not apply if your approach to LinkedIn is sending hundreds of generic AI messages.



Do not apply if you need me to create every post, find every prospect, write every message, and tell you every individual action to take.



I’m looking for somebody execution-heavy, consistent, aggressive about finding opportunities, and capable of learning how I operate.



You don’t need to reinvent the strategy.



You need to execute it.



To apply



Send me:



1. A short introduction.

2. Any relevant LinkedIn, outbound, lead generation, appointment-setting, content, or prospecting experience.

3. An example of a LinkedIn post you’ve written, if you have one.

4. A short explanation of how you would research and identify good prospects from an ICP I provide.

5. Confirm clearly that you understand this is commission only: 20% of first-month collected client revenue, with no hourly or base pay.



Keep your application straightforward. I care more about whether you can think and execute than whether you have a perfect résumé.

You’ll work directly with our team helping generate conversations, qualify prospects, book meetings, and build sales pipeline for Integer One and selected client accounts.



This role is best suited for someone who is comfortable speaking with business owners and professionals, enjoys sales, learns quickly, takes detailed notes, follows up consistently, and actively looks for ways to generate more opportunities rather than only completing assigned tasks.



What You May Work On



• Cold calling businesses and prospects

• Appointment setting

• B2B outbound sales

• Following up with prospects by phone,
, SMS, LinkedIn, or other channels

• Qualifying prospects

• Booking meetings for sales calls

• Updating and maintaining CRM records

• Taking detailed notes after conversations

• Following up with leads consistently

• Researching companies and contacts before outreach

• Re-engaging older leads

• Managing daily call lists and outreach tasks

• Sending personalized follow-up
s

• Handling basic objections

• Testing new scripts and approaches

• Reporting on calls, conversations, meetings, and outcomes

• Helping identify patterns in prospect responses and objections

• Supporting other business development activities as needed



What We’re Looking For



You should be:



• Very comfortable making cold calls

• Confident speaking with business owners, executives, and professionals

• Fluent or highly proficient in spoken and written English

• Able to communicate naturally rather than sounding scripted

• Organized and detail-oriented

• Comfortable taking detailed notes

• Reliable and consistent

• Comfortable working independently

• Able to learn quickly

• Coachable and responsive to feedback

• Persistent without being aggressive

• Comfortable with rejection

• Proactive rather than waiting for instructions on every task

• Someone who takes ownership of results

• Comfortable using spreadsheets, CRMs,
, and communication tools

• Able to keep track of many prospects and follow-ups at once



What Will Make You Stand Out



We are especially interested if you:



• Have previous cold calling or appointment setting experience

• Have sold or booked meetings for B2B companies

• Have experience speaking with founders, CEOs, executives, or business owners

• Have experience with SaaS, agencies, technology, ecommerce, professional services, or startups

• Have consistently booked qualified meetings

• Understand basic sales qualification

• Know how to handle common objections

• Are comfortable writing follow-up
s

• Have used HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Close, or another CRM

• Know how to use Google Voice or similar calling tools

• Can build or improve your own outreach tracking systems

• Regularly suggest ways to improve the sales process

• Naturally look for additional channels or methods to reach prospects



We care a lot about initiative.



If you notice that prospects are not answering calls and independently start testing follow-up
s, researching better contact information, improving notes, or suggesting a better approach, that is a major positive.



We are looking for someone who thinks about the goal, not just the task.



Hours



This can become a full-time, long-term position at 40 hours per week for the right person.



Because many of the prospects are located in the United States, you should be comfortable working hours that overlap with US business hours.



Exact working hours can be discussed depending on your availability and the campaigns you are assigned to.



Performance



Your performance may be evaluated based on factors including:



• Number of calls completed

• Meaningful conversations

• Qualified meetings booked

• Show rates

• Follow-up activity

• CRM organization

• Accuracy of notes

• Communication

• Reliability

• Ability to learn

• Initiative

• Quality of booked opportunities



We care about activity, but we care even more about results and the quality of the opportunities you create.



Paid Test



Strong candidates may be invited to complete a paid working test.



During the test, you may receive real prospects to contact and will be evaluated on:



• Communication ability

• Confidence on the phone

• Call quality

• Ability to follow a script without sounding robotic

• Objection handling

• Note-taking

• CRM organization

• Follow-up

• Reliability

• Coachability

• Initiative

• Ability to improve as you receive feedback



Strong performance can lead directly to a long-term position.



Growth



We are building quickly and want people who can grow with us.



Someone who starts as an SDR could eventually grow into roles such as:



• Senior SDR

• Account Executive

• Outbound Team Lead

• Sales Manager

• Business Development Manager

• Client-facing sales specialist



If you consistently produce strong results, take ownership, and demonstrate leadership ability, there is significant room for increased responsibility and compensation.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your previous cold calling, appointment setting, or sales experience

3. What types of companies or industries you have called before

4. Approximately how many calls you are comfortable making per day

5. Your current hourly rate

6. Your weekly availability

7. Your preferred working hours

8. Any CRM or sales tools you have used

9. Tell me about a time you successfully booked a difficult prospect or overcame an objection

10. If available, include a short voice recording introducing yourself



Important: At the very beginning of your application, write the word PINEAPPLE so I know you read the entire job description.



Please do not send a generic copy-and-paste application.



I’m particularly interested in people who are hungry, proactive, organized, naturally good communicators, and capable of learning quickly.



We are reviewing applications immediately and will begin paid tests with strong candidates quickly.

title: 🚨 ELITE UGC VIDEO EDITOR WANTED - LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY
description:
PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING.



Do not apply for this role unless you are a genuinely high-level video editor capable of creating premium TECH / APP / UGC content to the standard of the examples below — or better.



I am not looking for an average editor.

I am not looking for someone who can simply add captions, transitions and music to a video.



I am looking for someone who understands modern short-form UGC editing — hooks, pacing, retention, storytelling, motion graphics, screen recordings, overlays, sound design, visual pattern interrupts, clean captions and the small details that make content feel premium.



🎬 THIS IS THE STANDARD



Before applying, watch ALL THREE examples below:

EXAMPLE 1:


==



EXAMPLE 2:


==



EXAMPLE 3:


==



Look at the editing carefully.



If you cannot confidently create content to these standards, please do not apply.



If you look at them and think:

“I can make this — and I can make it even better.”

Keep reading.



WHO I AM

I'm James.

I'm a content creator and entrepreneur based in Australia, and I'm building a rapidly growing business around UGC, content creation, personal branding and coaching.



We're still early.

That's important.

I'm not advertising a position inside a massive company where you'll become employee #247.

I'm building the team now.



We currently have three people involved in the operation, and I'm looking for the next person who wants to come in early, become an important part of what we're building and potentially grow with us for the long term.



Content volume is increasing quickly across multiple brands, and I'm now looking for another exceptional editor to join the team.



For the right person, this can become consistent, ongoing work across multiple brands, accounts and projects.



And as the business grows, I want the people who helped build it to grow with it.

WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING



The immediate requirement is predominantly short-form UGC content, particularly within:

Tech / apps / software / education / digital products / online services.



Most content will be created for:

Instagram Reels + TikTok, with the potential for other short-form platforms and projects as we expand.



You will generally receive the raw footage, creative direction, brand requirements and examples/references.

Your job is to take that raw material and turn it into content that actually holds attention.



That may involve:

Fast-paced talking-head editing

Strong first 1–3 second hooks

Dynamic captions

B-roll

App/interface demonstrations

Screen recordings

Green-screen/background removal

Motion graphics

Zooms and reframing

Sound effects and sound design

Music

Pattern interrupts

Images and visual overlays

Strategic cuts

Retention-focused pacing

Brand-specific assets

Clean CTA sequences

Making potentially "boring" information visually engaging

I don't want effects thrown onto a video simply because you know how to use them.

Every edit should have intention.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



Technical ability matters enormously.

But your attitude matters just as much.



I'm looking for someone who:



Is exceptionally good at short-form editing

Has experience with high-quality UGC/tech content

Understands retention, not just editing

Has extremely strong attention to detail

Can follow a brief precisely

Takes initiative rather than waiting to be told everything

Communicates clearly and proactively

Can turn work around efficiently

Is reliable

Is organised

Is comfortable working within systems and clear deliverables

Takes feedback extremely well

Wants to continuously improve

Brings solutions, not excuses

Cares about the quality of what they put their name against

Wants to be part of a team rather than simply complete random freelance jobs



And importantly:

You need to be a good human.



Culture matters to me.



I want to build a team around energy, passion, positivity, ambition, communication and genuinely wanting to see other people win.



Skills can continue to improve.

Attitude, character and work ethic are everything.

⚠️ HOW TO APPLY — IMPORTANT



I'm intentionally making the application process different.

I will prioritise candidates who follow the instructions below.



Don't just send me a generic OnlineJobs.ph application saying:

"Hi sir, I am an experienced video editor and would love to work with you."

That tells me nothing.



Instead, I want you to take initiative.

Step 1 — Find me on Instagram

My main Instagram account 



Go to my profile and understand who I am, the content I create and what I'm building.



Step 2 — Message me personally.



Send me a DM.

Written message or voice note — completely up to you.



Tell me:

Why are YOU the person I should bring onto this team?

Don't tell me what you think I want to hear.

Be yourself.

Tell me what you're exceptional at.

Step 3 — Show me your work

Send me your portfolio and, more importantly, your best examples of work relevant to the three reference videos above.

I care significantly more about seeing 3 incredible edits than 50 average ones.



Step 4 — Sample edit

Shortlisted candidates must be willing to complete a short sample edit from supplied footage and a clear brief, so I can see how you interpret direction and whether your editing standard matches what we're building.



The sample will be narrowly scoped for evaluation rather than used as client deliverable work.



Step 5 — Interview



If the quality is there, I'll arrange a video call with you.



At that point, I'm not only assessing your editing ability.

I want to meet you.

I want to understand your goals, energy, communication style and whether we're the right fit for each other.



🚀 THE OPPORTUNITY

I'm not looking for somebody for the next two weeks.

I'm looking for somebody who could potentially be here for years.

The business is early, but we're expanding.

More brands are coming onboard.

Content volume is increasing.

The team is growing.

And my ambition for where I'm taking this is extremely high.



For the right person, there is an opportunity to work across multiple brands, develop alongside an existing editor, take on increasing responsibility and grow as the operation grows.



I want people around me who eventually look back and say:

“I joined when this thing was just getting started.”

If you're looking for the easiest editing job you can find, this probably isn't it.



If you're exceptionally good, hungry to improve, easy to work with, take pride in your craft and want to build something long-term with a team that genuinely cares about each other...



I want to hear from you.



Watch the three examples.

Find me on Instagram.

Show me what you've got.

Let's build. 🚀

— James D Russell

title: Technical Project Manager & Executive Assistant — Airtable Required
description:
I am looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager who can also function as my Executive Assistant and right-hand partner. This is not an entry-level project management role and not a traditional Virtual Assistant position.



I manage a demanding professional workload alongside business ownership and personal responsibilities. I need someone who can become an extension of me, helping manage projects, priorities, inbox, calendar, meetings, follow-ups, deadlines, and commitments while continuously improving the systems behind how I work. I am looking for someone highly organized, intelligent, curious, tech-savvy, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment.



You should be the type of person who notices something inefficient and thinks:



“There has to be a better way to do this.”



Then you research it, recommend a solution, and help implement it.



TWO NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



1. Professional Project Management / Technical Project Management experience



You must have previously managed real projects involving stakeholders, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, meetings, follow-ups, and status reporting.



2. Professional, hands-on Airtable experience



You must already know Airtable and have used it professionally. This is not something we are looking to train from scratch.



If you do not have BOTH, please do not apply.



What You’ll Own



Project & Technical Project Management



You will help keep multiple projects moving by:



* Building and maintaining project plans

* Managing timelines, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies

* Tracking risks, issues, decisions, and action items

* Following up with stakeholders

* Identifying risks before deadlines are missed

* Preparing agendas and organizing meetings

* Turning meetings into clear actions, owners, and deadlines

* Maintaining project documentation

* Preparing status updates and reporting

* Tracking commitments across multiple workstreams

* Helping coordinate competing priorities

* Identifying when something is stuck and determining what is needed to move it forward



I need someone who can take a messy meeting, project, or brain dump and turn it into an organized execution plan.



You should be able to tell me:



“Here is where we are. Here is what’s at risk. Here is what I’m handling. Here is what we’re waiting on. And here is what I need from you.”



Airtable & Systems



Airtable will be an important part of this role.



You should already be comfortable with:



* Building and maintaining Airtable bases

* Tables and linked records

* Views and filters

* Formulas

* Forms

* Interfaces

* Automations

* Workflow design

* Reporting

* Data organization

* Integrations where appropriate



Executive Assistance



This is where the role differs from a traditional TPM position.



I need someone who is also comfortable being a true executive support partner.



You will help with:



* Inbox and
 management

* Identifying and flagging messages that require my attention

* Drafting
s and communications for review

* Tracking unanswered
s and follow-ups

* Calendar management

* Meeting scheduling and coordination

* Identifying calendar conflicts

* Preparing me for upcoming meetings

* Maintaining priorities and task lists

* Tracking commitments I have made

* Reminding and following up with me

* Research and information gathering

* Organizing documents and information

* Business and personal administrative projects as needed



You must be comfortable managing up.



If I owe you something, remind me. If I am holding up a project, tell me. If I committed to something and haven’t completed it, follow up. I am specifically hiring someone so I do not have to keep everything in my own head.



Over time, I want you to understand my projects, responsibilities, working style, and priorities well enough to anticipate what needs attention before I have to ask.



Excel, Data & Analytical Thinking



Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills are required.



You should be comfortable working with:



* Formulas and conditional logic

* XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP or similar lookup functions

* Pivot tables

* Data cleaning and organization

* Trackers and dashboards

* Reporting and basic analysis

* Moderately complex datasets



But I care about more than spreadsheet mechanics. I want someone who is curious about what the data is telling us. If something changed, ask why. If you notice a pattern, investigate it. If something doesn’t make sense, question it. If we’re collecting the wrong information, tell me.



Process Improvement, Technology & Automation



One of the most important parts of this role is helping me work better, not simply helping me do more of the same work.



I want someone who naturally asks questions like:



* Why are we doing this manually?

* Could we create a form for this?

* Why are we entering this information in multiple places?

* Could these systems communicate with each other?

* Is there an application that would solve this problem?

* Could we automate this reminder?

* Why does this problem keep happening?

* Is there a simpler way to accomplish this?



You should be comfortable researching software and tools, testing potential solutions, creating workflows, building forms and automations, developing SOPs/checklists, and recommending better ways of working. You do not need to be a developer.You do need to be technologically curious and willing to figure things out.



AI Fluency



I strongly encourage intelligent use of 
e AI to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, formulas, brainstorming, process development, meeting preparation, drafting and repetitive work.



However:AI should accelerate your judgment, not replace it. I am not looking for someone who copies a problem into ChatGPT and sends me whatever comes back. You should understand the work, validate the output, apply your own judgment, and take ownership of the final result.



Who Will Thrive in This Role



You are proactive, curious, extremely organized, resourceful, analytical, and comfortable with technology.



You don’t need every task broken down into step-by-step instructions before you can begin.



If you don’t know something, you research it.



If you see a problem, you bring potential solutions.



If you discover a useful tool, you bring it forward.



If something keeps going wrong, you look for the root cause.



If there is a better way to organize something, you help build it.



If you improve a process, you document it so it can be repeated.



Most importantly, you close loops.



Current Environment & Availability



We are looking to hire immediately and preference will be given to candidates who can start right away or with very short notice.



We are currently in a particularly busy period with a significant amount of work to organize, catch up on and execute.



The first several weeks may be especially fast-paced as we work through existing projects, establish better systems, organize priorities, and create a more sustainable operating rhythm.



I am looking for someone who is willing to lean in during critical periods, demonstrate urgency when deadlines require it, and be flexible when an important project needs additional attention.



The goal is not to maintain a permanently chaotic or “always-on” environment. The goal is the opposite:



Help build the systems, processes, automations, and structure that make the environment less chaotic over time.



This role is best suited for someone with a builder mentality who enjoys taking something messy and making it work better.



Required Qualifications



* Professional Project Management or Technical Project Management experience

* Professional hands-on Airtable experience

* Experience managing multiple projects and stakeholders

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Excellent business communication

* Strong organizational and follow-through skills

* Strong technology aptitude

* Experience working with U.S.-based teams, executives, clients, or stakeholders

* Ability to work primarily during U.S. Eastern Time

* Ability to work independently and exercise good judgment

* Comfortable working directly with a busy executive

* Comfortable managing changing priorities

* Reliable computer and internet connection



Experience with tools such as ClickUp, Asana, Jira, Slack, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, automation/no-code platforms, or similar systems is a plus.



To Apply



 answer the following questions:



1. Project Management:

Describe one complex project you personally managed. What was the project, what were you responsible for, who were the stakeholders, what tools did you use, and what was the outcome?



2. Airtable:

Describe the most complex Airtable system you have personally built or managed. Be specific about the tables, linked records, views, formulas, interfaces, automations, integrations, or workflows you used.



If possible, include a sanitized screenshot or short screen recording of something you built. Please remove any confidential information.



3. Process Improvement:

Tell me about something you improved, automated, or redesigned without being specifically asked to do so. What did you notice, what did you change, and what was the result?



4. Executive Support / Managing Up:

Have you supported a busy executive or senior leader before? Describe how you kept them organized and made sure commitments did not fall through the cracks. Please include any experience managing inboxes or calendars.



5. Excel / Google Sheets:

Rate your ability from 1–10 and describe the most complex spreadsheet, dashboard, tracker, or analysis you have personally built.



6. Availability:

What is the earliest date you could begin working full-time during U.S. Eastern Time?



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term working relationship and growing into an increasingly trusted partner over time.





Compensation: $900 USD/month during the initial ramp-up period.





There will be a formal performance and compensation review, with opportunity for an increase based on demonstrated performance, reliability, ownership, judgment, and ability to independently manage projects and responsibilities.

title: Inbound + Outbound Sales Closer (Flawless English Required)
description:
We are Perfect Pear Roof & Exterior Cleaning, a Florida-based exterior cleaning company serving homeowners in the Orlando area. We have been in business since 2006. We are not a call center and we are not a churn-and-burn shop. We sell a recurring maintenance program that keeps homes clean year round, which means our customers stay with us for years and our sales team builds a book of business instead of starting from zero every month.



We are hiring one sales rep. This is a long-term seat on a small team, not a trial gig.



What You Will Actually Do



Inbound:



Answer inbound calls, texts, web form leads, and
 ad leads quickly. Speed to lead is everything here.

Qualify homeowners, understand the property and the problem, and build real rapport in the first 60 seconds.

Quote jobs over the phone and close them on the call whenever possible.

Sell homeowners into our recurring maintenance program rather than one-time cleanings. This is the core of the role.

Book estimates for our field team when a site visit is needed, and confirm those appointments so they hold.



Outbound:



Follow up on every unsold quote until you get a yes or a no. Most of our revenue lives in follow-up.

Work aged and cold lead lists and turn them into booked jobs.

Win-back calls to past customers who have not been serviced in a while.

Upsell and cross-sell existing customers into additional services and higher tier plans.

Outbound calls into target neighborhoods and referral sources.



Every Day:



Log every call, note, and next step in our CRM [CRM name]. If it is not in the CRM, it did not happen.

Keep your pipeline clean and current.

Submit a short daily check-in with your numbers: dials, contacts, quotes, closes, revenue.

Hit weekly and monthly targets that we will set together and review every week.

Follow our scripts and objection frameworks, then help us make them better.



Who We Are Looking For

Job Summary



We are looking for a technically curious and highly trainable AI & Automation Virtual Assistant to join the core remote team of a Hong Kong-based company.

This role combines normal Virtual Assistant execution with a strong focus on AI tools, automation, research, testing and technology support.

You will complete recurring operational tasks while also helping the team improve how work is done using AI and automation.

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys experimenting with new tools, learning how systems connect and finding faster ways to complete repetitive work.



Key Responsibilities



Complete assigned recurring and operational tasks accurately and on time.

Use AI tools to support research, documentation, data processing and daily execution.

Assist with building, testing and maintaining simple automations and workflows.

Research new AI tools, software and automation opportunities.

Keep company tools, documentation and internal systems updated.

Test new workflows and report errors, limitations and improvement opportunities.

Create clear documentation and SOPs for tools and automated processes.

Update ClickUp, spreadsheets, databases and other company systems.

Support Gerald, Turqey and other team members with AI-related research and technical execution.

Technical curiosity: You actively explore new AI tools and technology.

Execution: You can still complete normal recurring work accurately and consistently.

Problem solving: You investigate issues before immediately escalating them.

Accuracy: Automations and AI outputs must be checked before being trusted.

Documentation: If you build or change something, another person should be able to understand how it works.

Continuous learning: AI tools change quickly. You are expected to keep learning and adapting.

Qualifications & Skills

Strong interest in AI, automation and technology.

Regular experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar.

Comfortable learning new software without extensive training.

Good written and spoken English.

Strong research and problem-solving ability.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets, structured data and online systems.

Experience with ClickUp or similar project-management software is an advantage.

Experience with automation platforms such as Make, Zapier, n8n or similar is a strong advantage.

Basic understanding of APIs, databases, scripting or no-code tools is an advantage but not required.

Strong attention to detail.

Able to follow SOPs and complete recurring tasks reliably.

Comfortable working across different departments.

Formal technology qualifications are not required.

We are more interested in whether you genuinely use technology, experiment independently and can learn quickly.



How Success Is Measured



Success means recurring tasks are completed accurately, company tools stay maintained, automations work reliably, documentation remains current, and the amount of repetitive manual work gradually decreases.

This role is suited to someone who enjoys geeking out on AI and technology, but is also disciplined enough to handle routine operational work consistently.

We are seeking a Mental Health Practice Operations Virtual Assistant to provide ongoing administrative and operational support.



This is a part-time position initially, with the opportunity for increased hours and responsibilities as the practice grows.



The ideal candidate has experience working in healthcare, mental health, medical administration, or a similar professional environment and is comfortable learning new systems and software.



Initial Hours



10–15 hours per week



We are open to discussing the specific schedule with the right candidate. Consistent availability and reliable communication are important.



What You Will Help With

Follow up on emails and outstanding administrative tasks

Maintain spreadsheets, trackers, and administrative records

Organize electronic files and documents

Conduct administrative research

Make routine administrative phone calls when needed

Follow up with vendors, organizations, referral sources, and other contacts

Help keep projects and administrative tasks moving forward

Experience with TherapyNotes or another mental health EHR is strongly preferred

Review files for administrative completeness

Identify missing documents or administrative requirements for provider follow-up

Maintain documentation trackers

Help ensure administrative workflows are completed on schedule



This role does not involve making clinical decisions, diagnosing clients, providing therapy, or determining treatment.



Practice Systems & Organization

Help organize practice policies and procedures

Assist with creating and maintaining SOPs

Create checklists and workflow documents

Help improve administrative processes

Organize practice resources

Help identify repetitive tasks that could be streamlined

Assist with implementing new administrative systems

Owner/Executive Support



You will also provide administrative support to the practice owner, including:



Following up on items that require action

Organizing tasks and priorities

Drafting routine administrative emails for review

Researching questions and presenting organized findings

Following up on collaboration and referral opportunities

Helping turn ideas and projects into actionable task lists

Tracking outstanding projects and deadlines

What We Are NOT Hiring For Right Now



Medical billing is NOT part of the position.





Required Qualifications



We are looking for someone who has:



Previous healthcare, medical, mental health, or professional administrative experience

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong attention to detail

Excellent organization and follow-through

Strong computer and technology skills

Experience working independently

Ability to learn new software quickly

Professional communication skills

Ability to manage confidential information appropriately

Reliable internet connection

A quiet and professional workspace

Consistent availability during agreed-upon working hours

Strongly Preferred



Candidates with experience in any of the following will receive strong consideration:



Mental health practice administration

Medical Virtual Assistant work

TherapyNotes or another behavioral health EHR

Insurance verification

Prior authorization tracking

Provider credentialing

CAQH

Payer enrollment

Healthcare provider onboarding

Referral coordination

HIPAA/privacy procedures

Healthcare administrative documentation



You do not need to have experience with everything listed above.



We are more interested in someone who is organized, dependable, resourceful, and willing to learn.



The Person We Are Looking For



The right person is:



Proactive

You notice what needs attention instead of waiting for someone to tell you every next step.



Organized

You can manage multiple tasks, deadlines, emails, and follow-ups without losing track of details.



Reliable

When you say something will be completed, it gets completed.



Resourceful

If you don't know how to do something, you know how to research, ask appropriate questions, and find a solution.



Detail-oriented

You understand that accuracy matters when working in a healthcare practice.



Professional

You communicate respectfully and professionally with clients, clinicians, referral sources, and organizations.



Adaptable

The practice is growing, so processes will continue to develop. You should be comfortable working in an environment where we are building and improving systems.



Confidentiality & Privacy



Because this is a mental health practice, confidentiality and appropriate handling of sensitive information are extremely important.



Any access to client or practice information will be provided only through approved systems and according to the practice's privacy and security procedures. The selected candidate will be required to follow all applicable confidentiality and security requirements.



Compensation



Starting range: $6–$10 USD/hour, depending on experience, healthcare knowledge, technical skills, and demonstrated ability.





Hours and responsibilities may increase as the practice grows and as the candidate demonstrates strong performance.



How to Apply



Please begin your application with the words:



"I can help RenewIn-Minds stay organized."



This helps us identify applicants who carefully read the posting.



Please include:



A brief introduction about yourself

Your previous administrative or healthcare experience

The types of healthcare practices you have worked with, if applicable

The EHRs or software you have experience using

Your experience with credentialing, CAQH, insurance, or provider enrollment, if any

Your weekly availability

Your requested hourly rate

Your internet/work setup

Why you believe you would be a good fit for a growing mental health practice

A description of a time when you noticed an administrative problem and took initiative to solve it

Hiring Process



We expect the hiring process to include:



Step 1: Application review



Step 2: Short interview



Step 3: Skills/administrative assessment



Step 4: Final interview



Step 5: Paid trial period



We want the trial period to be useful for both sides so that we can determine whether the working relationship is a good fit.



Long-Term Opportunity



Our goal is to build a dependable administrative infrastructure as RenewIn-Minds continues to grow.



The person selected for this position has the opportunity to grow with the practice and potentially take on additional responsibilities over time based on demonstrated skills, reliability, and initiative.



If you enjoy creating order, solving administrative problems, learning new systems, and helping a growing organization operate more efficiently, we would love to hear from you.

title: Short-Form Editor / Graphic Designer **Rockstars Only**
description:
Are you an A player? We want you on our team!



Here's the wrong version of this role: someone who logs on, asks what they should work on, sends three "just checking if this looks right?" messages, and waits. We already know what needs to be made. We wrote it down. If the brief and the brand bible are sitting in your queue and you still need a call to start, this isn't a fit.



Here's the right version: you pull a task, read the brief once, look at the last three approved assets for that client, and build something that looks like it belongs next to them. You submit it. It's right the first time more often than it isn't. When something is genuinely ambiguous, you ask specific questions in one message and keep working on something else while you wait.



What you'll make



Short-form video (Reels, TikToks, paid ad cuts) and the static side of it: carousels, feed graphics, flyers, ad creative. Real small businesses with real ad spend behind some of it. Multiple clients, multiple brand voices, switched between in the same afternoon.



Tools you should already be fluent in



CapCut and DaVinci Resolve or equivalent for video. Photoshop and the Adobe suite or equivalent for design. Canva for anything going into a client's hands. We won't train you on these. We will absolutely train you on our clients.



How this works



You're online during a set daily window so revisions and the occasional rush don't sit overnight. Inside that window, nobody hovers. There's no no hour-by-hour reporting. What we measure is whether assets land on time, in the naming convention, at the right quality, and how fast you respond when a revision comes in.



The rules that aren't negotiable: brand bible before you start, naming convention on every file, new version every time (never overwrite), and when you're blocked you say so immediately instead of quietly stalling. Two people review your work and both will tell you plainly when something misses.



Who we're looking for



We're a growing agency, and we're building the team that takes us to the next stage. Your work is seen by the people who d
 things, on the day you do it.



We're hiring for a seat, not a project. We'd rather train one person properly over several years than churn through six editors in one. So we care less about whether you know every shortcut in Resolve today and more about whether you'll know them in six months because you went and learned them on your own. As we grow, the people who grew with us get first claim on what comes next.



What we're actually looking for in a person:



You tell the truth about your work. If you missed a deadline, you say so before we find out. If you didn't understand the brief, you say that too, instead of guessing and hoping. We've never once been upset with someone for saying "I don't know how to do this yet." We have been upset with silence.



You communicate without being chased. A short message that says what's done, what's stuck, and what you need is worth more to us than an hour of perfect work we didn't know was happening. Going quiet is the single fastest way to lose this job.



You get better on purpose. You watch how other editors cut, you notice when a style is shifting, you bring an idea occasionally instead of only executing. Nobody here will build you a curriculum. The people who do well are the ones who improve because they wanted to.



You move without being pushed. When the queue is empty you say so instead of waiting to be found. When something is obviously broken you flag it. When you finish early you ask what's next. That instinct is most of what we mean by independent, and you either have it or you don't.



You take criticism as information. Your work gets reviewed, and you'll be told plainly when something misses. It's not personal and it isn't a comment on you. Editors who take feedback as an insult burn out fast. Editors who take it as data get very good, very quickly.



What we'll give back:



Honest feedback, consistent and on-time pay, clear briefs, and real autonomy inside your shift. We won't message you after hours. We won't ask you to pretend to be busy. And if you're good, we'll keep you for years and grow the role around you. We care about all members of our team and want to see you grow and succeed in life.



If this sounds like a fit for you - Send over your portfolio for a chance to enter the trial task phase

title: Virtual Math & ELA Teacher (K-8) — PRC-Licensed, Remote
description:
Thrive Alliance is a U.S. based K to 8 online school. We make one commitment to every family who enrolls, and we put a number on it: one full grade level of improvement in twelve weeks. We are hiring PRC licensed teachers to deliver that outcome, and we are hiring for the long term.



How the teaching works



Teaching is one on one, in sixty minute classes, through Google Meet. Each student meets the same teacher twice a week and stays with that teacher. We do not rotate teachers through students, because a result that cannot be traced to a teacher is not a result we can build on.



Every teacher receives a student's documented grade level gap before the first class: where the student tests, what is missing, and the order to address it in. That comes from MobyMax, the adaptive platform we teach on. It assesses each student continuously and sets the next target from that student's own results. Teachers do not build lessons from scratch, and no prior experience with the platform is required. Training is completed before the first class.



Class time and schedule



Classes run from 3:00 PM to 9:00 PM US Central Time, Monday through Thursday. Teachers choose their own hours inside that range. The minimum commitment is four hours a day and the maximum is six. Because the range is exactly six hours, a six hour day means the full range with no gaps. That comes to 16 to 24 teaching hours per week. Fridays and weekends are not scheduled.



Compensation



Pay is $4.00 USD for each hour taught, sent by Wise every two weeks on a fixed date. Four hours a day comes to approximately $277 per month and six hours a day to approximately $416. A bonus of $200 USD is paid when 80 percent or more of a teacher's students gain a full grade level within a twelve week cycle.



What Thrive Alliance provides



Full training on the platform and on our teaching system, completed before the first class. Two weeks shadowing a senior teacher before a teacher takes on students of their own. A named operations manager as a single point of contact, reachable the same day. Every student's gap documented in advance.



Requirements



Active PRC teaching license and LET passer status. At least one year teaching or tutoring K to 8. Spoken and written English strong enough for live one on one teaching with U.S. elementary students. A reliable internet connection and a quiet space suitable for video.



Helpful but not required: prior online tutoring experience, familiarity with U.S. curriculum standards, and experience with an adaptive platform such as MobyMax, IXL, or Khan Academy.



To apply



Provide your PRC license number. State the maximum number of hours you can teach between 3:00 PM and 9:00 PM US Central Time, Monday through Thursday, and which hours those are. Begin your response with the word Alliance to confirm you have read the full posting.



Job type: Independent contractor. 



Work location: Remote. 



This is ongoing work, not seasonal. We are building a teaching staff we intend to keep.

title: Customer Service
description:
We are looking for a highly capable, thoughtful and proactive Customer Support Specialist to join our growing e-commerce company.

This is not a role where we are looking for someone who simply copies and pastes responses.

We are building a company with the ambition to grow into a multi-million-dollar e-commerce business, and we are looking for people who want to grow with us along the way.



At this stage, your main responsibility will be customer support. But for the right person, there is significant room to grow into a larger role within our company as our team, order volume and operations expand.



What We Are Looking For

We need someone who can work within clear systems, prompts, guidelines and SOPs — while still being able to think for themselves.



You should understand that great customer service is not always about following a script word for word.



Different customers require different approaches.

Sometimes a customer needs a short and direct answer.

Sometimes they need reassurance.

Sometimes they are frustrated and need to feel heard before a solution is offered.

Sometimes the best decision is not explicitly written in a prompt, and you need to use your own judgment.



We are looking for someone who understands that difference.

You should be able to read a customer's message and naturally determine:



What is the customer actually asking?

How frustrated or concerned is this customer?

How warm, social or direct should my response be?

What solution makes the most sense in this situation?

Is this something I can solve myself or should I escalate it?

How can I protect both the customer experience and the interests of the company?



Our goal is for customers to feel like they are communicating with a real, thoughtful person — not a customer service script.



Your Responsibilities

You will be responsible for:

Responding to customer
s professionally and efficiently

Handling questions regarding orders, shipping, tracking, products, sizing, returns and refunds

Resolving complaints and difficult customer situations calmly

Following our internal customer service prompts, policies and SOPs

Using your own judgment when a situation requires a more personal approach

Adjusting your tone depending on the customer's situation

Identifying situations that could potentially lead to disputes, chargebacks or negative customer experiences

Looking for solutions instead of simply forwarding problems

Escalating important or unusual situations when necessary

Keeping customer communication organized and accurate

Learning from previous cases and improving your decision-making over time

Providing feedback when you notice recurring customer issues or operational problems

As the business grows, responsibilities may expand.



You are someone who:



Has excellent written English

Your English should feel natural, professional and human.



Has strong social intelligence

You understand tone, emotion and context. You know when to be warm and empathetic and when to be concise and solution-focused.



Can follow instructions extremely well

We work with systems, templates, prompts and clear processes. Attention to detail is very important.



Can also think independently

We do not want someone who becomes stuck as soon as a situation is slightly different from the SOP.



Takes ownership

When you see a problem, your first instinct should be: How can I solve this?



Is calm under pressure

E-commerce customer service sometimes means dealing with frustrated or emotional customers. You should be able to remain professional and solution-oriented.



Understands the bigger picture

Customer support is not only about answering an
. Every interaction affects our reputation, customer retention, disputes, reviews and long-term brand value.



Is reliable

If you say something will be done, we need to know that it will actually be done.



Wants to improve

We expect you to learn from feedback, become faster, make better decisions and continuously improve your work.



Experience

Previous customer support experience is strongly preferred, especially within e-commerce or Shopify-based businesses.



Experience with areas such as:



Shopify

Order tracking

Refunds and returns

Payment disputes / chargebacks

Customer service platforms

International e-commerce

is a strong advantage.



However, your way of thinking, communication skills, reliability and ability to learn are even more important to us than having worked with every tool before.



Growth Opportunity

We are not hiring with the intention of keeping this role small forever.

We are building for scale.

As the company grows, there may be opportunities to take on additional responsibility such as:



Improving customer service systems and SOPs

Quality-checking customer conversations

Training new customer support employees

Managing escalations

Monitoring customer support performance

Identifying recurring problems within the business

Helping build and eventually manage a larger customer support operation



Someone who joins us today as a strong Customer Support Specialist could potentially grow into a Senior Customer Support, Customer Experience or Team Lead position as the company expands.



Growth within our company will always be based on performance, ownership and capability.



What Working With Us Looks Like



We value:



Ownership over excuses.

Thinking over blindly following scripts.

Consistency over occasional great performance.

Solutions over problems.

Long-term growth over short-term thinking.



We will give you clear guidelines and systems to work with.



In return, we expect you to take your role seriously, think critically and treat the business and our customers with care.



How to Apply



How to Apply



Please record a short video and send it directly to Chadine. In the video, introduce yourself and explain what makes you a strong fit for this role.



Please cover the following:



A short introduction about yourself and your previous experience.

Your experience with customer support and/or e-commerce.

The customer support and e-commerce tools you have worked with.

Your availability.

Your expected hourly rate.

Why you are looking for a long-term position.

An example of a difficult customer situation you handled and how you resolved it.



The video does not need to be professionally edited, we simply want to get to know you, understand your experience, and learn why you believe you would be suitable for this position.



Important: At the end of your application, please write the word PEARL so we know you have read the entire job description.

We are looking for someone who wants more than just another freelance task or temporary customer service job.

We are looking for someone who can become a reliable long-term part of the company we are building.
