title: SaaS Product Explainer Video Editor / Motion Graphics Animator
description:
We are looking for a talented video editor / motion graphics animator to create a polished 60–75 second SaaS product explainer video for Paid360.ai.

Paid360 is an AI-powered accounts receivable platform that connects with QuickBooks and helps businesses identify overdue invoices, prepare customer follow-ups, track promises to pay, disputes, partial payments, and manage the collection process.

This is NOT a generic animated explainer video. We want a premium SaaS-style product demo using our actual software interface as the main visual.

The video will be used when visitors click “See How It Works” on our website.

What we need:

- 60–75 second finished video

- Professional motion graphics and transitions

- Animation of our actual Paid360 dashboard/interface

- Smooth cursor movements, screen zooms, highlights, and UI animations

- Voiceover synchronized with the product demonstration

- Background music and sound design

- Text overlays for important moments

- Ability to subtly animate our AI assistant “Sarah”

- Professional editing suitable for a premium SaaS homepage

- Final versions optimized for website use

The basic story of the video:

1. The Problem

Open with the pain: business owners wasting time chasing customers for overdue invoices.

2. Meet Paid360

Introduce Paid360 as an AI-powered accounts receivable assistant.

3. QuickBooks “Aha” Moment

This is extremely important.

Show the user clicking Connect QuickBooks and then visually show invoices automatically populating inside Paid360.

We want the viewer to immediately understand:

“I don't have to manually enter anything. Paid360 already knows who owes me money.”

Show overdue invoice amounts, days overdue, customer names and total outstanding A/R appearing in the dashboard.

4. Meet Sarah

Show Sarah, our AI assistant, analyzing an overdue invoice and recommending what should happen next.

5. Sarah Creates the Follow-Up

Show Sarah reviewing things such as the outstanding balance, days overdue, payment history, previous communication and customer activity, then preparing an appropriate follow-up
.

6. Major Trust Moment — Human Approval

This is another extremely important part of the video.

Show the message entering a Ready for Approval queue.

Display prominently:

YOU STAY IN CONTROL

Nothing is sent without your approval.

Then show the user reviewing the
 and clicking Approve & Send.

7. Customer Responds

Show examples such as:

- “I'll pay Friday” → Paid360 records Promise to Pay

- “We already paid this” → Needs Review

- Customer disputes invoice → Follow-Up Paused

- Partial payment received → outstanding balance automatically updates

8. Paid360 Keeps Working

Demonstrate that Sarah remembers what happened and updates the plan for each invoice.

9. Results

Return to the dashboard and show recovered money, resolved invoices, promises to pay and declining overdue A/R.

Main message:

Less chasing. More getting paid.

10. Call to Action

Finish with:

Stop chasing invoices. Start getting paid.

Connect QuickBooks Free

No credit card required

Nothing is sent without your approval

Paid360.ai

IMPORTANT STYLE REQUIREMENTS

We want approximately 75–80% of the video to feature the actual Paid360 software interface.

Think modern SaaS companies such as Stripe, Ramp, QuickBooks, HubSpot, etc. — clean, premium, smooth and professional.

We do not want:

- Generic cartoon explainers

- Excessive stock footage

- Cheap-looking AI animation

- A long logo introduction

- A video that attempts to explain every feature

The product itself should sell the product.

Sarah should feel like an intelligent AI employee working inside Paid360, not a cartoon mascot. Any animation of Sarah should be subtle and professional.

We will provide:

- Paid360 logo/branding

- Access/screenshots or screen recordings of the interface

- Sarah character/image

- Full scene-by-scene storyboard

- Voiceover script

- Guidance on which sections of the software should be demonstrated

When applying

Please send 2–3 examples of SaaS product demo/explainer videos you have personally created.

We are especially interested in examples involving:

- UI animation

- SaaS dashboards

- Motion graphics

- Screen recordings

- Product walkthroughs

Please also tell us what software you use (After Effects, Premiere Pro, Figma, Screen Studio, etc.) and your estimated turnaround time.

Do not send generic animation samples. We specifically want to see SaaS/product UI animation work.

There may be significant additional Paid360 video work available for the right person.

title: Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor & AI Creative Producer
description:
Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor & AI Creative Producer



Competitor ad recreation • Long-form VSLs • AI UGC • AI doctors/experts • Cartoon ads • Swedish, Danish & English localization



Read this first



We are not hiring someone whose main goal is to make videos look cinematic or aesthetically pleasing.



We are hiring someone who understands that a paid ad has one job: stop the right person, hold their attention, build belief and make them take action.



You should be able to receive a competitor ad, a script or a rough concept and return a complete, conversion-ready creative. That includes reverse-engineering the reference, finding or generating every necessary visual, producing voiceovers, creating captions, editing the video and delivering finished variations for testing.



If you need us to prepare a folder containing every clip before you can begin, this role is not for you.



If you can independently turn a script or reference ad into a finished ad that feels native, credible and built to sell, keep reading.



Who we are



We are a growing direct-response DTC brand in the health and wellness space. Paid social and creative are central to our growth, and we test both short-form ads and long-form VSLs across Meta and other platforms.



We are building an ongoing creative operation rather than hiring a different freelancer for every project. The goal is to find an editor and AI creative producer who learns our products, customers, winning angles and performance data—and becomes more valuable with every batch we produce.



This starts with a lower, paid project volume so we can evaluate the fit on both sides. If your work performs and the collaboration runs smoothly, the volume, responsibility and compensation will increase. The long-term goal is a stable position with ownership over a large part of our creative pipeline.



What you will actually be doing



1. Reverse-engineering and recreating winning ads



We actively research ads that are working in other markets and for adjacent or competing products. You will often receive a reference ad and be asked to rebuild it for our product and market.



This is not blind copying. Your job is to identify why the original works and preserve those conversion-driving elements while replacing the brand, product, claims, language, visuals and market context.



You must be able to break down and recreate:



The hook and first three seconds



Script structure and sales psychology



Pacing, cuts and pattern interrupts



Visual sequence and shot selection



Demonstrations and mechanism explanations



Proof, testimonials and credibility elements



Captions, on-screen text and callouts



Voiceover style, energy and timing



Music, sound design and emotional shifts



Offer presentation and call to action



Some assignments will require a close, shot-by-shot recreation. Others will require you to preserve the underlying structure while producing an original execution for our brand.



You may receive only the reference ad, product information and a few brand assets. You are expected to solve the rest independently.



2. Localizing ads into Swedish, Danish and English



You will recreate and localize ads for Swedish-, Danish- and English-speaking markets.



Localization does not mean translating every sentence word for word. The finished ad must sound as if it was originally written and produced for that market.



You will be responsible for:



Adapting scripts, hooks and CTAs into natural market-specific language



Preserving the meaning, rhythm and persuasion of the original



Adjusting examples, currency, cultural references and terminology when necessary



Creating or sourcing suitable native-sounding voiceovers



Timing the edit around the localized voiceover rather than forcing a translation into the original timing



Producing accurate subtitles and on-screen text in each language



Flagging awkward or questionable wording before production



Native-level Swedish or Danish is a strong advantage. If you are not fluent, you must have a reliable localization workflow and be comfortable working with approved translations and feedback from native speakers.



3. Producing long-form VSLs



You must be comfortable editing sales videos from approximately 2 to 10+ minutes—not only 15-second social clips.



We provide the script or a proven reference. You turn it into a video that holds attention throughout the entire argument.



That includes:



Mapping a visual plan to every section of the script



Finding or creating enough visual variety to prevent retention from collapsing



Using cuts, zooms, graphics, captions and pattern interrupts intentionally



Visualizing problem and solution mechanisms clearly



Building emotional story sequences rather than placing random stock clips over narration



Introducing the product at the correct point in the story



Showing proof, demonstrations, testimonials, reviews and offer elements credibly



Creating visual callbacks and open loops



Maintaining consistent pacing across several minutes



Delivering different hooks or openings for the same proven body when requested



You need to understand that a long-form VSL cannot feel like a slideshow. Every shot must help explain, prove, intensify or move the story forward.



4. Sourcing footage independently



You will be responsible for finding the footage required by the script.



Sources may include:



Licensed stock libraries



Creator or UGC footage that is cleared for commercial use



Organic social content used as a research reference and then recreated appropriately



Product footage supplied by us



Screen recordings



Public-domain or properly licensed archival footage



AI-generated images and video



Custom graphics, animations and mechanism visualizations



You should know how to research visual references on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and other platforms, identify the exact type of scene the script needs, and then source, license or recreate an appropriate version for commercial use.



You must not simply place random lifestyle clips over a voiceover. If the script says a woman wakes at 2:13 AM, presses the same point near her shoulder blade and opens her laptop, the visuals should communicate that exact moment as convincingly as possible.



5. Generating AI footage and complete AI ads



AI production is a core part of this role, not an occasional bonus.



You must already be able to generate usable commercial footage and know how to fix common AI problems through prompting, reference images, shot design, iteration, compositing, cleanup and upscaling.



Examples of what you may need to create:



Credible doctor, physiotherapist or expert-style presenters



UGC-style customers speaking naturally to camera



Product demonstrations that cannot be filmed practically



Medical or anatomical mechanism visualizations



Before-and-after scenarios without misleading viewers



Consistent characters appearing across multiple scenes



Story-driven scenes in homes, offices, clinics and everyday environments



AI product shots and controlled product placement



Animated explainer sequences



Cartoon and character-led ads



Talking avatars, lip-sync and multilingual versions



Visual metaphors for pain, pressure, stress, sleep or relief



Complete ads produced primarily or entirely with AI



The output cannot look like low-effort AI content. Characters, environments, clothing, product details, lighting and visual style should remain consistent. Motion must feel intentional, and obvious generation errors must be corrected before delivery.



6. Producing UGC, expert, cartoon and other ad formats



We test many formats. You should not be limited to one editing style.



You may be asked to produce:



Native UGC and testimonial-style ads



Doctor or expert advertorial videos



Founder or spokesperson videos



Podcast-style ads



Interview and street-interview concepts



Long-form personal discovery stories



Problem–mechanism–solution VSLs



Listicle and advertorial creatives



AI cartoon stories



Animated explainers



Product demonstration ads



Before-and-after narratives



Short hook-first ads



Static-to-video and image-led ads



Competitor recreations and new variations of existing winners



You should understand how the format changes the viewer's expectations. A native UGC ad should not feel like a polished television commercial, and an expert video should not feel like an obviously fake authority endorsement.



7. Creating captions, graphics, audio and final deliverables



You own the complete post-production process.



This includes:



Accurate subtitles with intentional emphasis



Clean, readable on-screen text for mobile viewers



Kinetic text and callouts where useful



Proper audio levels and voice cleanup



Music and sound design that support the emotional pacing



Colour correction across mixed footage



Removing unwanted text or branding when legally and technically appropriate



Product replacement, tracking and compositing where required



Correct aspect ratios, safe zones, frame rates and export settings



Organized project files and clear version naming



Multiple hooks, CTAs or format variations without rebuilding the entire ad inefficiently



What we need you to understand about direct response



You do not need to be the copywriter, but you must understand the strategy behind the script you are editing.



You should be able to identify:



The target customer and exact problem being called out



The mass desire the ad activates



The problem mechanism: why previous attempts have failed



The solution mechanism: why this approach may work differently



The awareness and sophistication level of the market



The promise, proof, objections and offer



The emotional turning point in the story



Which moments require visual proof rather than generic b-roll



Where retention is likely to drop



Why one hook attracts buyers while another only produces cheap clicks



We want an editor who can challenge a weak visual idea, flag a credibility problem and suggest a stronger way to communicate the same sales point.



Non-negotiable skills



Proven experience editing paid social ads designed to convert



Ability to reverse-engineer and recreate competitor ads accurately



Ability to work from a script or reference without being handed every asset



Strong visual research and independent footage sourcing



Real, current experience with AI image and AI video generation



Ability to maintain character and scene consistency across many AI shots



Ability to edit both short-form ads and long-form VSLs



Strong pacing, storytelling and retention instincts



High-quality subtitles, motion graphics, sound design and audio cleanup



Ability to follow a brief closely while still solving problems independently



Fast and reliable communication



Willingness to receive direct feedback and iterate quickly



Honest use of commercially cleared, licensed, supplied or appropriately generated assets



Ability to follow advertising, disclosure and platform rules: synthetic presenters must never be passed off as real doctors, customers or independent experts, and testimonials, credentials and results must never be fabricated



Ability to deliver organized source files when requested



Tools



You should be highly capable with professional editing software such as:



Adobe Premiere Pro



After Effects



DaVinci Resolve



CapCut Desktop or an equivalent professional workflow



You should also already use several tools in categories such as:



AI video: Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Higgsfield, Hailuo, Seedance or equivalent



AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Ideogram, Nano Banana or equivalent



Voice and lip-sync: ElevenLabs, HeyGen or equivalent



Cleanup and upscaling: Topaz, Magnific or equivalent



Audio restoration: Adobe Podcast, Descript or equivalent



Text and object removal, tracking and compositing tools



We care more about the quality and consistency of your output than the exact tools you use. However, “I am willing to learn AI” is not enough. You should already be producing AI-assisted ads now.



This role is probably not for you if…



You only edit with footage supplied by the client



Your portfolio is mainly cinematic montages, music videos or organic content with no sales objective



You can make a video look good but cannot explain why it should convert



You rely on random stock footage that does not match the script



You use one-click AI outputs without correcting obvious inconsistencies



You cannot recreate the pacing and visual logic of a reference ad



You only produce short-form videos and avoid long-form projects



You disappear for several days when something is unclear



You miss deadlines without warning



You are an agency planning to pass the work to an undisclosed junior editor



We want direct access to the person who will actually create the videos.



How the collaboration starts



The first stage is a paid trial period with a limited number of projects.



Initial assignments will mainly involve:



Recreating and localizing proven competitor ads



Producing Swedish, Danish or English variations



Editing new hooks onto proven ad bodies



Creating short-form ads from existing scripts



Producing selected long-form VSLs



We will evaluate:



How accurately you understand the reference



Whether you preserve what makes it persuasive



Your ability to source or generate visuals without hand-holding



Speed and communication



Attention to language, product details and brand consistency



How well your finished ads hold attention and convert



How you respond to feedback and improve across iterations



If the fit is strong, the workload and pay will increase. The long-term opportunity is a stable ongoing role with greater ownership, performance-based upside and room to grow into a senior creative or creative-lead position.



What you get



Consistent paid work with room to scale



Access to proven competitor references, scripts and performance feedback



Visibility into important metrics such as spend, hook rate, hold rate, CTR and CPA when available



Fast, direct feedback from a small team



Budget for approved tools or production resources when justified



Performance bonuses for creatives that become meaningful winners



The opportunity to help shape the creative system, not just execute isolated edits



A path toward a stable long-term role if the collaboration performs



How to apply



Please follow these instructions exactly. Applications that ignore them will not be reviewed.



Begin your application with the words: CREATIVE SELLS.



Then include the following:



1. Your portfolio



Send direct links to relevant work—not only a general showreel.



We specifically want to see:



At least one competitor ad recreation; send both the original reference and your version if possible



At least one long-form VSL of 3 minutes or longer



At least one AI-generated ad or scene sequence you produced yourself



At least one UGC-style paid ad



Any cartoon or animated direct-response ad you have made



Examples produced in Swedish, Danish or English, if available



2. A short breakdown of three projects



For three selected examples, explain in no more than three sentences each:



What the goal of the ad was



What you did to hold attention and build belief



Which parts you personally handled



Any results you are allowed to share, such as spend, CPA, ROAS, CTR, hook rate or retention



3. Your AI workflow



Tell us:



Which AI tools you use and what you use each one for



How you maintain the same character across multiple scenes



How you create believable talking experts or UGC characters



One difficult AI-video problem you solved and how you solved it



Whether you can place a specific product accurately into generated scenes



4. Your recreation process



In a short paragraph, explain how you would approach this assignment:



You receive a five-minute competitor VSL, our product page and a Swedish script. No footage is supplied. Explain how you would turn it into a finished Swedish ad.



5. Your availability and rate



Include:



Your time zone



Your normal working hours



Your realistic weekly capacity for short-form ads



Your realistic weekly capacity for long-form VSLs



Typical turnaround time for a five-minute competitor recreation



Typical turnaround time for a ten-minute VSL when the script and voiceover are supplied



Your price per short-form ad



Your price per finished minute or project for long-form VSLs



Your preferred monthly retainer once the volume becomes consistent



Whether you are available for a paid trial project



6. Your role and setup



Confirm whether you are:



A solo editor doing the work personally



Part of a team



An agency



If anyone else will touch the projects, explain exactly who they are and what they will do.



Paid trial project



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid test based on a real assignment. The test may involve recreating a short section of a reference ad, sourcing or generating the required visuals, localizing captions and delivering a finished vertical video.



We will judge the test on:



Accuracy to the reference



Strength of the first three seconds



Visual relevance to the script



Pacing and retention



AI consistency and realism



Caption and audio quality



Language accuracy



Attention to product details



Speed, communication and organization



This is an execution role with significant creative responsibility. We are looking for someone who can study what is already working, understand why it works and rebuild it at a high level for new products, languages and markets.



If that sounds like the type of work you want to own, send your application.

title: Google Ads + Landing Page + GHL Funnel Specialist
description:
We are looking for someone to take ownership of the digital marketing funnel for an established home theatre and home technology business in Sydney, Australia.



This is NOT just a Google Ads media buyer role.



We need someone who can manage the complete journey:



Google Ads → Landing Page → Form/Phone Lead → CRM → Follow-Up → Qualified Lead → Sale



Our main service is complete custom home cinema builds, generally worth around $10,000–$50,000+, so we care much more about qualified leads and actual sales than cheap clicks or cheap leads.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



Google Ads



* Manage and optimise Google Search campaigns

* Review search terms regularly

* Add negative keywords

* Improve keyword targeting and match types

* Monitor spend, CPC, CTR, conversions and lead quality

* Test headlines, descriptions and offers

* Know when to make changes and when to leave campaigns alone

* Move budget toward campaigns/keywords producing the best opportunities

* Continuously improve traffic quality rather than simply increasing traffic



Landing Pages / Website



* Build and improve landing pages

* Create landing pages for different services/campaigns when required

* Improve conversion rates

* Update website pages, forms, CTAs and content

* Make sure landing pages clearly match the intent of the Google search/ad

* Test different messaging, layouts and offers



Tracking & Attribution



* Set up Google Ads conversion tracking correctly

* Google Tag Manager

* GA4

* Form tracking

* Phone call tracking

* Ensure conversions are not double counted

* Track campaign/keyword/source information into the CRM where possible

* Troubleshoot tracking issues

* Help us understand exactly which marketing is producing qualified leads and sales



GoHighLevel / CRM



* Build and manage pipelines

* Connect website and landing page forms

* Create lead follow-up automations

* SMS/email automations

* Lead notifications

* Capture lead source and campaign attribution

* Help track leads through Qualified → Quote → Won/Lost



WHAT WE CARE ABOUT



Our main KPIs are:



* Qualified Leads

* Cost Per Qualified Lead

* Quotes Generated

* Sales

* Customer Acquisition Cost

* Revenue / ROAS



We still monitor CTR, CPC, conversion rate and CPL, but we do NOT want someone optimising only for cheap clicks or cheap leads.



We want someone who understands the difference between:



Traffic → Lead → Qualified Lead → Sale



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



You should have strong experience with:



* Google Search Ads

* Search term optimisation

* Negative keywords

* Google Tag Manager

* GA4

* Conversion tracking

* Call tracking

* GoHighLevel

* CRM automations

* Landing page creation

* Website/form integrations

* Lead attribution

* Conversion rate optimisation



You need to be proactive.



We do not want someone who checks the account occasionally and sends a generic monthly report.



We want someone who pays attention to the account, regularly reviews what people are actually searching, identifies wasted spend, improves the funnel and communicates what should be changed and why.

title: Content Marketer With Video Editing Skills
description:
## About Us  

We are a fast-growing social media and content marketing agency that helps brands, podcasts, and founders turn attention into leads. Our work spans podcast repurposing, short-form video, social media growth, newsletters, and full-funnel content systems.



This is not a traditional video editor role.



We are looking for someone who understands content first and editing second. Someone who has worked in social media, understands why content performs, and uses editing as a tool to make ideas land harder.



If your strength is fancy transitions or cinematic effects, this role is not a fit. If your strength is knowing what to clip, how to frame it, and why someone would stop scrolling, keep reading.



##The Role



Think of this role as a content marketer who edits.



You will be responsible for shaping raw conversations into short-form content that performs. That means d
 what moments matter, how they should be framed, and how to edit them so the message is clear, engaging, and watchable.



Editing skills are required. Content judgment matters more. 



## What You’ll Do  

- Watch and listen to long-form content to identify moments worth turning into clips.

- D
 what should be edited, not just how it should be edited.

- Turn raw conversations into clear, compelling short-form content people actually want to watch.

- Shape clips using pacing, framing, and structure rather than heavy effects.

- Create strong hooks in the first few seconds using insight, context, or contrast.

- Improve clips by tightening the message, sharpening the point, or reframing the moment.

- Research what works for different audiences and platforms to guide clip selection and structure.

- Work closely with our strategy team to align content with growth and marketing goals.



## What We’re Looking For  

- Proven experience editing for social media (please share examples/portfolio).  

- Ability to identify and create viral hooks.

- Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, and emotional engagement.  

- Knowledge of current social media trends and platform-specific best practices.  

- Research-driven: knows how to study an audience, industry, or trend to inform edits.  

- Proficiency in video editing software (Premiere Pro is preferred).  

- Bonus: experience with motion graphics, memes, or creative overlays.  



## Who You Are  

- Ability to think critically about content and suggest better angles or moments.

- Creative and curious, always testing new styles and approaches.  

- A strong sense of taste. You can recognize a great moment instantly.

- Detail-oriented but fast, balancing quality with turnaround time.  

- Understanding of storytelling, attention, and audience behavior.

- Flexible in editing style, able to adjust for different clients and audiences.  

- Proficiency in Premiere Pro or similar tools.

- Experience editing for social media, with examples that show good judgment, not just clean edits.



##Who You Are

-You care more about whether a clip is worth watching than how polished it looks.

-You naturally think in hooks, moments, and angles.

-You see editing as a form of storytelling and decision-making, not just technical execution.

-You are confident enough to say, “This part won’t work, but this one will.”

-You understand that good content beats perfect edits.



## Why Join Us  

- Work with a team that values creativity and results.  

- Get exposure to a variety of clients and industries.  

- Grow with a company that is scaling quickly in social media and digital marketing.  

- Remote, flexible work with opportunity for long-term growth.  



## How to Apply  

Send examples of short-form content you have worked on and a short explanation of why you chose those moments. We care more about your thinking than your effects. Applications without examples or notes will not be reviewed

Writing scripts and detailed creative briefs

Eugene Schwartz's 5 Stages of Awareness

Market Sophistication

Customer desires and mass desires

Hooks, angles and mechanisms

Direct-response copywriting

Customer research

Creative testing and iteration

Why did this hook work?



Why did people respond to this angle?

That's the type of thinking we want on our team.

Once you've done a couple, it's the same repeatable process for every template. All future listing mockups (new templates, bundles, seasonal updates) will also follow this new style going forward

- **Reference:** browse my current Etsy shop here: 
 to see the current listings (these are what's being upgraded, so treat them as context, not the target). Whatever the new style looks like, it should stay clean and practical, matching a genuine spreadsheet/planner aesthetic — not flashy, trendy, or AI-generated-looking graphics

**Pinterest:**

- Design pins in Canva using my brand templates (static + video pins)

Requirements

title: Paid Search Manager
description:
We sell industrial automation components — VFDs, motors, gearboxes, clutches, and brakes — across four websites: three e-commerce stores and one content. Every customer finding us today found us organically. You will be building the paid program from the ground up.



Why this role exists

Our growth has come entirely from organic search and inbound phone quotes. That works, but it caps how fast we can move and leaves us blind to a large pool of buyers searching for parts we stock and can ship the same week.

We are not looking for someone to inherit a mature account and shave 8% off CPCs. We are looking for someone who can stand up measurement, build clean product feeds from our WooCommerce catalogs, prove out paid search with a controlled test budget, and then scale it.



What you will own

First: measurement. GA4 is installed. That is where our instrumentation ends. There is no conversion tracking on orders, forms, or phone calls. You will build all of it — and because a meaningful share of our revenue closes over the phone after a web-sourced quote request, you will need to think seriously about call tracking and offline conversion import, not just checkout events.



Then: the accounts. Google Ads and Shopping across three storefronts, plus whatever role the two content sites play in the funnel. Campaign structure, feed hygiene, negative keyword discipline, bidding strategy, budget allocation across sites.



Ongoing: the number. Paid search here has to clear a target ROAS of roughly 3:1 to be worth scaling. That is the metric you will be measured against. Online orders are the primary conversion; quote requests and calls are a secondary signal we want tracked and valued honestly, not ignored because they are harder to attribute.



Budget: We are starting with a test budget and scaling it against proven returns rather than committing to a fixed monthly spend up front. If you need a large budget on day one to demonstrate value, this is not the right fit. If you like the idea of a budget that grows because you earned it, read on.

title: CUSTOMER SERVICE SPECIALIST – SHOPIFY APPAREL / E-COMMERCE
description:
CUSTOMER SERVICE SPECIALIST – SHOPIFY APPAREL / E-COMMERCE (DO NOT APPLY PLEASE IF YOU DON'T HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH COMMSLAYER MOST BE VERY GOOD AT IT. THANKS FOR UNDERSTANDING



Starting Salary: $600 USD/month



Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM



Salary Increase After 3 Months Based on Performance





ABOUT THE POSITION



We are looking for an experienced Customer Service Specialist who has worked directly with Shopify apparel/e-commerce brands.



This is NOT a general customer service position.



We are NOT looking for someone who has only worked in call centers, restaurants, hotels, telecommunications, or other types of customer service.



You must already have real experience working inside Shopify stores and handling the specific type of customer service described below.



You must have a minimum of 3–5 years of relevant experience.



If you do not have experience with these exact requirements, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.





REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You MUST have hands-on experience with:



• Shopify stores

• Shopify apparel/e-commerce brands

• Gmail

• Returns and refunds directly inside Shopify

• Shopify order management

• Shopify order notes

• Unfulfilled orders

• Tracking numbers

• Tracking synchronization issues

• Working with sourcing agents for orders problematics 

• Customer complaints

• Refund requests by customers 

• Replacement requests by customers 

• Chargebacks

• Commslayer app (IS A MOST)





COMMSLAYER EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must already have hands-on experience using Commslayer.



You need to understand how the app works and how to properly organize customer conversations inside the system.



You should understand the different functionalities available inside Commslayer, including its AI capabilities.



You must already know how to use the system efficiently.



If you have never worked with Commslayer, DO NOT APPLY.



We are looking for someone who already knows the software and can start working without basic training.





SHOPIFY EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must already know how to work directly inside Shopify.



You should be comfortable handling situations such as:



• Customer requests a refund

• Customer requests a replacement

• Customer says an order has not arrived

• Order is showing as unfulfilled

• Tracking number is missing

• Tracking number did not synchronize from the sourcing agent

• Tracking information is incorrect

• Customer received the wrong product

• Customer received the wrong size or color

• Product is damaged

• Customer wants to return a product

• Customer claims they never received the package



You should already understand what actions need to be taken inside Shopify and how to document important changes using order notes.





CUSTOMER SERVICE + COMPANY FINANCIALS



This is extremely important.



We do NOT want someone who simply gives the customer whatever they ask for.



We want someone who understands how to make the customer happy while also protecting the company's money.



You need to understand that every refund, replacement, reshipment, discount, and customer-service decision has a financial impact on the company.



You should understand:



• Refund rates

• Chargeback rates

• The financial impact of excessive refunds

• The financial impact of unnecessary replacements

• How to handle difficult customers without unnecessarily losing money

• When it makes sense to refund

• When it makes sense to replace

• When another solution is better

• How to protect the company's interests while still providing excellent customer service



The goal is not to say YES to every customer.



The goal is to find the right solution for the customer while protecting the company.





HUMAN CUSTOMER SERVICE



We do NOT want robotic customer service.



You need to understand the situation before responding.



Customers should feel that they are speaking with a real person who understands their problem.



You need to know how to:



• Listen

• Understand the real problem

• Communicate clearly

• Show empathy

• Solve problems quickly

• Keep customers satisfied

• Stay professional with difficult customers

• Protect the company at the same time



You should be able to make good decisions instead of simply following scripts.





ORGANIZATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You must be extremely organized.



You will be dealing with a large number of customer conversations, orders, refunds, returns, replacements, tracking issues, and other problems.



You need to know how to keep everything organized and make sure nothing gets forgotten.



You should naturally be someone who:



• Keeps track of open problems

• Follows up when necessary

• Documents important information

• Adds Shopify order notes when changes happen

• Keeps conversations organized

• Does not lose track of customers

• Does not need to be constantly reminded what to do

• Takes initiative when something needs to be solved





INITIATIVE IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



We want someone who sees a problem and takes action.



If you notice an order has been unfulfilled because the tracking number from the sourcing agent did not synchronize, you should already know what to investigate and what steps to take.



You should not simply wait for someone else to tell you what to do.



We want someone who thinks ahead, solves problems, and takes ownership of their work.





SPEED + ACCURACY



We work with a high volume of customer requests.



You need to work quickly without becoming careless.



We want someone who can handle a large workload while maintaining:



• Accuracy

• Organization

• Good communication

• Good judgment

• Fast response times



You should not work like a robot just trying to close tickets.



You need to understand what is happening and make the correct decision.





LEARNING FROM MISTAKES



Nobody is perfect.



Mistakes can happen.



What matters is that you learn from them.



If you make a mistake, you need to understand why it happened, correct it, and make sure you do not keep making the same mistake.



We want someone who improves over time and takes responsibility for their work.





WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who:



• Has 3–5+ years of highly relevant experience

• Has worked specifically with Shopify apparel/e-commerce brands

• Has hands-on Shopify experience

• Has Commslayer experience

• Has Gmail experience

• Understands returns and refunds

• Understands chargebacks

• Understands Shopify order management

• Understands tracking and fulfillment problems

• Understands how sourcing-agent tracking works

• Is extremely organized

• Has strong initiative

• Works fast

• Speaks and writes very good English

• Provides human customer service

• Understands customer psychology and expectations

• Understands how to protect company finances

• Takes ownership

• Learns from mistakes

• Wants to grow with the company long term

• Has genuine passion for customer service





DO NOT APPLY IF



• You have less than 3 years of relevant experience

• You have never worked directly with Shopify stores

• You have only worked in general customer service

• You have worked mainly in call centers

• You have no Shopify apparel/e-commerce experience

• You have never used Commslayer

• You do not understand Shopify returns and refunds

• You have never handled Shopify orders directly

• You have never dealt with fulfillment/tracking issues

• You are not extremely organized

• You need constant supervision

• You do not understand the financial impact of refunds and replacements

• You simply give customers whatever they ask for

• You provide robotic/scripted customer service

• You are slow

• You do not take initiative

• You repeatedly make the same mistakes

• You are looking for a short-term position



PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU HAVE REAL, HANDS-ON EXPERIENCE WITH THE SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS ABOVE.

title: Paid Media Buyer – Meta & Google (E-commerce Focus)
description:
BEFORE YOU APPLY — KNOCKOUTS (must be YES)

1. Are you willing to work over 40 hours a week? YES

2. Are you willing to work over the weekend? YES

3. Are you completely fluent in English (written and spoken)? YES



# Paid Media Buyer – Meta & Google (E-commerce Focus)

**Connect Social · Full-time · Remote (Worldwide) · Mid–Senior**



Connect Social is a performance marketing partner for e-commerce and DTC brands. We've worked with 120+ brands across subscription, established DTC, celebrity/creator, and high-stakes niches including politics. We run paid media, email/SMS, CRO, creative, and influencer under one roof — which means the media buyer here isn't handed a black box. You see the whole funnel, and you're accountable for what happens in it.



We're hiring one senior Paid Media Buyer. Location is open globally. English must be completely fluent (written and spoken). This is a high-output remote seat: we expect people who can sustain **40+ hours/week** and are **willing to work weekends** when accounts or launches need it. If that is not a hard yes, do not apply.



## Before you apply — answer these (must be YES to both)

1. Are you willing to work over 40 hours a week?

2. Are you willing to work over the weekend?



If either answer is no, this role is not a fit. Applications that do not confirm both will be declined.



## What you will own

- Full ownership of a book of e-commerce accounts on Meta and Google — strategy, build, launch, optimization, and the number at the end of the month

- Media planning and budget allocation across platforms, tied to blended targets, not in-platform vanity metrics

- Structured creative testing: writing briefs, reading results, and telling our creative team what to make next based on data — not taste

- Feed and Shopping health on the Google side, including PMax, brand/non-brand separation, and search term hygiene

- Measurement integrity: CAPI, server-side tracking, and reconciling platform-reported numbers against actual business results

- Client-facing reporting and calls — presenting performance, defending decisions, and telling a founder the truth when a month goes sideways

- Diagnosing accounts that are underperforming and having a specific point of view on why, backed by evidence



## Non-negotiable qualifications

Read this section carefully. If you don't clear these bars, this role isn't the right fit.



- **English:** Completely fluent in English (written and spoken). Client calls and Slack are in English.

- **Hours:** Willing and able to work **40+ hours/week** and **weekends** when needed. Overlap with US Eastern business hours for client calls is required.

- **Scale:** You've personally managed at least $5M+ in lifetime ad spend, or you're currently running $200K+/month sustained across your book of accounts. Not agency-wide spend you were adjacent to — spend you had your hands in.

- **Tenure:** 3+ years buying media specifically for e-commerce/DTC. Lead gen, B2B, and app install experience is fine as a supplement, but it isn't a substitute.

- **Both platforms:** Deep, current, hands-on experience in both Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads. Not "I've dabbled in Google." We need someone who can build a PMax campaign and fix a broken product feed without escalating it.

- **Business math:** You're fluent in blended ROAS, MER, contribution margin, CAC, AOV, and LTV. You understand why a 2.1x in-platform ROAS can be a great month or a disaster depending on the P&L, and you can explain which one it is.

- **Measurement:** You've implemented or overseen server-side tracking and CAPI. You've worked with a third-party attribution tool (Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar) and you know where those numbers lie.

- **Creative literacy:** You can look at 40 ads and tell us which 3 to scale, which 5 to iterate, and why. You understand that creative is the primary targeting lever, and you can brief it clearly.

- **Receipts:** You can walk us through specific accounts you've scaled — starting point, ending point, what you changed, and what you'd do differently. Real numbers, real timelines.

- **Setup:** Reliable high-speed internet, quiet space for client calls, and your own computer capable of running Ads Manager / Sheets / Meet without friction.



## You'll stand out if you have

- Experience navigating ad account restrictions, policy appeals, and compliance-sensitive verticals

- TikTok and/or Truth Social buying experience

- Experience running incrementality or geo-lift testing

- You've taken an account from healthy to great and pulled one back from the edge — both skills, not just one



## The mentality we are hiring for

Skills can be taught. This part can't.



**You figure it out.** When you hit something you've never seen before — a new platform update, a tracking break, an account structure you didn't build — your first instinct is to go find the answer, not to ask who's handling it. You'll have support here and you'll never be left stranded, but you should be the kind of person who shows up to the conversation with a hypothesis already formed.



**You're a perfectionist about your output.** Nothing leaves your hands that you're not proud to put your name on. No typos in ad copy. No mismatched UTMs. No report with a number that doesn't tie out. If it's 90% done, it's not done, and you know the difference between the two without being told.



**Your attention to detail is uncomfortable.** You're the person who notices the landing page headline doesn't match the ad, catches the duplicated audience exclusion, and spots the $400 spending in a paused-but-not-really-paused ad set. Small things compound in this job. Missing them costs real money.



**You're relentlessly curious.** You're reading changelogs, testing things in your own accounts, and following what's actually working right now — not what worked in 2023. This industry rewrites itself every six months and you find that energizing rather than exhausting.



**You own the outcome.** When a campaign underperforms, you show up with the diagnosis and the plan before anyone asks. You don't hide behind the algorithm, iOS, or a bad creative cycle. You also speak up early when something isn't working — bad news travels fast here, and that's by design.



**You operate independently.** We're remote. Nobody is watching your calendar. You manage your own priorities, hit your own deadlines, and communicate proactively enough that no one has to chase you for a status update.



**You care about the client's business, not just the account.** Our clients aren't campaign IDs. Your success is measured by whether their business grew — and we treat their success as our own.



## How to apply

1. Confirm in your application / cover note that you answer **YES** to both: (a) willing to work 40+ hours/week, and (b) willing to work weekends.

2. Include your LinkedIn (or portfolio), location/timezone, and 2–3 account receipts (spend scale + outcomes — anonymized is fine).

3. Apply through the board where you found this post.



Connect Social · Remote worldwide · Full-time

title: Dispatcher — Fleet Roadside & Mobile Repair Operations
description:
National Fleet Network (NFN) is hiring reliable dispatchers to support our growing roadside and mobile repair network in the United States.



We are looking for 1–2 dispatchers to provide coverage across both daytime and overnight operations.



This role involves coordinating service calls between fleet customers, drivers, technicians, and our internal operations team. You must be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where clear communication, urgency, and good judgment are important.



Pay



$4–$6 USD per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.



Long-term opportunity for strong performers as the company grows.



Available Shifts



We are hiring for:



* Day Shift

* Night / Overnight Shift



Exact schedules will be discussed during the interview.



Applicants should clearly state which shift they are applying for and their availability.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Receiving incoming roadside and fleet service requests

* Gathering accurate vehicle, driver, location, and repair information

* Determining the type of technician or service needed

* Contacting and dispatching available technicians

* Monitoring technician acceptance and ETA

* Keeping customers updated throughout the service call

* Following up with technicians while jobs are in progress

* Escalating urgent or unusual situations appropriately

* Updating job information and notes in our dispatch system

* Coordinating parts or repair information when needed

* Making outbound calls to technicians and customers

* Helping ensure jobs are completed and properly documented

* Maintaining professional communication with fleet customers and technicians



Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is highly preferred:



* Trucking dispatch

* Roadside assistance

* Mobile mechanic dispatch

* Diesel repair

* Automotive repair

* Heavy-duty truck repair

* Fleet maintenance

* Towing dispatch

* Logistics or transportation operations



Automotive or diesel knowledge is a major advantage.



You do not need to be a mechanic, but you should ideally understand common terms such as:



* No-start

* Battery / alternator issues

* Tire failures

* Air leaks

* Brake problems

* Cooling system issues

* Check-engine or fault codes

* Fuel system problems

* Trailer issues

* Preventive maintenance

* Basic automotive and diesel components



Requirements



We are looking for someone who is:



* Highly reliable and punctual

* Comfortable speaking English on the phone

* Able to communicate clearly with U.S.-based customers and technicians

* Calm under pressure

* Organized and detail-oriented

* Comfortable making frequent outbound calls

* Able to manage multiple active service calls at once

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at following procedures

* Able to make reasonable decisions without needing constant supervision

* Comfortable using web-based software and communication tools

* Available consistently for the agreed schedule



You must also have:



* Reliable computer

* Stable high-speed internet

* Quality headset

* Quiet working environment

* Backup internet or mobile data preferred



Important



This is an operations position.



There may be periods when several service calls are active at the same time. We need someone who can stay organized, communicate proactively, and keep jobs moving without waiting to be reminded about every step.



Reliability is extremely important. If you are scheduled to work, we need to know that you will be available and ready to handle calls.

title: Ecommerce Customer Service Representative (Shopify)
description:
PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE JOB POST BEFORE APPLYING



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a fast-growing 7-figure DTC eCommerce brand looking for an experienced and exceptional Customer Service Representative to join our team.



This isn't just another customer service job.



We're looking for someone who is driven, adaptable, proactive, and genuinely excited to grow with a company long-term.



We value attitude, work ethic, and the willingness to improve. However, applicants must already have a strong foundation in e-commerce customer service and hands-on experience with the tools required for this role.



IMPORTANT: STRICT EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS



Please read the following requirements carefully before applying.



These are NON-NEGOTIABLE requirements.



1. HANDS-ON SHOPIFY EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



Applicants must have previous hands-on experience using Shopify in an e-commerce customer service role.



You should be comfortable navigating Shopify, reviewing orders, checking customer and order details, and handling basic e-commerce-related tasks.



If you have never used Shopify before, please DO NOT APPLY.



2. PREVIOUS E-COMMERCE CUSTOMER SERVICE EXPERIENCE IS REQUIRED



You must have previous experience working in e-commerce customer service.



We are no longer accepting applicants without prior e-commerce customer service experience.



This role requires individuals who already understand the fundamentals of handling customer inquiries, order concerns, refunds, replacements, shipping issues, and other common e-commerce support scenarios.



If you have no previous e-commerce customer service experience, please DO NOT APPLY.



3. EXPERIENCE WITH AT LEAST ONE CUSTOMER SERVICE PLATFORM IS REQUIRED



You must have hands-on experience using at least ONE of the following customer service or helpdesk platforms:



- Richpanel

- CommsLayer

- Front

- Zendesk

- Gorgias



You should have actual experience using the platform to handle customer inquiries or manage customer support tickets.



Experience with other comparable helpdesk or customer service platforms may also be considered, provided you have genuinely used the platform in a customer support role.



If you have no experience using ANY of the platforms listed above, or any comparable customer service helpdesk platform, please DO NOT APPLY.



AUTOMATIC DISQUALIFICATION



To respect everyone's time, please do not apply if you do not meet the minimum experience requirements outlined above.



Applicants who do not have:



- Hands-on Shopify experience

- Previous e-commerce customer service experience

- Experience using at least one of the required customer service platforms or a comparable helpdesk system



will be automatically declined.



We are looking for experienced candidates who can adapt to our workflows, follow our SOPs, and contribute to the team without requiring training on the fundamentals of e-commerce customer service.



Please be honest about your experience. We value transparency and would rather work with someone who accurately represents their skills and background.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for someone who:



- Has excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and communication skills.

- Has proven experience working in e-commerce customer service.

- Is confident navigating Shopify and customer service platforms.

- Learns quickly and enjoys mastering new systems and processes.

- Is proactive and takes initiative instead of waiting to be told what to do.

- Can work independently with minimal supervision.

- Is resourceful and knows how to find answers before asking for help.

- Accepts feedback professionally and applies it immediately.

- Is adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes continue to improve.

- Is willing to unlearn habits from previous companies and fully adopt our workflows, SOPs, and standards.

- Takes pride in producing high-quality work instead of simply completing a shift.

- Is looking for a long-term opportunity rather than just another VA job.

- Can commit to being fully focused and productive during scheduled working hours.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



The following experience is a plus and will be considered an advantage:



- Experience handling subscription-based e-commerce businesses.

- Experience navigating or using Loop Subscriptions.

- Experience with Checkout Champ.

- Experience with other subscription management platforms.

- Familiarity with subscription cancellations, billing inquiries, subscription modifications, and recurring order management.

- Experience working with multiple e-commerce tools and systems.



These are preferred qualifications, not strict requirements. However, candidates with relevant subscription management experience may be better prepared for some of the responsibilities of this role.



RESPONSIBILITIES



You'll be responsible for:



- Responding to customer
s professionally and empathetically.

- Resolving customer concerns efficiently and accurately.

- Handling order updates, shipping inquiries, refunds, replacements, and product questions.

- Assisting customers with subscription-related concerns, including cancellations, billing questions, and subscription changes.

- Navigating Shopify and relevant customer service systems to investigate and resolve customer issues.

- Following company SOPs while adapting to new processes as the business grows.

- Documenting and managing customer interactions accurately.

- Escalating complex issues when necessary.

- Delivering a consistently excellent customer experience.

- Maintaining high standards of quality, accuracy, and professionalism.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH



- Starting rate: $4 USD/hour.

- New hires will begin on a part-time trial period.

- High-performing team members who consistently demonstrate reliability, initiative, and strong performance will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time position (40–48 hours/week).

- Performance bonuses may be available based on company policies and individual performance. (KPIs)

- Opportunities for additional responsibilities and career growth as the company continues to expand.



We're looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with the company.



Preference will be given to applicants who can make our team their primary work commitment. Applicants with other part-time jobs or client commitments may still be considered, provided they fully disclose these commitments during the application process.



If you currently work with another employer or client, please include the following information in your application:

-Your preferred working schedule with us.

-The days and hours you currently work for your other employer or client.

-Your availability outside of those working hours.



This information will help us assess your availability and determine potential scheduling arrangements if you progress through the interview process.



Please be honest and transparent about your current work commitments. Full disclosure is important to us when evaluating candidates for long-term opportunities with our team.



OUR HIRING PROCESS



We invest heavily in building a strong team, so our hiring process is designed to identify candidates who are willing to learn, follow instructions, and grow with the company.



1. Submit your application.

2. Selected applicants will receive a short application form.

3. Top candidates will be invited for an interview.

4. Successful interviewees will receive access to our learning materials for a self-paced learning period (approximately one week).

5. Before the end of that week, you'll complete a timed mock customer support assessment based on the materials provided.

6. Candidates who successfully pass the assessment will proceed to the paid training stage, with the opportunity to become a long-term member of our team.



Please note:



The evaluation stage is designed to assess your ability to learn, follow SOPs, and apply new knowledge to real-world customer support scenarios.



Only candidates who successfully pass the evaluation stage will move on to paid training.



REQUIREMENTS



- At least 18 years old.

- Fluent in written English.

- Strong grammar, spelling, and communication skills.

- Previous hands-on Shopify experience.

- Previous e-commerce customer service experience.

- Hands-on experience using at least one of the required customer service platforms listed in this post, or a comparable helpdesk system.

- Reliable computer and internet connection.

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Willingness to learn and continuously improve.

- Ability to follow company SOPs and adapt to changing workflows.

- Strong problem-solving skills.



HOW TO APPLY



To confirm that you've read this entire job post, please follow all the instructions below.



1. Include the word PURPLE at the beginning of your application title.



2. Answer the following questions:



- How many years of e-commerce customer service experience do you have?

- How long have you been using Shopify? Briefly describe the tasks you regularly handled in Shopify.

- Which customer service or helpdesk platforms have you used? Please list all the platforms you have hands-on experience with and describe how you used them.

- Have you worked with subscription-based e-commerce businesses? If yes, which subscription platforms have you used?

- What motivates you to do great work?

- Why do you want to work with our company?

- How do you usually handle constructive feedback?

- If you don't know the answer to a customer's question, what would you do?



3. BONUS EXERCISE



A customer sends the following
:



"I've already
ed twice and nobody has helped me. This is honestly very frustrating."



Write the response you would send to this customer.



4. EXPERIENCE VERIFICATION



Please include the following information in your application:



- Your previous e-commerce customer service experience.

- The Shopify stores or types of e-commerce businesses you have worked with.

- The customer service platforms you have used.

- The subscription management tools you have experience with, if any.



Please do not share confidential information from previous employers.



We carefully review every application.



Thoughtful answers, genuine hands-on experience, and attention to detail matter much more than generic responses or years of experience alone.



If you meet all the strict requirements and are confident in your ability to deliver high-quality customer service, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Instagram DM Marketing Expert For Collabs (Lead Gen & Outreach)
description:
Job Title: Instagram Cold DM Marketing Expert for Creator Collaborations (Hourly + $50/Collab Bonus)



About the Role



We're looking for an experienced Instagram DM marketer who knows how to start conversations that convert without torching the account in the process. Your goal is simple: reach out to content creators, build genuine conversations, and land content collaborations for our brand. You'll own our Instagram outreach channel end to end, covering strategy, execution, tracking, and reporting. That includes creating, warming up, and bringing to life the new Instagram accounts that will be used for the cold DMs. This is a hands-on role, and you run it yourself.



What You'll Do



• Create the new Instagram accounts that will be used for cold DM outreach, including profile setup, branding, and positioning so they look like real, active accounts from day one

• Warm up each account properly before any outreach begins: aging, gradual activity increases, and normal engagement patterns

• Post content and bring the accounts to life: feed posts, stories, and reels, plus genuine day-to-day engagement so they stay healthy, active, and credible

• Plan and execute Instagram cold DM outreach campaigns to content creators that generate qualified conversations and booked collaborations

• Build and maintain a prospect list of 20,000 to 30,000 target creator accounts based on criteria we provide (niche, follower range, engagement quality)

• Manage day-to-day engagement: outbound DMs, replies, follow-ups, and story-based nurture. You're the first point of contact creators see, so you represent the brand

• Track reply rates, conversation rates, and collaborations closed, then iterate weekly

• Write and A/B test DM scripts and collab pitches that feel human and personal, not copy-paste spam

• Report results directly to the owner



Requirements (Must-Haves)



• Proven experience managing Instagram cold DM outreach campaigns, with results you can show

• Hands-on experience creating and warming up Instagram accounts for outreach, and keeping them alive with regular posting and engagement so they stay in good standing

• Experience pitching collaborations, partnerships, or ambassador deals to creators is a big plus

• Deep understanding of Instagram's rate limits, automation policies, and what actually keeps accounts in good standing (we want sustainable growth, not account churn)

• Ability to run campaigns independently, start to finish, including account creation, warm-up, and content posting

• Strong written English and conversational instincts, since creator outreach lives or dies on tone

• Familiarity with outreach/CRM tracking (spreadsheet or tool of your choice)

• Be willing to work in controversial niches**



Compensation



• $4.60 USD/hour

• $50 USD bonus per successfully executed collaboration with a content creator (target: 6 completed collabs/month once scaled)

• Part Time (May evolve into full time if we can scale to 50 Instagram accounts to dm people) If we're getting results, we'll ramp it up more and you can take on more responsibility like scheduling and logistics. If you want more work I can always find more for you to do.



How to Apply



Reply to this job post with "IG cold DM genius" in the subject line. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



In your reply, include an answer to only 1 of the following:



• Your experience with Instagram cold DM campaigns: niches, volume, and results (reply rates, leads generated, collaborations or sales closed)

• Your experience creating and warming up Instagram accounts, and how you keep them active and healthy long term

• Any experience specifically pitching creators for collabs, sponsorships, or partnerships

• The tools you've used (automation, scheduling, tracking, CRM)

• How you structure outreach so accounts stay healthy and compliant long-term

• A short example DM opener you'd use to pitch a content collaboration in our niche



You'll be evaluated on your demonstrated ability to manage Instagram DM campaigns and your past results, not generic marketing claims.

title: Video Uploader & Publishing Specialist  – Remote, PH
description:
Love hitting "publish" and watching the numbers start moving? We need you on our team, every single day.



We're a growing YouTube media company running a portfolio of channels, and we publish videos at real volume — multiple uploads a day, across several channels, every day of the week. We're looking for a dedicated YouTube Uploader to own that pipeline: taking finished videos from our editors and getting them live, correctly, on time, every time.

This is not a "set it and forget it" task. You'll be the last checkpoint before a video goes public — the person who catches a wrong thumbnail, a missing tag, or a scheduling mistake before it becomes a problem. If you're the kind of person who double-checks a form before hitting submit, you'll fit right in.



The essentials up front, no guessing:

• 🌏 100% remote / work from home anywhere in the Philippines.

• 🕐 Full-time. Because we publish daily across several channels, this role needs real, consistent daily availability not a squeeze-it-in-when-I-can arrangement. Flexible on when in the day you work, firm on showing up every day.

• 🌐 Fast, stable internet is non-negotiable. You'll be uploading and downloading large video files daily; a slow or unreliable connection bottlenecks the whole pipeline. Please don't apply without it.



What You'll Do

Publishing

• Receive finished videos from editors and upload them to the correct channel, accurately and on schedule

• Write and optimize titles, descriptions, and tags for each video for searchability

• Upload the correct thumbnail per house style for each channel

• Set the right visibility (public/scheduled/premiere), category, language, and captions before publish

• Add end screens and cards, and slot each video into the right playlist(s)

• Do a final quality check correct resolution, aspect ratio, audio, no glitches before anything goes live



Channel & workflow management

• Keep multiple channels organized and consistent, each with its own naming and metadata conventions

• Track every upload in a shared log status, publish time, any issues flagged

• Flag copyright/Content ID claims or community guideline issues immediately

• Coordinate with editors and channel managers so nothing publishes out of order or ahead of schedule

• Handle real volume multiple videos a day, across multiple channels without dropping quality or missing a slot



What You Need

• Fast, reliable internet you can count on daily the single most important requirement for this role

• Full-time availability, every day we publish this is a high-volume role and needs someone with the time to give it consistently

• Comfortable navigating YouTube Studio, or quick to learn it we'll train you

• Meticulous with detail a wrong tag or a mistimed publish is exactly what this role exists to prevent

• Comfortable handling large video files and cloud storage (Google Drive, Dropbox, or similar)

• Decent written English for titles and descriptions

• A reliable computer and a backup plan for power or internet interruptions



Nice to have, not required

• Experience uploading to or managing more than one YouTube channel

• Experience with Multilogin or similar multi-account browser tools





How to Apply:

We're hiring quickly for this one, so please fill out the application form: 





No interview for this role. 



Applicants who complete the steps above and look like a fit go straight to a short paid trial upload task a real, small batch of videos, so you can show us how you work instead of talking about it. Pass the trial, and you're in.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and hire on skill, reliability, and attention to detail alone.



Ready? Apply now! We're filling this role fast.

title: B2B Outbound Lead Prospecting & Sales Specialist (Setter to Closer Path)
description:
Role: B2B Outbound Lead Prospecting & Sales Specialist (Setter to Closer Path)

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday – Friday, Pacific Standard Time (Flexible: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM PST Part-Time or 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST Full-Time)

Start Date: Immediate





Compensation & Career Progression:

We believe in supporting you while you build your pipeline, offering guaranteed baseline pay during onboarding and a transparent pathway to step into a high-earning, full-cycle closing role as you gain experience.



• Stage 1 — Onboarding Setter Track:

o Competitive Guaranteed Base Pay ($3.00 – $3.50+ USD / hour, negotiable based on outbound B2B experience)

o +$30 – $50 bonus for every qualified appointment that turns into a closed deal

o Guaranteed income while you learn our niche, build lead lists, and master the outreach script.

• Stage 2 — Performance Commission (Setting Track):

o Optional Commission-Only Track

o 10% – 12% of project value ($50 – $200+ per deal, based on website scopes starting at $500+) when you source the lead, book the discovery call, and we close the sale.



• Stage 3 — Full-Cycle Closer Track (Promotion Opportunity):

o Optional Commission-Only Track

o Up to 20% – 25% of total project revenue ($100 – $500+ per closed client).

o Unlocked once you master our offer and take over running website audits, sales presentations, and closing client agreements directly.

o Target monthly earnings: $1,200 – $2,500+ USD (uncapped).

• Payouts: Paid on time, bi-weekly via Wise or Revolut.





Job Overview



We build modern, high-converting websites for small and medium-sized local businesses across the United States. We are looking for an ambitious, ethical, and resourceful B2B Sales Specialist.

You will start by identifying local businesses with strong community reputations (4.0+ stars on Google Maps and Yelp) that currently lack an active or modern website, reaching out to owners, and booking them for complimentary digital audits. As you become proficient with our solutions and objections, you will have the opportunity to run the sales calls yourself and close deals end-to-end.



Key Responsibilities



• Reputation-First Prospecting: Search Google Maps and Yelp for established local businesses (contractors, trades, auto services, specialty clinics, local dining) with strong ratings that have no website, broken links, or outdated pages.

• Need Qualification: Verify that the business is active, healthy, and would genuinely profit from an inbound web presence.

• Decision-Maker Discovery: Track down the actual owner or principal decision-maker using public records, social platforms, and brief verification calls.

• Multi-Touch Outreach: Execute cold calls, personalized follow-up emails, and direct messaging using our conversational, non-pushy outreach frameworks.

• Pipeline Management: Schedule qualified business owners onto the discovery calendar, maintain organized CRM records, and prepare to transition into running product walkthroughs and closing deals.

Candidate Requirements

• B2B Cold Outreach Experience: 1+ years of outbound calling, cold outreach, or appointment setting targeting US or North American business owners.

• Conversational English Fluency: Professional, natural verbal communication with clear tonality on US phone lines.

• Consultative Ethics: We sell real solutions to businesses with clear digital gaps—no high-pressure or misleading tactics.

• Growth Ambition: Eager to develop beyond basic appointment setting into a full-cycle sales professional who presents offers and closes contracts.

• Schedule Alignment: Reliable availability during core US Pacific business hours.

Technical Setup Requirements

• Hardware: Dedicated laptop or PC (minimum Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3, 8 GB RAM).

• Connectivity: Stable high-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload) plus a mandatory mobile data / hotspot backup.

• Audio/Video: Dedicated noise-canceling USB headset and a functional webcam for internal team check-ins.

• Environment: Quiet, distraction-free home office setup.



How to Apply



To confirm your attention to detail, include this format in your application exactly as:

[Your Full Name] - Web Sales Specialist - 0904





Submit your application with the following:



1. Your updated resume highlighting your outbound sales and appointment-setting experience.

2. A short (60–90 second) Loom video or audio recording covering:

o How you determine whether a business with no website is actually a good sales prospect.

o How you navigate past gatekeepers to speak directly with the owner.

3. A screenshot of your current internet speed test.

title: CHIEF OF STAFF – FINANCE, HR & TEAM PERFORMANCE

Xero | Spanish Accounting | External Accountant Follow-Up | Recruitment | Shopify



We are an international fashion brand with retail operations in Spain and global wholesale and e-commerce activities.



We are looking for a strong right hand to the founders who combines financial administration, HR, recruitment and daily team follow-up.



This is not a passive administrative role. You will create structure, follow up every commitment and ensure that employees, external accountants and partners deliver accurate work on time.



We need someone with a CHIEF MINDSET: responsible, assertive, organized and focused on results.



Finance & external accountant follow-up



You will not replace our external Spanish accountant. You will be internally responsible for ensuring that the external accountant delivers complete, accurate and timely work.



* Act as the main contact for our external accountant and Spanish gestoría

* Keep Xero and all supporting documentation complete and up to date

* Collect and provide invoices, bank statements, payroll information and other requested documents

* Follow up continuously on missing documents, unanswered questions and overdue work

* Monitor accounting, payroll, VAT, tax and filing deadlines
