VIRTUAL ASSISTANT — QC & DELIVERY SPECIALIST



Company: N & K Real Estate Media Position: Remote Virtual Assistant — QC & Delivery Starting Pay: $5/hour Starting Hours: 20-25 hours per week, with opportunities for additional hours in the future.



 Schedule: Tuesday–Saturday 



Location: Mattoon, IL (Remote)



ABOUT N & K REAL ESTATE MEDIA

N & K Real Estate Media is a professional real estate media company providing professional photography, drone photography and video, virtual tours, video, and other visual media services to real estate agents, property managers, builders, businesses, and other clients.



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant who wants to grow with our company.



The starting position will focus primarily on Quality Control (QC) and Delivery, but this position is intended to grow into a larger role as you become familiar with our systems, standards, and workflow.



Our goal is to develop someone who can eventually take on a lead role within the VA side of our company.



STARTING POSITION: QC & DELIVERY

Your primary responsibility will be to make sure completed photo and video projects meet our quality standards before they are delivered to clients.



You will:

* Download completed projects from our editing platforms.

* Review completed photos and videos for quality and consistency.

* Perform quality control before projects are delivered.

* Make corrections when necessary.

* Upload and organize completed projects in our client delivery system.

* Verify that all services ordered by the client have been completed and delivered.

* Add drone pinpoints above homes in aerial images when required.

* Add lot lines or other required markings when necessary.

* Communicate with editors regarding corrections and revisions.

* Communicate through SMS,
, Slack, Instagram, and other platforms as needed.

* Respond promptly and professionally to messages.

* Make sure projects are delivered accurately and on time.



PHOTO QUALITY CONTROL

We use Auto HDR, an AI-powered photo editing system, as part of our editing workflow.



However, AI does not replace the need for an experienced photo editor.



You will be responsible for carefully reviewing the completed Auto HDR images and identifying anything the AI may have missed or incorrectly edited.



This includes checking for:

* Incorrect or inconsistent color

* Exposure problems

* White balance issues

* Unnatural HDR results

* Editing inconsistencies

* Items that should have been removed

* Grass or landscaping issues

* TV screen replacements

* Bracketed photo editing issues

* Other visual problems that do not meet our standards



You may also need to compare the edited image against the original RAW files to determine whether the final image accurately represents the property.



It is extremely important that you have a strong eye for detail and consistency.



Our goal is not simply to deliver images that have been processed by AI. Our goal is to deliver images that meet the N & K Real Estate Media standard.



ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

As you become comfortable with QC and delivery, additional responsibilities may be assigned, including:



Client Communication

* Responding to client
s and text messages.

* Assisting with client communication and follow-up.

* Helping with client acquisition activities.

* Instagram Method



During available time, you may assist with our social media outreach strategy by:

* Liking posts.

* Commenting on posts.

* Engaging with real estate agents.

* Following potential clients.

* Performing other Instagram outreach activities.



Virtual Assistant Tasks

Additional administrative, organizational, research, communication, or operational tasks may be assigned as needed.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

You should have:

* Strong written and spoken English.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong organizational skills.

* Experience with Adobe Photoshop.

* Experience with Adobe Lightroom.

* Experience reviewing and editing photographs.

* The ability to identify subtle color and editing problems.

* The ability to follow detailed instructions and company standards.

* Reliable communication and responsiveness.

* A fast and stable internet connection.

* A reliable computer capable of handling photo editing.

* The ability to work independently.



Previous QC, photo editing, real estate photography, or project delivery experience is strongly preferred.



EQUIPMENT & INTERNET REQUIREMENTS

You must have:

* A reliable computer suitable for photo editing.

* Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom or equivalent professional editing experience.

* Fast and stable internet.

* A backup plan in case of internet or power failure.



We want to know that you can continue communicating with the team and completing your responsibilities if something goes wrong with your primary internet or power.



TEST PROJECT

If you are selected to move forward in the hiring process, we will provide you with a test project.

The test may include tasks such as:

* Editing bracketed real estate photos.

* Grass screening/replacement.

* Object or item removal.

* Color correction and touch-ups.

* TV screen replacements.

* Drone pinpoints on listing addresses.

* Photo quality control.

* Comparing edited images against RAW files.

* Other tasks related to our real estate media workflow.



The purpose of the test is to determine whether your technical skills, attention to detail, and editing judgment meet our standards.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY

This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person.

You will start primarily with QC and Delivery.

As you gain experience with our systems and demonstrate reliability and accuracy, you can take on additional responsibilities.

More responsibility can lead to:

* More hours.

* Additional duties.

* Increased responsibility within the company.

* Future raises.

* Opportunities to become a lead VA.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with N & K Real Estate Media, rather than someone who is simply looking for a short-term job.



Our goal is to build systems, train people properly, and develop team members who can eventually take ownership of important parts of our operation.



HOW TO APPLY



DO NOT APPLY THROUGH ONLINEJOBS.PH.

Instead, send your application directly to:





IMPORTANT —
 SUBJECT LINE



Your
 subject line MUST contain:

N & K Rocks



Applications that do not follow the subject-line requirement may not be considered.



REQUIRED APPLICATION QUESTIONS

Please answer all three questions in your
:

1. Previous Experience

Do you have any previous job experience in QC and delivery, and are you currently working anywhere else?

Please describe your relevant experience.



2. Availability

What is your current availability, and will you be available to work the requested times?

(We will discuss the specific working hours/time standard during the hiring process.)



3. Equipment & Internet

What is your equipment setup and internet speed? Do you have a backup process if you lose power or internet? If so, what is it?

Please also attach:

* A screenshot of your computer specifications.

* A screenshot of an online internet speed test.

Bonus points if you answer the three questions above in a short video.

You may attach the video to your application or provide a link to the video.

This is completely optional, but it gives us an opportunity to see how you communicate and explain your experience.



PORTFOLIO

* Quality control work

Communicates clearly.

 Follows instructions. 

Takes responsibility for their work. 

Can work independently. 

Wants to learn. 

Wants to grow with the company.



If that sounds like you, send your application to:





Subject: N & K Rocks

Please answer all three required questions, provide your equipment and internet screenshots, and include your portfolio and/or video application if available.



We look forward to hearing from you!

Hey there!



We’re looking for an experienced Senior Chargeback & Dispute Specialist to join our growing USA-focused fashion e-commerce brand.



Our team is based in The Netherlands, while we sell exclusively to customers in the United States. We need someone who can independently manage payment disputes, build strong evidence cases, and help reduce future chargebacks.



This is not an entry-level role. We’re looking for someone with real e-commerce dispute experience who can make an immediate impact.



---



🧠 What We’re Looking For



* At least 1 year of experience handling chargebacks and payment disputes for an e-commerce or fashion dropshipping store.

* Experience working for a store generating at least $100,000 USD per month.

* Proven experience with WHOP Disputes and Shopify Chargebacks.

* Strong experience collecting, organizing, and presenting evidence for disputes.

* A good understanding of chargeback reason codes and dispute procedures.

* Excellent written English.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

* High attention to detail and the ability to work independently.

* Experience with PayPal and Klarna Merchant Portal is a strong advantage.



---



🚀 Your Responsibilities



You will manage the complete chargeback process from start to finish.



Your responsibilities include:



* Reviewing and managing incoming chargebacks and payment disputes.

* Contacting customers where possible to resolve issues before a dispute is finalized.

* Preparing professional dispute responses with strong supporting evidence.

* Submitting disputes through WHOP, Shopify, PayPal, Klarna, and other payment platforms when needed.

* Collecting and organizing order details, tracking information, customer communication, supplier information, and store policies.

* Maintaining accurate dispute documentation, spreadsheets, and internal reports.

* Monitoring dispute trends and identifying recurring issues.

* Working closely with customer support, suppliers, and management to reduce future chargebacks.

* Recommending practical improvements that lower dispute rates and improve the customer experience.



We’re looking for someone who focuses not only on winning disputes, but also on preventing them.



---



📈 What We Expect



* Clear, professional communication and documentation.

* Strong evidence packages that maximize the chance of winning disputes.

* Accurate and organized reporting.

* Ownership and initiative from day one.

* A proactive approach to identifying and reducing recurring chargeback issues.



---



🌱 Growth Opportunity



We are hiring early because we are preparing for further growth.



The position will start with limited hours, allowing you to become familiar with our business and processes. As the company grows and your contribution becomes more valuable, your working hours and hourly rate can grow with us.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term working relationship.



---



📋 How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. What type of e-commerce or fashion dropshipping stores you have worked for.

2. Which countries those stores sold to.

3. The approximate monthly revenue of those stores.

4. How long you worked there and your main responsibilities.

5. Which payment platforms you have experience with, such as WHOP, Shopify Payments, PayPal, Klarna, Stripe, or Airwallex.

6. Your approximate dispute win rate, if available.

7. Why should we choose you? Tell us what experience, value, or ideas you would bring to our business.



Please keep your application clear and honest. We want to understand whether your experience matches what we need.



---



🎥 What to Expect After You Apply



If your experience looks like a potential fit, we will send you a short video introduction.



In this video, you’ll get to know us, our business, how we work, and what we expect from the person joining our team. It gives both sides the opportunity to see whether this role feels like the right fit.



After watching the video, you can share your thoughts with us. If we both feel there is a good match, we will schedule a call to discuss the next steps.



---



⚠️ Important



Only apply if:



* You have read this entire post carefully.

* You meet the experience requirements above.

* You have genuine experience handling e-commerce payment disputes.

* You are ready to work independently and take ownership.

* You are serious about a long-term role.



If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you.

title: YouTube Tutorial Video Editor — Fixed-Price Project, 25 Videos (Spreadsheet Template Business)
description:
Hi, I'm Toni! I run TopSheets, a growing digital product business selling spreadsheet templates (Google Sheets + Excel) on Etsy and my own website. I need a video editor to polish a backlog of around 25 tutorial videos into YouTube-ready content.



This is a fixed-price project, not an ongoing weekly role — I have 25 videos that need the same treatment, and once they're done, the project is complete. Work on your own schedule; there's no weekly task list and no fixed hours. You'll be paid per video as you deliver them.



Every video follows the same format, so once you've done one or two, the rest go quickly — this is repetitive, template-driven work, which is exactly why it's priced and delivered per video rather than by the hour.



What You'll Do



- Polish-edit screen-recording tutorial videos (8–20 min finished). I provide a rough cut with the audio, screen recording, and my talking-head footage already synced and mistakes already removed — your job is to make it YouTube-ready

- Add zoom-ins and highlight callouts on the cells/formulas being discussed as I talk through them

- Light text overlays and pacing polish, matching my existing style (examples provided)

- Clean, simple editing style — NO flashy transitions, NO fast-cut effects. Think calm, clear, helpful — this is educational content, not entertainment

- I handle thumbnails, descriptions, and publishing myself — your job ends at the finished long-form export



Requirements



- Proven video editing experience (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, or similar) — portfolio required

- Comfortable following a consistent style guide closely and repeating a process accurately across many videos

- Strong written English (for reading my notes and any on-screen text)

- Reliable internet and a computer that can edit 1080p video smoothly

- Organized: consistent file naming, uses Google Drive, communicates proactively if something is unclear or delayed

- Bonus (not required): experience editing explainer, tutorial, or software-demo videos



Pay & Process



- **Paid test video:** I'll hire a small number of candidates to each edit one video at a fixed price of $15. This lets me see your work firsthand before committing the full batch. The candidate whose edit best fits my style gets the remaining videos in the project.

- **Full project:** $18 per video, paid as each video is delivered and approved, for the remaining ~24 videos.

- **Delivery:** send me each video as soon as it's done rather than batching them up — I'll review and approve (or request changes) before you move on to the next one.

- **Revisions are part of the job.** If I send back edit notes on a video, I expect those changes made and the revised video delivered before it's considered complete and paid. This is normal and expected — most videos will need at least one small revision round, especially early in the project while you're learning my style.

- This is a one-time project. If it goes well, there's a good chance of similar batches in the future as I release new templates, but I want to be upfront that it isn't an ongoing weekly commitment.



How to Apply



1. Start your application with the word **STORYBOARD** so I know you read this posting.

2. Link 3–5 examples of videos you've edited. At least one should be a tutorial, screen-recording, or explainer-style video if you have one. Tell me in one line what YOU did on each (edited only? added graphics? full production?).

3. In 2–3 sentences, tell me: what's one thing that makes a tutorial video easy to follow?

4. Tell me about a time you had to follow someone else's style guide or brand guidelines closely. How did you make sure you got it right?

5. Tell me roughly how many videos per week you could realistically deliver once you're up to speed, so I can plan the project timeline.



Applications that don't follow these steps will not be considered. Thanks, and I'm excited to meet you!

title: Founder Content Writer / Ghostwriter
description:
Founder Content Writer / Ghostwriter - LinkedIn, X and Newsletter



We are looking for one dedicated writer to become the long-term writing partner to a UK-based founder/operator in e-commerce and social commerce.



This is not a generic social media manager role and it is not high-volume SEO writing. The job is to learn one founder's voice, extract strong ideas from conversations and source material, and turn them into sharp, useful content across LinkedIn, X and a weekly newsletter.



The current content operation already has an audience, source material and a working publishing rhythm. We now want one person who can build context over time, improve the quality and own the writing consistently. You will work directly with the founder and internal team. The role will not be passed between writers.



What you will own:

- A weekly 30-45 minute content interview with the founder

- 4-5 LinkedIn posts per week across different formats

- 1-3 longer article-style X posts or threads per week

- One newsletter per week

- Research, fact-checking and turning company/client insights into useful content without exposing confidential details

- A simple editorial calendar, revisions and a record of what performs

- Repurposing ideas across channels without copying the same post word-for-word



You may be a fit if:

- You have written in a founder, executive or subject-matter expert's voice before

- Your English is excellent and your writing sounds natural, specific and human

- You can interview someone, spot the strongest angle and challenge weak ideas

- You understand the differences between LinkedIn, X and

- You are comfortable writing about e-commerce, marketing, agencies, creator commerce or adjacent business topics

- You are reliable, responsive and want a long-term role with one team



This is not a fit if your experience is mainly generic blogs, AI-generated content, captions or scheduling. Tools can support research and editing, but the thinking, interviewing and final writing must be yours. You must personally write the work; no subcontracting.



To apply, send:

1. Three relevant samples, ideally content ghostwritten for a founder or executive. Explain what you personally wrote.

2. A short note on how you learn and maintain someone's voice.

3. One example of a time you turned an interview, call or rough notes into a strong piece of content.

4. Your location, working hours and availability to overlap with 9am-1pm UK time.

5. Your desired monthly rate within the range shown.



Shortlisted candidates will have a brief interview and a paid work sample using the same source material. Test work will not be published without separate agreement.



This starts with a 6-week paid contract and is intended to become a long-term, full-time role if the fit is strong.





Location: Philippines, remote. Full-time contractor. USD $1,000-$1,600 per month depending on experience and evidence of fit. A reliable daily overlap with 9am-1pm UK time is required; applicants should state the exact hours they can maintain.

title: Recruitment, People & Compliance Administrator – UK Care Home Group
description:
Full-time | Remote | UK working hours



We are a family-run UK care home group looking for an organised, reliable and detail-focused administrator to support recruitment, onboarding and staff compliance across our care homes.



This is a varied role with a strong focus on recruitment, including carrying out initial candidate interviews, and making sure candidates move efficiently from application through to being ready to work.



You will also help maintain accurate staff records, monitor compliance requirements and follow up outstanding actions with candidates, employees and managers.



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates confidently and follows tasks through to completion without needing constant reminders.



Key Responsibilities



Recruitment



Draft and post job adverts across recruitment platforms

Review applications and identify suitable candidates

Carry out initial interviews with shortlisted candidates (e.g. by phone or video call) to assess suitability

Pass suitable candidates to managers, with brief interview notes

Arrange further interviews with managers and candidates

Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process

Maintain recruitment trackers showing vacancies, applicants and outcomes

Follow up candidates and managers to keep vacancies moving

Maintain a pipeline of suitable candidates for recurring care home roles



Onboarding & Pre-Employment Checks



Coordinate the onboarding process for successful candidates

Request and follow up employment references

Assist with right-to-work checks and documentation

Coordinate DBS applications and monitor outstanding checks

Collect required identification and employment documents

Prepare employment documentation and new starter packs

Ensure personnel files are complete before employees start work

Liaise with managers regarding start dates and induction arrangements



Staff Records & Compliance



Keep personnel files complete, organised and up to date

Maintain staff compliance and training trackers

Monitor expiry dates for documents and checks

Maintain records relating to right to work, DBS, references and other employment documentation

Monitor staff training completion and overdue training

Follow up employees and managers where documents, checks or training remain outstanding

Produce simple compliance reports for management

Help ensure staff records remain accurate and consistent



General Administration



Draft letters,
s and basic employment documents

Maintain organised electronic filing systems

Take meeting notes and maintain action trackers

Assist managers with staff-related administrative tasks

Support other recruitment and people-related administration when required



What We're Looking For



Previous recruitment, HR administration, compliance or general administrative experience

Excellent attention to detail

Strong organisational skills

Confident communicating with candidates and employees

Confident carrying out initial interviews and assessing candidate suitability

Good written and spoken English

Comfortable using Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook

Comfortable maintaining spreadsheets, trackers and electronic records

Able to manage multiple vacancies and onboarding cases at the same time

Able to work independently and meet deadlines

Confident following people up when information or actions are outstanding

Proactive and willing to take ownership of tasks

Reliable and discreet when handling confidential staff information



Experience in healthcare, care homes, recruitment, HR administration or compliance would be helpful but is not essential.



This is primarily a recruitment, administration and compliance role rather than an HR advisory role.



Remote Working Requirements



You must have:



Your own reliable laptop or computer

A stable internet connection

A suitable and quiet home-working environment

Availability to work full-time during agreed UK working hours



How to Apply



Please include:



Your CV

A brief summary of why you are interested in the role and why you would be suitable

A short video introduction

Details of your internet connection

Confirmation that you have your own laptop or computer suitable for remote work

Brief details of any previous recruitment or onboarding experience



Applications that do not include the above may not be considered.



Job type: Full-time, remote

Language: Strong written and spoken English required
